feature: First-start guide opens a few seconds after start on a radio with no callsign; Settings > General > STATION > First-start guide > Start runs it again; never opens by itself with a callsign set or on unsaved defaults
how_to_confirm: Remote 'open' refuses the guide, so: clear the callsign over SSH (params db) and restart the GUI, or walk Settings > General > STATION with knob mfk / key MFK to Start. Confirm the panel state's 'win' names the guide and a screenshot OCRs step 1 'Language'; with a callsign set, restart the GUI and check 'win' never becomes the guide.

feature: Step 1 Language: list as Settings > Display > Language, choice applied at once, screen rebuilt and guide returns on this step in that language
how_to_confirm: In the guide, knob mfk to a language, key MFK; screenshot OCR shows the guide's labels in the new language and still on step 1; restore the language afterwards.

feature: Step 2 WiFi: Networks opens the WiFi window (turns WiFi on); the line above says connected network and address; GEN/ESC returns to the guide
how_to_confirm: Step to WiFi; screenshot OCR the status line contains the radio's SSID and IP (compare with SSH 'ip addr'); press Networks (key MFK) and check 'win' becomes the WiFi window, key GEN brings 'win' back to the guide. Do not change the network.

feature: Step 3 Callsign and Locator via the on-screen or USB keyboard; with a GPS fix a 'Use <locator>' line offers the GPS locator
how_to_confirm: Enter a test callsign with the on-screen keyboard (MFK walk + press), Enter; read back over SSH from the params db / Settings > General > STATION screenshot. The GPS-fix offer needs the Bluetooth GPS (X6200) and is screenshot only.

feature: Step 4 Country: list in screen language, 'From the callsign' offers cty.dat country, band-plan line says the region it takes; a country also sets the time zone when none was chosen
how_to_confirm: With a callsign set, OCR the 'From the callsign' line and the band plan line ('Auto, Region 2 ...'); choose a country, then check 'plan [...]' from the panel feed and the clock's zone (SSH 'date', OCR top-right clock).

feature: Step 5 Clock and time zone: shows date/UTC and what set it (NTP or GPS); manual date/time fields if neither; Time zone sets the displayed zone, logs stay UTC
how_to_confirm: OCR the step's 'NTP' source line (radio on WiFi); compare the shown UTC with the test computer's clock (also 'clk?' on the remote); choose a zone and OCR the top-right clock offset.

feature: Navigation and summary: Back/step/Skip/Next/Done, MFK moves between controls, Skip marks 'Skipped', ESC asks then a second ESC within 4 s skips the rest, GEN or another app leaves; Done shows settings and web address; never reopens by itself
how_to_confirm: Walk the guide with key F1-F5 and key MFK; OCR 'Skipped' in the summary for an unset item and the 'http://x6200.local' / IP line; key GEN leaves ('win' changes) and a GUI restart does not reopen it.

feature: Web configurator served at http://x6100.local/ or http://x6200.local/ (or the radio's IP) on port 80
how_to_confirm: HTTP GET http://<radio>/ returns 200 with the GoldCorpHF page; also by mDNS name.

feature: Settings shown follow the base firmware (codec gain, band output gain, IQ offsets, IQ balance, compressor/makeup, TX filter, FM emphasis, CESSB); unsupported ones hidden; Settings > Info > Baseband names the base
how_to_confirm: Open Settings > TX Cal, Settings > Audio > TX AUDIO and Settings > Info (walk with keys/MFK); screenshot OCR: X6200 shows no IQ offsets/CESSB; factory-V1.1.9 X6100 shows IQ offsets but no codec gain/CESSB; Baseband string matches the base (e.g. 'V1.1.9').

feature: Codec gain -25..+25 dB (patched X6100 base r3+, overall TX level) and band output gain -6..+6 dB kept per band (r8+)
how_to_confirm: Only with gdyuldin's patched base; on the bench X6100's factory V1.1.9 both rows must be hidden (screenshot of Settings > TX Cal). On a patched base: key a carrier at pwr 10 (1 W) into the cable and compare 't <W>' and the X6200's 'm' before and after a change; band output gain read back per band after a band change.

feature: Patched/test-base TX processing: compressor threshold and makeup -15..+15 dB (r3+), CESSB on/off and 0.0-5.0 dB (r12+), TX filter low 50-400 / high 2000-4000 Hz (r9+), FM pre/de-emphasis (r8+)
how_to_confirm: Hidden on factory V1.1.9 (screenshot of Settings > Audio > TX AUDIO and TX Cal > CESSB). On a patched/test base, over the cable at <=1 W: makeup raises 't' power; CESSB lowers ALC and keeps the X6200's spectrum width; a 2.5 kHz tone drops with the high edge at 2000 Hz; NFM high tones change with emphasis.

feature: IQ offsets per band (X6100) for carrier suppression; base takes a new value at the next transmission; a band never calibrated is 0
how_to_confirm: 'set txio N' / 'set txqo N' on the X6100, state keys txio/txqo change; key a carrier at pwr 1 into the cable and read the carrier level on the X6200's spectrum frames ('wide 1'); change band to an uncalibrated band and check txio/txqo read 0.

feature: IQ balance (gain, phase) per band, X6100 with GoldCorpHF base gcfix5, for opposite-sideband image suppression
how_to_confirm: Needs base gcfix5 (bench X6100 now factory V1.1.9: row hidden, screenshot). With it: 'set txig'/'set txip', state txig/txip change; tools/bench/txcal.py measures the image on the X6200 over the cable at <=1 W.

feature: TX calibration belongs to its radio: x6x00-fingerprint (hashed chip ID); on another radio the IQ calibration is cleared on every band; txcal_store.py save/apply
how_to_confirm: SSH: run x6x00-fingerprint, compare with the state's 'fp' key; tools/bench/txcal_store.py save then apply round-trips the file in tools/bench/calibrations/; GUI log says it cleared values when the stored fingerprint differs (simulate by editing the stored fingerprint, then restore).

feature: Mic gain per microphone (Hand mic 20, Built-in 30, 0-50) and Input Auto/Hand/Built-in
how_to_confirm: Change Settings > Audio > MICROPHONE values (state 'mic' shows the input); key at pwr 1 into the cable while 'play /tmp/bench_x.wav' sounds into the built-in mic (tools/bench/acoustic.py) and compare the other radio's received audio level / 'm' between two gains.

feature: Comp ratio on MFK 2:4 (1:1 off .. 8:1); X6200 base has three levels (2:1, 4:1, 8:1)
how_to_confirm: Put Comp on a knob (GEN to MFK 2:4, press), knob mfk to 4:1, screenshot OCR the knob line; key a bench voice file at pwr 1 into the cable and compare average power ('t' W) and the other radio's 'm' at 1:1 vs 4:1.

feature: Moni level (Settings > Audio > MICROPHONE, 0 default) plays own transmission on the speaker
how_to_confirm: State key 'moni' follows the setting; key at pwr 1 into the cable with moni 30: on the X6100 the TX monitor reaches the processor capture (G's voiceprint draws the over, screenshot); speaker level itself is by ear (owner).

feature: TCI transmit level (X6100): client audio levelled to the apps' level, fade-in over 1.5 s, ALC-driven climb, own TCI level, client gain set once per transmission
how_to_confirm: TCI client on port 50001 sends FT8 audio with PWR 0.1 W and 1 W into the cable; the remote's 't <W>' stays near the setting after the first second; the X6200's FT8 app decodes it ('ft8r' rows, 4 of 4).

feature: X6100 test base (V1.1.9 tx1a2-test): recognised by version string, TEST ONLY notes, compressor/CESSB off and TX filter 300-3000 Hz at each start, settings resent after base reset
how_to_confirm: Needs the test base written to the X6100 (owner's decision). Then: Settings > Info > Baseband OCR shows 'V1.1.9 Nov 27 2025,tx1a2-test' and 'TEST ONLY'; GUI log shows the settings sent at start.

feature: APP opens six button pages (APP 1:6 .. 6:6: Modes, Cluster, SWR Scan, RX Recorder / Settings, CW Trainer, Field Ops, Channels / ...); each app has its own button pages, first button goes to the next page
how_to_confirm: With Icon menus off, key APP repeatedly on the classic screen; screenshot OCR the F1-F5 labels against the table; 'apps' lists the same names.

feature: Icon menus on: APP opens a grid of tiles (incl. Walkie, Birdie Cal); MFK chooses, press opens, APP/ESC closes; grid scrolls
how_to_confirm: key APP on the classic screen; screenshot shows the tile grid; knob mfk 3, key MFK opens a tile (state 'app'/'win' changes); key APP closes it.

feature: VOL press does not close menus/apps and types nothing in a text field; on the main screen it acts as ESC; held it is still one press
how_to_confirm: Open an app ('open N'), key VOL 1/0: state 'win' unchanged. On the main screen open a popup and key VOL: popup gone (screenshot).

feature: Knob info lines over the buttons name each knob's control and value (message line when off or hidden), coloured by what a turn changes
how_to_confirm: Screenshot OCR the two lines (e.g. 'Volume 20'); knob vol 1 and compare with state 'vol'; turn Knob info off on the web Display page and OCR the message line instead.

feature: Knob press toggles between changing the value and choosing the control; a turn while choosing goes to the next control on that knob's list
how_to_confirm: key VOL press, knob vol 1, key VOL press, knob vol 2: OCR the knob line shows the next control (e.g. 'RF gain') and state 'rfg' changes.

feature: X6200 MFK inner ring chooses the MFK's control (and moves the walk frame); outer ring changes the value without a press
how_to_confirm: The remote has no inner ring; the owner turns it and a screenshot OCR shows the MFK line's control change.

feature: Holding a value button cycles it no knob -> VOL ('Added to VOL encoder') -> MFK ('Moved to MFK encoder') -> off ('Removed ...'), mark on the button shows which knob
how_to_confirm: GEN to VOL 1:2, long press F2 (key F2 1, wait 1.2 s, key F2 0); screenshot OCR the message; knob mfk 1 now changes that value (state 'sql' etc).

feature: Press of a value button puts it on a knob; on/off buttons switch (NB, NR, DNF, VOX, PRE, ATT, ATU); AGC press cycles Off/Slow/Fast/Auto
how_to_confirm: Key the GEN/DFN page buttons for NB, NR, PRE, ATT, ATU, AGC and read state 'nb','nr','pre','att','atu','agc' toggle/cycle.

feature: On a knob, AGC and Step step forward/back stopping at Off/Auto and 10 Hz/100 kHz; PRE, ATT, ATU switch
how_to_confirm: Assign AGC to the MFK, knob mfk +5: state 'agc' stops at Auto; Step on a knob: state 'step' stops at 100 kHz and 10 Hz.

feature: GEN pages VOL 1:2 (Volume, Squelch, RF gain, TX power), VOL 2:2 (Brightness, PRE, ATT, ATU), MFK 1:4-4:4; default knob lists (VOL: Volume, RF gain, filter, TX power; MFK: Zoom, DNF); Volume never leaves VOL
how_to_confirm: key GEN repeatedly, screenshot OCR the F-button labels per page; after a settings reset OCR the knob lines' default controls.

feature: Brightness on VOL 2:2 F2: 0-9, kept as Settings > Display > BACKLIGHT; below the dim level it lowers that too; never turns the light off
how_to_confirm: Press VOL 2:2 F2, knob vol -9: SSH read /sys/class/backlight/*/brightness never 0 and the setting reads 0; knob vol +5 raises it; restore.

feature: Walking the screen's values (#113): hold MFK, frame walks VFO, mode, AGC, PRE, ATT, ATU, NR, NB, DNF, RIT, XIT, step; press picks, turn changes; released by press/hold/ESC/VOL/app/6 s
how_to_confirm: key MFK long press, knob mfk 1 (to mode), key MFK, knob mfk 1: state 'mode' changes; screenshot shows the frame; wait 7 s and OCR the MFK line back to its own control.

feature: Hide buttons After 3/5/10 s: buttons and knob lines hide on the main screen; any key brings them back; F1-F5 first press only reveals; page keys show their hidden page; main knob/VOL/MFK keep them hidden
how_to_confirm: Set Hide buttons After 3 s on the web Display page; wait 4 s, screenshot shows waterfall to the bottom; key F1 once: buttons back and state unchanged (no action); key F1 again acts.

feature: Keep knob lines: the two knob lines stay while buttons hide (needs Knob info on)
how_to_confirm: With Hide buttons on and Keep knob lines on (web Display page), wait, screenshot OCR the knob lines still present; knob vol 1 updates them.

feature: Long-press actions for GEN, APP, KEY, MSG, DFN, DFL (Settings > Keys > PAGE KEYS, LONG PRESS)
how_to_confirm: Set GEN's long press to 'mute' (web Keys page), long press GEN: state 'muted' toggles; set 'frequency lock': state 'lock' toggles.

feature: FST: press steps up, hold steps down through 10 Hz, 100 Hz, 500 Hz, 1 k, 5 k, 10 k, 25 k, 100 kHz
how_to_confirm: key FST press repeatedly: state 'step' walks the list up to 100000; long press steps down.

feature: The radio's own keys (#111): press and hold of FST, ATU, A/B, Band down/up, AM, CW, SSB (X6100 PRE, AGC) take an action instead of 'Own'; Reset to own
how_to_confirm: Give A/B's hold 'mute' on the web Keys page, long press AB: state 'muted' toggles, VFO unchanged; Reset to own restores (state 'vfo' toggles on AB again).

feature: X6100 AGC key held switches split (not while an app holds the VFOs)
how_to_confirm: On the X6100 long press AGC: state 'split' toggles; with FT8 open ('ft8 open') it does not.

feature: Key action list for keys, holds and the USER page: keys' jobs (mode next/back, VFO A/B, band up/down, AGC, split, USER page, charger on/off), quick actions (screenshot, RX recorder, screen rec, mute, lock, step up/down, WF mode, WF 3D, CW decoder, CW ZAP, SWL panel, SWL save channel, ATT, PRE, tuner on/off), digital modes and tools (FT8 ... Sentry, Airspace, Birdie Cal, Time Signal, On the Air)
how_to_confirm: Assign actions to a band key's hold on the web Keys page and long press it: 'mode','vfo','freq','agc','split','muted','lock','att','pre','atu' change; screenshot -> a new file on /mnt; RX recorder -> WAV in /mnt/rec; CW decoder -> 'cw' feed; SWL save -> new /mnt/channels.json entry; app actions -> 'app'/'win'/'pg' name the window; charger -> Settings > General > Charger flips.

feature: Key actions that transmit: tuner tune (carrier) and TUNE ext. tuner on/off
how_to_confirm: Assign to a key, set pwr 10, trigger into the cable: state 'tune' / 'tx' goes 1 and 't' shows power, the other radio's 'm' rises; trigger again stops.

feature: USER page: F1-F5 of your own (Settings > Keys > USER PAGE), named after their action ('-' for none); shown from APP 4:6 User keys or a key given 'USER page'
how_to_confirm: Set USER F1 = Mode + (web Keys page); open User keys; screenshot OCR the label; key F1: state 'mode' advances.

feature: Web configurator Keys page (System > Keys): top and side keys, page keys, USER page, hand mic keys and lock per band/mode from the radio's lists
how_to_confirm: HTTP GET /keys returns the lists; POST a change and confirm the radio uses it (long press -> state change) and the page reads it back.

feature: Two keys at once: a key pressed while PTT is held does its job (and long press); the radio returns to receive the moment PTT is let go
how_to_confirm: pwr 1, 'key PTT 1 HOLD' into the cable, key BAND_UP 1/0 during it, release PTT: state 'tx' goes 0 within a moment and stays 0.

feature: Frequency lock: knob/F-INP/browser panel/TCI/Pat QSY/Field Ops tune refused; band keys, memories, channels, cluster spots and CAT still tune; LOCK shown in the strip, scale greyed
how_to_confirm: 'set lock 1' (state 'lock' 1, OCR 'LOCK'); knob main 5: 'freq' unchanged; 'set freq' refused; TCI 'vfo:0,0,<hz>;' leaves freq; rigctl 'F <hz>' on 4532 tunes; key BAND_UP tunes; lock still 1.

feature: Per band and mode lock (Settings > Keys > FREQUENCY LOCK): each band/mode keeps its own lock, also across a restart
how_to_confirm: Enable on the web Keys page; on 20 m USB 'set lock 1'; 'set mode CW': lock 0; back to USB: lock 1 ('Dial locked (this band and mode)' OCR); restart GUI: lock still 1.

feature: X6100 LOCK held restarts the base board after a 5 s countdown ('Keep holding LOCK to restart: 4 s'); let go before: no restart
how_to_confirm: key LOCK 1, wait 2 s, key LOCK 0: screenshot OCR 'LOCK let go: no restart', base data keeps flowing ('m' continues). The full restart (on battery it powers off) is owner-only.

feature: FT8, FT4, JS8, PSK, Olivia, JTTY, WSPR hold the frequency while open, their own knobs working; the user's lock is separate and survives the app
how_to_confirm: 'set lock 0', 'ft8 open', knob main 5: 'freq' unchanged (main knob moves the TX offset: 'ft8' state txfreq changes); 'ft8 close': 'lock' still 0 and knob main tunes again; repeat with lock 1 before opening.

feature: SSTV holds frequency, band and mode while it transmits a picture
how_to_confirm: Open SSTV, send a picture at pwr 1 into the cable; during 'tx' 1, knob main / key BAND_UP leave 'freq' and 'mode' unchanged; after Halt TX they act again.

feature: Hand mic digits 1-9, 0 (and H-22 dot = 10 m) select the band printed on the key (X6100 mic and H-22 maps differ); long press recalls memory 1-9; key codes logged
how_to_confirm: Owner presses keys; confirm state 'freq' band change via panel feed and the GUI log line 'hand mic: key 0x.. (3)' over SSH.

feature: F-INP (H-22 red F-INP/ENT) opens the frequency box, digits and dot type MHz, CE deletes, F-INP again tunes; not while locked; digits type in lists/text boxes
how_to_confirm: Owner types 7.074 + F-INP; state 'freq' 7074000; with 'set lock 1' the box does not open (screenshot).

feature: Hand mic F1, F2 (H-22 F3) press/long press take the action set in Settings > Keys > HAND MIC KEYS (F1 steps up/down by default)
how_to_confirm: Owner presses F1: state 'step' up; long press: down; after assigning NR to F2: 'nr' toggles.

feature: UP/DOWN (H-22 arrows) recall the channel before/after with its name (LOCK lets it through); long press band up/down; H-22 side keys change band
how_to_confirm: Owner presses UP: state 'freq'/'mode' match the next entry of /mnt/channels.json, screenshot OCR its name.

feature: MODE: next mode (LSB, USB, CW, CW-R, AM, NFM, X6200 SAM/WFM), long press DIG on/off in SSB; V/M opens the CHANNELS window
how_to_confirm: Owner presses MODE: state 'mode' advances; V/M: 'win' names CHANNELS.

feature: H-22 VOL+/VOL- step the RX volume (held: auto-repeat ~10/s from 0.4 s); A/B toggles VFO, long press copies VFO
how_to_confirm: Owner presses VOL+: state 'vol' +1; holds it: 'vol' climbs; A/B: 'vfo' toggles.

feature: X6100 mic keys FIL (filter pages / DFL long), XFC (VFO A/B), SPCH (lock), TUNER (tuner on/off, long = tune cycle, transmits), GENE (SWL panel, next station), NW (save SWL station as a channel); the X6100 mic also works on the X6200
how_to_confirm: Owner presses each: XFC -> 'vfo', SPCH -> 'lock', TUNER -> 'atu' (long press transmits: only on the cable), GENE -> SWL panel screenshot, NW -> new entry in /mnt/channels.json.

feature: Settings > Keys > KEYBOARD AND MOUSE > Shortcuts: off = keyboard only types (text boxes, CW keyboard, JTTY, shell); on = knob keys, CapsLock chords, CW paddle [ ]
how_to_confirm: With the Bluetooth keyboard (or a uinput keyboard created over SSH, if the suite has one): Shortcuts off, press '=' on the main screen: state unchanged; on: knob keys change state ('vol' via [ ]).

feature: Keyboard layout (US, UK, German, Swiss German, French, Belgian, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Swedish, Finnish, Danish, Norwegian, Polish, Czech), applied at once; accents in text boxes; AZERTY Caps Lock digits
how_to_confirm: Set German on the web Keys page; type 'Y/Z' and AltGr+Q into a text box with the keyboard; screenshot OCR shows 'Y', 'Z', '@'.

feature: Main-screen keyboard keys: arrows = MFK, Enter = MFK press, { } choose / [ ] turn VOL's control, - = knobs, f = frequency box, Scroll Lock = lock, Print Screen = screenshot
how_to_confirm: Shortcuts on: press ']' -> state 'vol' +1; Scroll Lock -> 'lock' toggles; Print Screen -> new screenshot file; 'f' + 14.074 + Enter -> 'freq' 14074000.

feature: CapsLock chords: K lock, P screenshot, S Settings, F frequency box, Up/Down band, 1-8 JTTY macros; main screen only, once per press, wake a dark screen first, chord key never typed
how_to_confirm: CapsLock+K -> 'lock' toggles; CapsLock+Up -> 'freq' next band; CapsLock+S -> 'win' Settings; CapsLock+P -> screenshot file; on a dark screen the first chord only wakes (state unchanged).

feature: CapsLock+1..5 in CW key MSG > CW messages 1-5 from the CW line
how_to_confirm: In CW at pwr 1 on the cable, CapsLock+1: 'tx' goes 1 and the X6200's CW decoder ('cw' feed) shows message 1's text.

feature: CapsLock+Space PTT toggle with the radio's refusals, 0 W hold, SWR protection; lets go on CapsLock+Space, not on air in 2 s, keyboard gone, no base data 3 s, after 3 minutes; gives control to the local operator
how_to_confirm: Cable, pwr 1: CapsLock+Space -> 'tx' 1, OCR 'PTT on: CapsLock+Space for off'; again -> 'tx' 0; out of band -> 'No TX on ...'; held 3 min -> 'PTT off: three minutes on the air'; remote 'control take' refused meanwhile.

feature: Mouse (USB, Bluetooth, BT keyboard touchpad) with Settings > Keys > KEYBOARD AND MOUSE > Mouse on: arrow, left click = tap (held = long press, drag scrolls), wheel = MFK, middle = MFK press, right = ESC; paddle-as-mouse stays paddle
how_to_confirm: Turn Mouse on (web Keys page); with the Rii touchpad (or a uinput mouse over SSH): wheel 1 notch -> MFK control changes one step (state), right click closes an app ('win'), left click on an F-button acts; screenshot shows the arrow.

feature: Quick QSO log box ('Call [sent [rcvd]]:') from CapsLock+L or KEY > CW 1:2 > F5 Log QSO; defaults 59/599; writes /mnt/field/logs/YYYYMMDD.adi with time, freq, mode; 'QSO logged: ...'
how_to_confirm: KEY until CW 1:2, F5, type 'T3ST 59 57' on the on-screen keyboard (MFK walk), Enter; SSH grep the call in /mnt/field/logs/<UTC day>.adi with the state's freq/mode; web Logs page lists it; OCR 'QSO logged'.

feature: Extra comma fields: name, QTH with locator, comment -> ADIF NAME, QTH, GRIDSQUARE, COMMENT; 64 characters
how_to_confirm: Log 'T3ST 59 57, Jean, Paris JN18du, test' and check the ADIF record has NAME, QTH, GRIDSQUARE JN18du and COMMENT.

feature: In CW (and RTTY) the call the decoder confirmed last is pre-filled; not carried into SSB
how_to_confirm: The other radio sends 'CQ T3ST' in CW at pwr 1 over the cable; on the receiver open Log QSO: OCR 'T3ST' already in the box; switch to SSB and it is empty.

feature: With the dial on a DX Cluster spot the spot's call is pre-filled (1 kHz SSB/AM/FM, 200 Hz CW/data; none when two are close); POTA/SOTA/WWFF/WWBOTA/HOTA references go into SIG/SIG_INFO/POTA_REF/SOTA_REF
how_to_confirm: With the cluster connected ('spots [...]' feed), 'set freq' to a spot, open Log QSO: OCR the spot's call; log it and check SIG/SIG_INFO in the ADIF when the comment holds a park reference.

feature: In CW with a line typed in the CW line, CapsLock+L logs that line instead of sending it
how_to_confirm: In CW, type 'T3ST 599 599' in the CW line, CapsLock+L: 'tx' stays 0, the ADIF has the QSO.

feature: Radio starts in the Sentry and returns to it when an app closes (F SYSTEM > START IN can choose the classic screen)
how_to_confirm: Restart the GUI over SSH: state 'pg' is a letter; 'open N' an app, 'close': 'pg' set again.

feature: Transmit locked in the Sentry: PTT, KEY, MSG and tuner tune refused; PTT while locked says 'PRESS A/B ON THE TOP PANEL TO UNLOCK, THEN PTT' with an arrow
how_to_confirm: On the cable, pwr 1, 'open sentry C', 'key PTT 1 HOLD' for 2 s: 'tx' stays 0, OCR the PRESS A/B message; key KEY/MSG: no TX, no window.

feature: Pages A-H (I with a Kraken) on the MFK inner ring; each title names the page
how_to_confirm: 'open sentry A' .. 'open sentry H': state 'pg' equals the letter, screenshot OCR the title (e.g. 'B VHF/UHF').

feature: X6100: hold the MFK and turn the main dial to change pages (dial does not tune while held; release is not a push)
how_to_confirm: key MFK 1, knob main 1, key MFK 0: 'pg' moves to the next page and 'freq' unchanged.

feature: X6100 A shows 50 kHz around the dial (middle of its 100 kHz), scans step 50 kHz, base held at widest zoom on V1.1.9 and zoom restored on leaving; V1.1.8 waits at x8+ ('ZOOM AT X4 OR WIDER')
how_to_confirm: 'open sentry A' on the X6100: OCR TUNED span 50 kHz; F1 scan: 'freq' steps ~50 kHz; 'close'/'open sentry F'->CLASSIC: state 'zoom' back to its value.

feature: X6100's PRE (held ATT), AGC and LOCK (held: base restart) work in the Sentry with a word on screen; V/M does nothing
how_to_confirm: In 'open sentry A' key PRE: 'pre' toggles; long PRE: 'att' toggles; key AGC: 'agc' cycles; key VM: 'win' unchanged.

feature: After a GUI restart the Sentry resumes the same page (SCAN CFG too), A/B/C scans, choices and sweep marks from /mnt/gui_state.conf; armed TX, signal lock, C playback, SWR scan and WSPR are not restored; two quick crashes give a clean start
how_to_confirm: 'open sentry C', start F4 SCAN, wait 3 s, check /mnt/gui_state.conf mtime; restart the GUI: 'pg' C and the scan running (OCR). Arm A/B, restart: not armed.

feature: GEN (or a tap on the title) shows the Sentry's controls help
how_to_confirm: In the Sentry key GEN: screenshot OCR the controls table; key GEN again closes.

feature: VFO knob on A tunes the X6200 by hand: the Sentry goes MANUAL and A's scan stops till F1, a band key or D's SCAN/LISTEN hands it back; MFK or VFO turned stops a scan
how_to_confirm: 'open sentry A', key F1 (scan running: 'freq' moving), knob main 3: 'freq' changes by the step and stops moving; title OCR 'MANUAL'; key F1 resumes.

feature: VOL knob: volume; push squelch, push RF gain, push volume; back to volume 5 s after the last turn; on B they are the SDR's
how_to_confirm: 'open sentry A', key VOL, knob vol 2: state 'sql' changes; key VOL, knob vol -2: 'rfg' changes; wait 6 s, knob vol 1: 'vol' changes.

feature: A/B on A and G arms the transmitter (X6200 TX ARMED blinks; G lamp TX ARMED); scans wait; CW/data switched to the band's voice mode (CW: USB from 10 MHz and 60 m, LSB below; data: LSB/USB) and put back on locking; any screen but A/G locks it
how_to_confirm: 'open sentry A', 'set mode CW' on 14 MHz, key AB: OCR 'TX ARMED', 'mode' USB; key AB: 'mode' CW. On 7 MHz: LSB. Arm, 'open sentry C': OCR not armed, mode back.

feature: Armed PTT transmits voice at the power set (base taken out of play mode while B plays the SDR on the speaker); KEY and MSG still refused; radio's TX rules apply

how_to_confirm: GET /api/digital_modes/lists (cfg 'digi_lists') returns the region and the PSK 40 m frequency for it; screenshot of 'open 119' Bands app per region

feature: Bands the plan does not cover get a strip typed from their name (CW, DIG/FT8/FT4/DATA, BCN, else all modes); broadcast and CB none; shown at the next band change
how_to_confirm: Add a band '60m CW' 5258500-5264000 via POST /api/bands (removed after); tune there → 'plan [...]' has one CW segment

feature: The main screen's CW line keys only in a CW segment (not NOT YOUR CLASS; Region 3 not above 3535/7030 kHz)
how_to_confirm: Pads on, pwr 1, text typed on the BT keyboard: on 7.025 MHz CW state tx 1 and the other radio decodes 'cw "..."'; on 7.100 MHz it refuses (tx 0)

feature: Screen rec (APP 3:6 button reading Stop rec while on, or a long-press action) records screen+audio to /mnt/screenrec/screen-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.avi (MJPEG 800x480, 8 fps, mono); Stop says how many files; web Gallery lists and converts to MP4
how_to_confirm: Remote 'key APP' to page 3 and the Screen rec F-key, 20 s, again to stop: `ls /mnt/screenrec` has a new .avi, ffprobe shows 800x480 MJPEG 8 fps + audio; GET /api/gallery lists it

feature: While recording the X6100 raises the monitor to >=30 (restored after); the X6200 keeps its own Moni level
how_to_confirm: Remote state 'moni' before, during and after a recording: X6100 >=30 during and back after; X6200 unchanged

feature: SCREEN REC File length 1 h (default), 45, 30, 15 or 5 min: a full file closes and recording goes on in a new one
how_to_confirm: File length 5 min (params.db screen_rec_split); record 11 min: three .avi in /mnt/screenrec 5 min apart; the Stop message OCR names 3 files

feature: Screen rec needs the SD card and 50 MB ('Screen rec: no SD card', 'SD card full'); under 10 min left 'SD card: about N min left' each minute; stops at 50 MB with the file closed ('SD card full, recording saved')
how_to_confirm: A temporary filler on /mnt leaving ~400 MB, start recording: screenshot OCR the notices and auto-stop, the .avi plays (ffprobe); delete the filler at once

feature: While recording no screensaver comes, and with the panel dark (Screen off, POWER) the GUI is still drawn into the file
how_to_confirm: Screensaver 1 min, record 3 min idle: screenshots show no rain; 'key POWER' short press darkens; ffmpeg frames from the .avi still change

feature: Walkie Talkie mode (Settings > Walkie or General > CONTROLS): portrait screen (VFO/memory, RX/TX, freq, mode, bandscope, S-meter, VOL/SQL/PWR bars) at once without restart; leave by APP > hold to WLK 4 > hold 'Exit hold'; apps, Settings and hand mic keys unavailable inside
how_to_confirm: Turn on via Settings (remote MFK): state 'win' is the walkie screen, screenshot portrait; 'open 101' leaves win unchanged; 'key APP', hold F1 to WLK 4:4, hold Exit → state win main, landscape screenshot

feature: Walkie bandscope: the main spectrum trace with band edges and span, the main zoom, running even with the main spectrum off
how_to_confirm: spectrum_show 0, walkie on: successive screenshots show a moving trace; 'set zoom 2' changes the span text (OCR)

feature: Walkie PTT (side key) transmits with the walkie microphone; red border; S-meter shows power and SWR; the Audio microphone back on exit
how_to_confirm: Pads on, pwr 1, amateur band: 'key PTT 1' → state tx 1 and mic = the walkie microphone, screenshot red border; 'key PTT 0'; after exit state mic = the Audio tab's input

feature: In walkie mode the VOL knob is always the volume (value buttons use the MFK); its previous function returns on exit
how_to_confirm: 'knob vol 3' in walkie → state vol +3; exit; with VOL set to SQL before, 'knob vol 1' changes state sql again

feature: WLK pages: WLK1 MEM/VFO, Band +/-, TX power; WLK2 AM/FM, SSB (held DIG), PRE (held ATT); WLK3 AGC (held split), A/B (held copy), Step (held as FST held), Lock; WLK4 Store, Clear, levels page; GEN/KEY/DFN/DFL/VM open their pages
how_to_confirm: 'key APP' then F1-F5 presses and holds per page: state band/freq, mode, pre/att, agc/split, vfo, step, lock and pwr change as listed; screenshots for the GEN/KEY/DFN pages

feature: WLK2 ATU held: tune (transmits)
how_to_confirm: Pads on, pwr 1: hold the ATU button → state tune 1 / tx 1 and 't' frames; then tx 0

feature: 32 walkie channels apart from Channel Memory (freq, mode, AGC, PRE, ATT): MEM knob steps 1-32 ('CH 05 - name' / '- empty'), Store, Clear (held), kept in /mnt/walkie_channels.json with optional names
how_to_confirm: Store on channel 5 via WLK4: /mnt/walkie_channels.json has ch 5 with freq/mode; 'knob main' in MEM → screenshot OCR 'CH 05 - ...' and state freq tunes; Clear empties it; a name added in the file shows

feature: Settings (APP page 2): tabs on three button pages, the page button or APP turns the page; the MFK walks the controls and stops at the ends; base-dependent cards (TX AUDIO, band output gain, TX filter, CESSB, FM emphasis) hidden on older bases
how_to_confirm: 'open 104'; 'key APP' turns the tab page (screenshot OCR tab names); 'knob mfk 50' reaches the last control with status rows in view; on the X6200 no TX AUDIO card (OCR)

feature: STATION First-start guide Start runs the first-start guide again
how_to_confirm: Start via remote MFK (or 'open 131'): state win names the guide; screenshot OCR

feature: STATION callsign (an empty field clears it) and QTH locator
how_to_confirm: Set in Settings: sqlite3 /mnt/params.db rows callsign / qth; band plan Auto's source text uses the locator

feature: STATION Country ('-' none by default; names in the screen's language from CLDR) used by band plan Auto and the CB app's plan
how_to_confirm: Set via Settings or cfg socket disp_set 'country'; cfg {"cmd":"pos_get"} over SSH (/tmp/x6100_cfg.sock) returns cc; the region follows with no locator/GPS

feature: DATE / TIME date, time and Zone (24 zones, applies at once, summer time by itself)
how_to_confirm: POST /api/set_timezone America/New_York; GET /api/get_timezone and /api/get_time; `date` over SSH and the top-right clock (OCR) agree; FT8/log times stay UTC

feature: 12-hour clock (top right '1:05:30 PM' vs '13:05:30' default; VISION '1:05 PM'; Field Ops and Walkie follow; logs and FT8 stay UTC)
how_to_confirm: POST /api/display clock_12h 1; screenshot OCR the clock format and its time vs `date`; params clock_12h

feature: Freq acceleration None / Lite (up to x6) / Strong (x15, sooner) and Accel. onset 1-5 (3); steps of 10 kHz and up never grow
how_to_confirm: Strong, onset 5: 20 'knob main 1' sent 20 ms apart → state freq moves more than 20 steps; None → exactly 20; params freq_accel (depends on how the remote times detents)

feature: Charger Off / On (default) / Shadow (and a 'Charger on/off' key action): what the base is asked with a supply in; low-battery power-off asks for On; the X6200 shows 'charging' only with On
how_to_confirm: On a supply: params.db charger; Settings > Info External OCR '... charging' with On, no 'charging' with Off/Shadow; top-right lightning vs plug; battery_log.csv % rises with On over 40 min

feature: TX shift of the band the radio is on (CONTROLS), shown in the status bar ('-600k', REV)
how_to_confirm: Set a -600 kHz shift on 10 m FM: screenshot OCR '-600k' in the status bar; remote state 'txf' = freq - 600000 (no TX)

feature: TCI SERVER on/off, port, status, connected client
how_to_confirm: GET /api/tci; ws://<radio>:50001 connects and receives 'protocol:' and 'ready;'; turned off via POST /api/tci the port refuses; the status line OCR names the client

feature: TCI Clients Operate or Listen only
how_to_confirm: POST /api/tci clients listen-only: a TCI 'vfo:0,0,7074000;' leaves state freq unchanged and 'trx:0,true;' does not key; Operate: freq changes

feature: TCI Ask before TX (on by default) with the Allowed list and Forget all
how_to_confirm: A new TCI client sends 'trx:0,true;' → remote state 'ask' set and screenshot OCR the question, state tx stays 0; answered No → refused; GET /api/tci Allowed list; Forget all empties it

feature: TEXT LOG Keyboard modes (on) and Size limit (1-100 MB, 10 MB): PSK, Olivia, Contestia, JTTY RX/TX and RTTY RX text logged on the card
how_to_confirm: The X6200 sends PSK31 at 0.1 W through the pads to the X6100 with 'open 121': GET /api/textlog lists a file with the sent text; Keyboard modes off → nothing new

feature: BACKLIGHT Timeout (0 off, 5-120 s, 30) and Brightness (-1..9 with the dim level): dims after the timeout, a key or knob restores; also on VOL 2:2
how_to_confirm: POST /api/display bright_timeout 5, bright_normal 7, bright_idle 2: SSH cat /sys/class/backlight/backlight/brightness drops after 5 s idle and rises after 'knob main 1'; timeout 0 never dims

feature: Buttons brightness Always Off / Always On / Temporarily On (the key lights, through the base)
how_to_confirm: Key lights are not visible remotely: owner looks; params.db brightness_buttons changes

feature: Screen off (min) (0 never, the default) and Screen always off (dark for browser/VFO-Knob use, POWER shows it for the blank time, a minute at least)
how_to_confirm: POST /api/display screen_off_min 1: after 60 s idle /sys/class/backlight/backlight shows the panel dark; 'key POWER' short press lights it; screen_off_always 1 → dark at once

feature: Screensaver None or Matrix rain (default) after Screensaver (min) 1-120 (5), Rain speed Normal/Slow/Very slow, colours from the theme (saver_bg, saver, saver_head)
how_to_confirm: POST /api/display screen_saver 1, screen_saver_min 1: after 60 s idle the USR1 screen dump shows the rain (mostly dark, differs from the GUI); screen_saver 0 never

feature: The first key, knob turn or hand mic key on the screensaver only wakes (the rest of that turn for 0.5 s too); POWER wakes; on a dark screen a knob lights and turns
how_to_confirm: Under the rain 'knob main 1' → state freq unchanged and the GUI back in the dump; a second 'knob main 1' 1 s later changes freq

feature: Use that restarts the minutes: radio keys/knobs, hand mic, keyboard, browser panel tuning, remote screen keys, a TCI or Pat frequency, CW Trainer groups and keying
how_to_confirm: Screensaver 1 min; a TCI 'vfo:0,0,F;' every 30 s → no rain after 3 min; stop → rain a minute later

feature: Any TX ends the screensaver within a second and none comes on the air; minutes restart on receive; Screen off still darkens on time
how_to_confirm: Under the rain, pads on, pwr 1: TCI 'trx:0,true;' → the dump shows the GUI within 1 s; a 2 min over with saver 1 min shows no rain; rain 1 min after key-up

feature: Someone on the web Remote > Screen page (or a screen recording) keeps the screensaver away; Screen off still darkens the panel
how_to_confirm: Keep the web Remote Screen page open 3 min with saver 1 min: no rain in the dumps; closed → rain within a minute

feature: Under the screensaver the radio receives, apps decode, cluster/browser/TCI spectrum continue; only drawing stops; it comes back fully drawn
how_to_confirm: Under the rain remote spectrum frames and TCI audio keep their rate; `top` GUI CPU lower than lit 3D; the first dump after waking shows a full waterfall

feature: Popups Freq (off by default): the new frequency big in the middle while tuning
how_to_confirm: POST /api/display mag_freq 1; 'knob main 5' then an immediate dump: OCR the big frequency equals state freq

feature: Popups Info (off by default): a note when a key switches the VFO, split, AGC, PRE, ATT or ATU
how_to_confirm: POST /api/display mag_info 1; 'key AB 1/0' then a dump: OCR the note

feature: Icon menus (on by default): APP grid, Modes tiles and Settings tab icons; off, button pages, a list and numbers
how_to_confirm: POST /api/display icon_menus 0/1; 'key APP' dump shows grid vs buttons; 'open 114' tiles vs list

feature: Knob info: the value shown while a knob turns
how_to_confirm: POST /api/display knob_info 0/1; 'knob mfk 1' then a dump: the value line present/absent

feature: Hide buttons Off / 3 / 5 / 10 s (buttons and knob lines hide, the next key brings them back) and Keep knob lines
how_to_confirm: POST /api/display buttons_hide (3 s): a dump after 4 s idle has no button bar; any 'key' brings it back; knob_lines_stay 1 keeps the knob lines

feature: Theme, applied at once without a restart
how_to_confirm: POST /api/display {"name":"theme","theme":NAME} for each of GET /api/display 'themes': the dump changes and the GUI pid does not; params theme_name

feature: Font Sony Sketch, Roboto or DejaVu (default), at once; themes with their own font keep it
how_to_confirm: Change it in Settings via remote MFK: params.db font; glyph diff of the labels in the dump; under Classic no change

feature: Language English (default), Español, Français, Nederlands, 简体中文, at once; missing strings in English; Chinese from Noto Sans CJK
how_to_confirm: Choose it in Settings (cfg 'lang'): params.db language; OCR a known label (Settings tab names) in that language; back to English

feature: /mnt/i18n/<code>.po is used before the image's and read again when the language is chosen again
how_to_confirm: scp a copy of po/es.po with one msgstr changed to a marker to /mnt/i18n/es.po; choose Español again; OCR the marker; remove the file

feature: INTERFACE Decoder text and FT8/FT4 info options
how_to_confirm: Toggle in Settings (cfg disp_set digi_text_compact or similar); 'open 101' dump of the FT8 window changes

feature: Broadcast names: 'BC <station>' in a light blue box on the frequency strip for a broadcast station on the air now (EiBi list)
how_to_confirm: Pick a station on air now from the radio's EiBi list file; 'set freq' to it; dump OCR 'BC '; off → the band name

feature: On a memory channel the strip shows 'CH <name>' (before broadcast names), dimmed when its mode/AGC/PRE/ATT differ, gone when tuned off
how_to_confirm: Add a channel via /api/channels; 'set freq' and 'set mode' to it: OCR 'CH name'; 'set mode' other → dimmed pixels; 'knob main 1' → gone

feature: Channels (off by default): memory channels marked by name on the waterfall, tuning snaps to them; web Channels edits show within a second
how_to_confirm: POST /api/display channel_marks 1: dump OCR the channel name over the waterfall; rename via /api/channels → new name within 1 s; 'knob main' near it snaps (state freq = channel freq)

feature: Birdies (MAIN SCREEN): Birdie Cal marks on the main screen
how_to_confirm: POST /api/display birdie_marks 1: the dump shows marks at the Birdie Cal frequencies

feature: RX AUDIO Speaker mode
how_to_confirm: Change in Settings: remote state 'spk' changes; params row

feature: Line-in / Line-out 0-36 (10), the base's own levels (Line-in = the digital apps' TX input); Play/Rec gain no longer change Line-in
how_to_confirm: 'set linein 12' → state linein 12, params.db line_in 12; changing Play gain in Settings leaves line_in unchanged

feature: Play / Rec gain (dB): the radio's own playback and recording volumes
how_to_confirm: Change in Settings: params.db play_gain_db_f / rec_gain_db_f; a Recorder ('open 105') file's RMS scales by the dB change

feature: Boot sound: CQ CQ in CW with the boot logo, quiet, at volume 28 when VOL is lower; off by default; none with Speaker always off
how_to_confirm: Owner listens at an x6x00-reboot; params row

feature: Speaker always off (also web Display, Remote station card): speaker and TX monitor silent whatever the volume, no boot sound; browser, TCI and BT audio go on; turning VOL says so; CW sidetone keeps Key volume
how_to_confirm: POST /api/display speaker_off 1: remote state 'spk'/'muted' show it; TCI audio stream RMS unchanged; 'knob vol 1' → dump OCR the notice

feature: TX AUDIO card: compressor threshold/makeup, TX filter, FM pre/de-emphasis; X6100 with a patched base (r3, r8, r9+) only, hidden on Xiegu's base and on the X6200
how_to_confirm: On a patched base change the TX filter and send a tone sweep (tools/bench/tones.py) at 0.1 W through the pads: the X6200's received spectrum response changes; on Xiegu's base the card is absent (OCR)

feature: Compressor (Comp on MFK 2:4) off (1:1) by default, voice only (X6100 leaves data modes and CW out), makeup after it; the X6200 maps ratios to 2:1/4:1/8:1
how_to_confirm: Default ratio 1:1 in params; set 4:1 with makeup 0, send TCI TX audio in SSB at 0.1 W through the pads: 't' power lower than at 1:1; in USB-D unchanged

feature: MICROPHONE Input (Built-in, Hand, Auto), Hand mic gain, Built-in gain
how_to_confirm: Change in Settings: remote state 'mic' changes; params rows (the effect on air needs a voice: owner)

feature: Moni level (0-100, 0 by default): own transmission on the speaker, silent whenever the speaker is
how_to_confirm: Change in Settings: remote state 'moni' follows, default 0 on both; params row

feature: VOX On, Gain, Anti-VOX, Delay
how_to_confirm: Owner speaks at the microphone with the pads on: state tx 1 and back to 0 after Delay; Anti-VOX high with speaker audio keeps tx 0 (play mode mutes the mics, so a played file cannot stand in)

feature: AGC Hang, Knee, Slope
how_to_confirm: The other radio sends a carrier stepped 0.1 → 1 W through the pads: the receiving radio's TCI RX audio level vs input follows the knee/slope; params rows

feature: WiFi/BT power switch (one chip: Bluetooth off with it)
how_to_confirm: Off drops the test link: owner switches it back; then `nmcli radio wifi` and `bluetoothctl show` Powered

feature: WIFI status, IP and networks list (scan when the tab or WiFi window opens, or Scan)
how_to_confirm: 'open 108' or Settings > Wireless: dump OCR the SSID and an IP equal to `ip addr show wlan0`

feature: Connect: password 8-63 (hand mic digits type), open joins at once, WPA2/WPA3 in WPA2, WEP/Enterprise/OWE/WPA3-only/hidden refused with a message; four tries then the reason; a changed network's profile updated in place; failure details in /mnt/app_logs/wifi.txt
how_to_confirm: Needs a second access point or a wrong password: owner; dump OCR the reason; /mnt/app_logs/wifi.txt written without the password

feature: Per saved network Address: DHCP (default) or Static 'address/prefix gateway DNS'; also the web Network page for every saved network
how_to_confirm: GET /api/network/wifi (cfg wifi_nets) lists dhcp/ip; set static to the address it has now via POST /api/network/wifi (uuid), it rejoins in seconds and `nmcli con show` shows manual; set DHCP back

feature: Failed self-started joins retried with the best saved network (15 s, 30 s, 1, 2, 5 min, then every 10 min); after six failures the chip is power-cycled (at most every 10 min, not with a cable)
how_to_confirm: Owner turns the access point off and on: /var/log/messages 'wifi:' retry times; the radio rejoins untouched

feature: Saved networks, SSH host keys and root's SSH keys copied to /mnt/backups/backup.tgz at clean shutdown and on web SSH key changes; restored at a rewritten card's first start
how_to_confirm: After `x6x00-reboot`: /mnt/backups/backup.tgz mtime new and `tar tzf` lists the NetworkManager connections, ssh host keys and /root/.ssh (the restore needs a card rewrite: owner)

feature: Once joined the WiFi power saving is off and no scans run while connected (only on the WiFi window/tab or Scan); a lost access point is still looked for
how_to_confirm: SSH `iw dev wlan0 get power_save` → off; 10 min of ping -i 0.2 from the test computer with no gap over 0.5 s; `iw event` shows no scans until 'open 108'

feature: X6200 keeps off channels 9-11 when another access point of the network is at >=-65 dBm (moves within seconds, same address); from v0.3.12.42 the driver notches its own 2457.6/2470.6 MHz lines, no channel avoided, links weaker than -60 dBm moved to an AP 8 dB stronger; logged 'wifi:' in /var/log/messages
how_to_confirm: SSH `iw dev wlan0 link` (channel, signal) and grep 'wifi:' /var/log/messages; tools/bench/tci_rate.py TCI audio stream >=99 % of real time

feature: X6100: the GUI holds the WiFi chip's power over GUI restarts (no power cut)
how_to_confirm: Ping the X6100 during `/etc/init.d/S95gui restart`: no outage over a second and `iw dev wlan0 link` stays associated

feature: Clock set by NTP (three tries 10 s apart) and written to the clock chip; ntpd restarted if it found no server; /var/log/ntpdate.log
how_to_confirm: After x6x00-reboot /var/log/ntpdate.log shows success; `date -u` within 1 s of the test computer; `hwclock -r` agrees

feature: X6100: access points that never answer 8723bu's association (MediaTek GL-MT3000/MT3600BE, UniFi U6+) fixed in the card image's driver; rtl8xxxu fallback by SSH
how_to_confirm: Needs such an access point: owner; `lsmod | grep -E '8723bu|rtl8xxxu'`; dmesg 'auth success, start assoc' followed by an association

feature: NETWORK NAME: the radio's LAN name (x6100 / x6200 by default), reachable as <name>.local
how_to_confirm: GET /api/hostname; `dns-sd -G v4 <name>.local` resolves to the radio; change via POST /api/hostname and back

feature: TAILSCALE on/off, status, tailnet name and address, Funnel with Public address, login/allow link as a QR code, Log out
how_to_confirm: GET /api/tailscale status JSON; `tailscale status` over SSH; dump shows the QR/state

feature: ETHERNET: a USB Ethernet adapter with DHCP or a static address
how_to_confirm: Needs an adapter on HOST: owner plugs it; cfg eth_get / GET /api/network shows the address; `ip addr show eth0`

feature: ADAPTER Bluetooth power, Status (on/hidden, pairing, off, chip off, service stopped), Address
how_to_confirm: Settings > Bluetooth dump OCR Status and Address; SSH `bluetoothctl show` Powered and Address match (read only: never power off with bluetoothctl)

feature: Pairing (3 min): visible and pairable with a countdown; pairing requests refused outside the window
how_to_confirm: Press Pairing via remote MFK: `bluetoothctl show` Discoverable yes / Pairable yes; after 180 s both no; dump OCR the countdown

feature: DEVICES Scan (16 s) and the list with tags (headphones, keyboard, phone, CAT, GPS, new, connected); MFK on a new device pairs and connects (keyboard code in Activity, 'not found - is it in pairing mode?')
how_to_confirm: With the Rii keyboard in pairing mode: Scan → dump OCR its tags; MFK press → `bluetoothctl info <addr>` Paired yes, Connected yes

feature: Paired-device menu: Connect/Disconnect, Connect at startup (headphones), GPS for gpsd, Forget (asks again, Cancel first)
how_to_confirm: Disconnect → `bluetoothctl info` Connected no; Connect → yes; Forget → no longer listed as paired

feature: HEADPHONES RX to headphones, Volume, Mute speaker; one pair at a time
how_to_confirm: With BT headphones connected: `bluetoothctl info` A2DP connected; remote state 'spk' muted with Mute speaker; the Note icon blue

feature: BLUETOOTH CAT: clients connected and port
how_to_confirm: A PC on RFCOMM sends CAT 'FA;' → the reply has the frequency; Clients count OCR 1; the Keyboard status icon amber

feature: GPS for gpsd on a paired Bluetooth device
how_to_confirm: With the Bluetooth GPS set: `gpspipe -w -n 5` has TPV mode 3; the status arrow green; band plan Auto source 'GPS'

feature: PAGE KEYS, LONG PRESS: the long-press action of GEN, APP, KEY, MSG, DFN and DFL
how_to_confirm: POST /api/keys (keys_set long_gen = screen rec action); remote 'key GEN 1', 1 s, 'key GEN 0' → a recording starts (/mnt/screenrec); GET /api/keys reflects it

feature: TOP AND SIDE KEYS: press and hold of FST, ATU, A/B, band keys and mode keys (X6100 PRE and AGC too), own job or an action; Reset to own
how_to_confirm: keys_set press_ab to 'WF 3D on/off' via POST /api/keys; 'key AB 1/0' → GET /api/display wf_3d toggles and state vfo unchanged; reset_top → AB swaps VFOs again

feature: USER PAGE: the actions of the USER page's F1-F5
how_to_confirm: keys_set user_f1 to an action; open the USER page and 'key F1 1/0' → the action's effect in remote state or GET /api/display

feature: FREQUENCY LOCK Per band and mode (off by default)
how_to_confirm: keys_set lock_per_band 1; 'set lock 1' on 20m USB, BAND_UP → state lock 0, BAND_DOWN → 1; with lock 1 'knob main 1' leaves freq

feature: HAND MIC KEYS F1, F2, F1 long, F2 long (X6200 F3 and F3 long for the H-22)
how_to_confirm: Owner presses the hand mic keys; GET /api/keys mic_* holds the setting

feature: PADDLE: USB paddles Connected, dit/dah of each kind, Learn dit and dah, Swap, Serial port
how_to_confirm: Owner plugs and keys a USB paddle; dump OCR Connected and the learned keys

feature: KEYBOARD AND MOUSE: layout of a USB or Bluetooth keyboard (US default, UK, German, French...), Shortcuts (off), Mouse (off)
how_to_confirm: With the paired Rii keyboard: Shortcuts on → CapsLock+Up changes the band (state freq); German layout → a typed 'z' shows as 'z' in a text field (dump OCR)

feature: CLUSTER FILTERS Modes, Bands, Activity (POTA, SOTA, ...; none lit = all spots)
how_to_confirm: POST /api/cluster/filters; the remote 'spots [...]' contain only the chosen modes/bands; dump of the spot list

feature: CLUSTER VIEW Newest first, All bands, Spot snap hold, Spot snap speed
how_to_confirm: POST /api/display cluster_order / cluster_all_bands; column order in the dump; 'knob main' near a spot snaps (state freq = spot freq)

feature: PSK REPORTER Report decodes (on by default)
how_to_confirm: With FT8 decoding: SSH `tcpdump -n udp port 4739` shows reports to report.pskreporter.info; off → none

feature: X6100 TX CALIBRATION IQ offsets per band (null the carrier; every base)
how_to_confirm: tools/bench/txcal.py with the X6200 receiving through the pads at 0.1 W: the carrier at the dial drops with the stored offsets; band rows tx_i_offset / tx_q_offset in params.db

feature: X6100 IQ balance per band (base gcfix5): suppresses the opposite-sideband image; effective at the next TX
how_to_confirm: txcal.py: a 600 Hz USB tone at 0.1 W; the X6200 measures the image at -600 Hz lower with the stored balance than at (0,0); rows tx_iq_gain / tx_iq_phase

feature: X6100 band output gain (base r8+) and codec gain (r3+); on Xiegu's V1.1.9 only the IQ offsets show
how_to_confirm: On a patched base the output gain changes the 't' watts at the same pwr through the pads; on Xiegu's V1.1.9 the dump shows the IQ offsets only

feature: CESSB on and level
how_to_confirm: SSB TCI TX audio at 0.1 W through the pads: the received average power ('t' and the other radio's 'm') higher with CESSB on at the same peak; params row

feature: SWR protection Off or 1.5-5.0 (2.0): TX stops after 0.3 s over ('TX stopped: SWR 3.4'), not during ATU tune or external TUNE, nothing locked (Winlink waits 5 min)
how_to_confirm: Needs a mismatched load (the pads read ~1.0): owner; dump OCR the stop message, state tx 0, the next PTT keys again

feature: TX PROTECTION TX ranges (Ham bands, South Korea, Own list), Own list file (Read again), TX outside ham bands
how_to_confirm: GET/POST /api/tx_ranges; cfg socket {"cmd":"band_use","lo":F,"hi":F} over SSH returns 2 inside the chosen ranges and 1 outside (7.1 MHz, 27.185 MHz, Korean edges); tx_ranges_read after editing the own list

feature: EXTERNAL TUNER TUNE power (W) and TUNE time limit (s)
how_to_confirm: Pads on: TUNE power 0.1 W, limit 3 s; remote 'tune 1 10' → 't' frames ~0.1 W and state tune back to 0 after 3 s

feature: S-METER Preamp (0-40 dB, 19 / X6200 16), Attenuator (0-40 dB; X6200 0-70 per band on supply and on battery), RF gain a step (0-2 dB, 0.6): the reading stays put when PRE, ATT or RF gain change
how_to_confirm: The other radio sends a steady carrier at 0.1 W through the pads (~-60 dBm): 'm' with PRE on/off, ATT on/off, rfg 100/40 agree within ~2 dB; band_params smeter_att / smeter_att_bat rows

feature: Measure (~12 s) sets PRE/ATT/RF gain figures for the band (both 40 m/20 m parts) and the power source ('Done on 40m CW and 40m SSB, on battery: PRE 16 dB, ATT 28 dB'); stops on a wandering reading, band change, supply change, ATT to S1; ATT top 70/40 says so
how_to_confirm: With that carrier (~-55 dBm for the X6200) press Measure via remote MFK: dump OCR 'Done on ...'; params rows change; state pre/att/rfg back as before; 'set band +1' during it → 'Stopped: band changed'

feature: X6200 two attenuator figures per band (on supply / on battery), switched after 5 s steady, defaults from the table, older single values migrated as the supply figure
how_to_confirm: Owner pulls and inserts the supply: the 'm' reading with ATT on moves to the other figure after 5 s; band_params smeter_att vs smeter_att_bat

feature: X6200 S-meter in AM, SAM and WFM from the spectrum power inside the filter, matched to the base's reading learned in other modes
how_to_confirm: The X6100 sends an AM carrier at 0.1 W through the pads: the X6200's 'm' in AM rises and falls with the carrier and agrees with the USB reading within a few dB after learning

feature: Stuck TX guard: base still in TX 2 s after PTT off with a failed write → TX power 0 until RX; base log lines (register write failed/resent, PTT off resent, TX power set to 0 / restored, base silent, no data from the base said on screen, TX back to RX, SWR scan stopped)
how_to_confirm: Passive after every cabled TX run: grep the base log in /mnt/app_logs for these lines; any 'TX power set to 0' followed by 'restored'; state pwr back to its setting after the over

feature: FIRMWARE card: project, source, firmware version, baseband version, X6200 PA bias in use and its source
how_to_confirm: Settings > Info dump OCR: the version equals `x6100-update status` and remote state 'fp'; the baseband line matches the base log; X6200 shows the PA bias line

feature: Broadcast list Update (EiBi, season A/B, previous season fallback): 'In use: season ..., N stations', progress, success and failure messages; the old list kept; SWL panel and BC names use it at once
how_to_confirm: Press Update via remote: dump OCR 'Broadcast list updated: N stations'; the list file's mtime on the radio changes; offline 'No internet connection'

feature: Factory reset: panel of what goes and stays, MFK right/left deletes or keeps the WiFi networks, hold MFK 3 s to confirm, Esc cancels; resets params.db, app freqs, cluster, TCI and its allowed clients, browser remote (50002), time zone, headphone volume, BT CAT; keeps logs, channels, macros, pairings, WiFi, SSH keys, name, Tailscale, accounts; GUI restarts
how_to_confirm: scp /mnt/params.db off first; open Reset, 'key MFK 1', 3.5 s, 'key MFK 0' with the WiFi line 'kept': new GUI pid, params.db at defaults, /mnt/qso_log.db and channels unchanged, WiFi still up; an early release OCR 'Released: reset cancelled'; restore params.db after

feature: POWER box: Battery ('7.9 V  66%' or 'not fitted'), External ('12.1 V  charging' or 'none'), Time left ('learned from N h on battery, M charges' or 'starting values, learning')
how_to_confirm: Settings > Info dump OCR the three lines vs remote state 'bat' and the last /mnt/battery_log.csv row

feature: Main knob steps channels: the main knob goes through the walkie channels instead of tuning (as MEM/VFO on WLK 1)
how_to_confirm: On in Settings > Walkie, walkie mode on: 'knob main 1' → state freq jumps to the next stored channel in /mnt/walkie_channels.json, not one step

feature: Walkie Microphone (Built-in default, Hand, Auto) used while the walkie screen is up; the Audio tab's input unchanged
how_to_confirm: Set Hand in Settings > Walkie; walkie on → remote state 'mic' is hand; exit → state mic back to the Audio setting

feature: PWR 0.1-10 W on the X6100, 0.1-8 W on the X6200; knob, WLK 1, Panel PWR, TCI drive (100 % = the top) and CAT stop there; a saved value above 8 W comes back as 8 W
how_to_confirm: Remote 'set pwr 100' then panel state 'pwr' reads 100 on the X6100 and 80 on the X6200; 'set pwr 1' reads 1; TCI 'drive:0,100;' -> pwr 100 / 80 and 'drive:0,50;' -> 50 / 40; rigctl 'L RFPOWER 1.0' then 'l RFPOWER' gives the same top. On the X6200 write pwr above 8 W into the settings over SSH, restart the GUI: state pwr 80. No TX needed.

feature: On battery (supply gone for 5 s) every way of setting PWR stops at 5 W, a higher PWR drops to 5 W with 'TX power 5 W on battery'; PWR stays 5 W when the supply returns; TCI drive gives 5 W from 50 % (X6100) / 62 % (X6200)
how_to_confirm: Owner unplugs the supply: state 'bat' changes, state pwr drops from 80 to 50 within ~6 s, 'set pwr 80' reads back 50, TCI 'drive:0,70;' reads 50; screenshot (SIGUSR1) for the message. Supply back: pwr stays 50 and 'set pwr 80' is accepted again.

feature: PTT refused outside the amateur-band table on every path (PTT key, walkie screen, CAT answers NG, TCI, browser Panel) with 'No TX on 27.185 MHz' / 'Out of band: Settings > TX Cal'
how_to_confirm: 'set freq 27185000', 'key PTT 1 <id>' -> 'err ptt: no TX on 27.185 MHz ...' and state tx stays 0 with no 't' frames; rigctl 'T 1' -> RPRT error (NG); TCI 'trx:0,true;' -> state tx stays 0; screenshot shows the two-line message.

feature: Built-in TX table edges (2200 m, 630 m, 160-10 m, Alaska channel 5.167-5.168, 60 m 5.250-5.450, 8 m 40-45, 6 m 50-54): 1 kHz outside each edge is refused
how_to_confirm: For each table row: 'set freq' just below the lower and just above the upper edge, 'key PTT 1 <id>' -> 'err ptt: no TX on ...', state tx 0; rigctl 'T 1' -> error. Back to 14.074 between tries.

feature: Inside the table edges (e.g. 7.299, 14.349, 28.001, 50.001 MHz) TX is allowed
how_to_confirm: At 0.1 W into the 80 dB chain: TCI 'trx:0,true;' with a 1 kHz tone just inside an HF/6 m edge: state tx 1, 't' frames, the other radio's spectrum rises there; then unkey.

feature: The X6200's receive-only ranges (FM broadcast, airband, the WR12's) never transmit ('Receive only there'), even with TX outside ham bands on
how_to_confirm: X6200 'set freq 100000000' then 'key PTT 1 <id>' -> 'err ptt: no TX on 100.000 MHz: receive only'; TCI trx stays 0; screenshot 'Receive only there'.

feature: TX outside ham bands (Settings > TX Cal > TX PROTECTION, web Display page Transmitter card): off by default and after the update; on lets the radio transmit 0.1-55 MHz (receive-only stays receive-only)
how_to_confirm: Read the switch on the web Display page (HTTP) and in Settings (screenshot): off. Toggle it on the web page and read it back; turn it off again. Never key out of band on the bench: the off state is proved by tx-out-of-band-ptt-refused.

feature: TX ranges: Ham bands (default) / South Korea / Own list; saved at once, kept over restart and update; a settings reset, an older backup or a bad settings file brings Ham bands back
how_to_confirm: Set it on the web Display page Transmitter card, restart the GUI over SSH, read it back on the page and in Settings > TX Cal (screenshot); set Ham bands again.

feature: South Korea TX ranges: only the Korean amateur ranges transmit (7.250 refused, 7.100 allowed); TX outside ham bands does not widen it; 'No TX on 7.250 MHz' / 'TX ranges: Settings > TX Cal'; the Panel says 'outside the TX ranges'
how_to_confirm: Choose South Korea; 'set freq 7250000', 'key PTT 1 <id>' -> 'err ptt: no TX on 7.250 MHz: outside the TX ranges ...'; rigctl 'T 1' -> error; 'tune 1 <id>' -> 'err tune: ...'; 3.560 and 1.830 refused too; restore Ham bands.

feature: Own list from /mnt/tx_ranges.conf (MHz from-to, # comments, up to 6 decimals, up to 64 ranges, unreadable lines left out); read at start, on choosing Own list, on Read again and on the web Save; Settings shows the ranges and the first unreadable line; no file or no readable line transmits nowhere
how_to_confirm: Write '7.000-7.200' and a bad '7,1-7,2' line over SSH, choose Own list, press Read again (or Save on the web Transmitter card text field): 7.250 and 14.074 PTT -> 'err ptt: ... outside the TX ranges'; screenshot of Settings shows the ranges and the bad line; the GUI log has the read. Then move the file away and Read again: PTT on 7.100 refused too, screenshots 'No TX ranges: Settings > TX Cal' and 'No TX anywhere: no /mnt/tx_ranges.conf'; put it back, Ham bands.

feature: With South Korea / Own list a transverter transmits only where its IF (frequency less the shift) is inside the ranges (2 m via 28 MHz IF: 144.000-145.700)
how_to_confirm: Transverter 1 144-148 MHz shift 116 MHz, South Korea: 'set freq 145800000', 'key PTT 1 <id>' -> 'err ptt: no TX on ...'; at 145.000 no refusal (keying only at 0.1 W into the chain). Restore.

feature: TX ranges apply to PTT, CAT, TCI, Panel, the apps, CW, the tuners, the SWR scan sweep and the 0 W hold; the CW Trainer's key is refused outside them
how_to_confirm: South Korea, dial 7.250: 'ft8 open', 'set freq 7250000', 'ft8 cq' -> ft8 sending stays false, state tx 0; CW + TCI 'cw_macros:0,TEST;' -> tx 0; 'tune 1 <id>' -> err; 'open 115' and key via TCI -> screenshot 'No TX'.

feature: SDR transmitters on the HOST port (HackRF/bladeRF, the Sentry's G WALKIE) have their own table, 2 m/1.25 m/70 cm/33 cm/23 cm only, whatever TX outside ham bands says; nowhere with South Korea/Own list; the SDR daemon refuses too
how_to_confirm: HackRF on the radio's HOST port, minimum gain into a load: G WALKIE TX on 146.520 keys (x6x00-rtlspec log over SSH); on 151.000 refused on screen and in the daemon's log; with South Korea chosen 146.520 refused too.

feature: Zello and SVXConnect simplex repeaters key only inside the table or an enabled transverter range; CB/air/broadcast audio goes to the network only with TX outside ham bands on (with a warning)
how_to_confirm: With a Zello/SVXConnect link up: tune 27.185 (or the X6200's airband) and send audio from the network: state tx stays 0; in band (28.4, 0.1 W, cable) it keys; with the switch off no CB audio reaches the channel.

feature: Out of band the digital apps, voice messages, Winlink (ARDOP/Mercury/XARA), CW messages/beacons, QRSS3, CW keyboard, USB paddle, PTT in CW, Field Ops test beacon, the radio's tuner, TUNE and the SWR scan are refused
how_to_confirm: Dial 27.185: FT8 open + 'set freq 27185000' + 'ft8 cq' -> no tx; CW + TCI 'cw_macros:0,TEST;' -> no tx; 'tune 1 <id>' -> 'err tune: no TX on 27.185 MHz ...'; 'open 117' screenshot 'No TX on 27.185 MHz'; state tx 0 throughout.

feature: In split the status-bar VFO turns red when the other (TX) VFO is outside the bands; the TX frequency is what is checked (the X6200's dial outside does not turn it red)
how_to_confirm: 'set split 1', VFO B at 27.185 ('set vfo', 'set freq', 'set vfo'): screenshot status bar red; 'key PTT 1 <id>' -> 'err ptt: no TX on 27.185 MHz'.

feature: A transmission that comes onto a refused frequency (band key, CAT/TCI/Panel QSY under PTT, an app slot, a CW message, the switch turned off) is stopped: 'TX stopped on 27.185 MHz', 0 W until it stops
how_to_confirm: Key at 0.1 W on 28.400 (TCI trx with a tone), then 'set freq 27185000': 't' frames read 0 W, state tx goes 0; the other radio's spectrum shows nothing at 27.185; screenshot 'TX stopped on 27.185 MHz'.

feature: Outside the bands the base is held for what it keys itself (hand mic PTT, VOX, KEY jack): PWR 0 W, VOX off, KEY Train on; first such key says '0 W on 27.185 MHz'; the hold goes before a band key/CAT QSY with the mic PTT held
how_to_confirm: Owner keys the hand mic PTT on 27.185 (dummy load, other radio watching): 't' frames 0.0 W, other radio's spectrum flat; screenshot of the message; VOX setting unchanged in Settings, back on in band.

feature: X6200: the base's own band table (calibration byte 280) is set wherever the radio refuses TX (half a second after the dial stops, at once before the WR12 IF), open elsewhere and with TX outside ham bands on; never during TX; retries and 'Base's band table not set' messages on failure
how_to_confirm: 'set freq 27185000', wait 1 s, SSH grep /mnt/base_i2c.log -> 'open TX 0: shut'; 'set freq 14074000' -> 'open TX 1: opened'; after a GUI restart 'open TX 1: open already'; no 'not shut' lines.

feature: X6200: with the CW Trainer open, outside the bands where the radio can transmit, the base's table stays open (Train sidetone via TX at 0 W); receive-only ranges are set all the same
how_to_confirm: 'open 115', 'set freq 9500000': no new 'shut' line in /mnt/base_i2c.log and a TCI-keyed answer is decoded (own 'cw' text); 'set freq 100000000': 'shut' line, the trainer's key refused (screenshot 'No TX').

feature: Birdie Cal holds the base (0 W, table set) for its whole run, until both VFOs are back where tuned
how_to_confirm: Start Birdie Cal: /mnt/base_i2c.log shows shut/open lines bracketing the run (X6200); state freq of both VFOs returns to the start; no 't' frames during it.

feature: Both transverters off by default (shift 0) on both radios; gdyuldin's saved defaults (144-150/116 MHz, 432-438/404 MHz) are taken as off
how_to_confirm: Screenshot of Settings > General > TRANSVERTERS (or params over SSH): shifts 0; 'set freq 144300000', 'key PTT 1 <id>' -> refused, no 28 MHz output.

feature: On a transverter's band the waterfall shows the band tuned (144.300), on the X6100 too (#242)
how_to_confirm: Transverter 1 shift 116 MHz, 'set freq 144300000': remote spectrum frames' centre Hz = 144300000 and bins vary; screenshot shows waterfall rows (not empty). Restore shift 0.

feature: No TX from the GUI while the base sends no data (none for 3 s or none since start): PTT/CAT NG/TCI/Panel ('no data from the base'), apps, voice messages, Winlink, CW, tuner, SWR scan, TUNE refused with 'No TX: no data from the base' / 'Baseband: Settings > Info'; the CW Trainer still sounds
how_to_confirm: Restart the GUI over SSH and before the first spectrum frame send 'key PTT 1 <id>' and rigctl 'T 1': 'err ptt: no data from the base', RPRT error; 'tune 1 <id>' -> 'err tune: no data from the base'. Mid-run data loss only in the host test tools/base_guard.
manual_ref: ### No TX without data from the base

feature: If the data stops: CW stops at its next element after 3 s, a tune or SWR scan is given up 3 s after the last data ('Tuner: no data from the base'), PTT/app slot/voice message unkey once let go; the Field Ops test beacon messages
how_to_confirm: Not provokable on a healthy radio: covered by the host test tools/base_guard; on the radio only the base log line 'ATU: Tuner: no data from the base for N ms' if it happens.
manual_ref: ### No TX without data from the base

feature: TX shift per band (Settings > General > CONTROLS > TX shift <band>, web Bands page), 0 off, up to +-10 MHz: split comes on, VFO B = A + shift in A's mode, status bar shows '-100k'
how_to_confirm: Set -100 kHz on 10 m (web Bands page or Settings), 'set freq 29620000': state split 1, txf 29520000; 'set mode FM' -> rigctl split VFO mode FM too; screenshot status bar '-100k'.

feature: VFO key on a shifted band gives REV: listen on the input (A = B - shift), transmit on the output; status bar REV; again goes back
how_to_confirm: With the shift on 29.620: 'set vfo' -> state freq 29520000, txf 29620000, screenshot 'REV'; 'set vfo' again restores.

feature: While the shift is on VFO B belongs to it: tuning A anywhere (knob, memory, band keys, CAT, TCI, apps) moves B, a frequency/mode written to B (CAT, A=B) goes back to A + shift; split off pauses the shift (kept), a shift of 0 turns split off
how_to_confirm: 'knob main 10' -> txf moves with freq; rigctl 'V VFOB', 'F 29000000' -> state txf back to freq + shift; 'key AB' -> same; 'set split 0' -> txf = freq, 'set split 1' -> freq + shift again; shift 0 -> split 0.

feature: The shift belongs to the band: tuning into a band (e.g. a web-defined '10m FM' 29.520-29.700) brings it, tuning out takes it away
how_to_confirm: Web Bands page: add '10m FM' 29.520-29.700 with -100 kHz; 'set freq 29600000' -> split 1, txf 29500000; 'set freq 28400000' -> split 0.

feature: A shift that takes B outside the bands (or below 0) turns the VFO red and PTT, apps, CW, tuner and SWR scan are refused 'No TX on ... MHz'; the web Bands page refuses a shift the hardware cannot do (6 m +5000 kHz), the Settings row takes any
how_to_confirm: Settings shift +1000 kHz on 10 m, dial 29.500: 'key PTT 1 <id>' -> 'err ptt: no TX on 30.500 MHz ...'; screenshot red VFO; HTTP POST 6 m +5000 on the Bands page -> refused.

feature: Digital apps, SWR scan, voice messages and TCI audio go out on the TX frequency (split or shift): the listen VFO moves there with split off for each TX and both come back
how_to_confirm: Radio A FT8 on 14.074 with split B = 14.080 (or a +6 kHz shift on 20 m): 'ft8 cq' at 0.5 W; radio B on 14.080 decodes the CQ at A's txf (ft8r); after the slot A's state freq 14.074, split 1. TCI tone in split lands at B + tone on the other radio's spectrum (tones.py).

feature: X6200: PTT (key, walkie, CAT, TCI, Panel) in split goes out on the TX frequency in the listen VFO's mode and the VFO comes back; the knob under PTT moves the dial not the TX; a new other-VFO frequency moves the TX
how_to_confirm: X6200 A = 14.100 USB, B = 14.150, split 1; TCI trx + 1 kHz tone at 0.5 W: the X6100's spectrum rises at 14.151, not 14.101; after unkey state freq 14.100; 'knob main 5' during PTT changes freq but the rise stays.

feature: X6200 in split: what the base keys itself (hand mic, VOX, KEY jack), the GUI's CW key (messages, CW keyboard, USB paddle) and the radio's tuner stay on the VFO you listen on; the TX panel shows that frequency
how_to_confirm: X6200 split A = 14.050 CW, B = 14.060: TCI 'cw_macros:0,TEST;' at 0.5 W -> the X6100 on 14.050 decodes TEST ('cw' text), nothing at 14.060.

feature: Winlink is simplex: no TX with a TX shift ('Winlink: no TX, a TX shift is set on this band'), in plain split with B elsewhere, or with XIT/RIT
how_to_confirm: Set a shift (or split with B elsewhere, or 'set xit 100'), start a Winlink connection from the web Winlink page: the page shows the refusal text, state tx stays 0.

feature: Transverter TX power limit (Settings > General > TRANSVERTERS > 1:/2:, Off by default or 0.1 W to the top): on a limited transverter band (dial, split's other VFO, TX shift) PWR comes down to the limit ('TX power 0.5 W: transverter 2m') whichever way it is set and goes back on leaving ('TX power back to 10.0 W', also after a restart); Off/no limit leaves PWR; a new or raised limit is followed; the lower of two VFOs' limits holds; battery 5 W stays
how_to_confirm: Transverter 1 144-148, shift 116 MHz, limit 0.5 W; 'set pwr 50', 'set freq 144300000': state pwr 5; 'set pwr 50' -> 5; TCI 'drive:0,100;' -> 5; 'set freq 14074000' -> pwr 50; split 2 m/70 cm with 0.5 and 1 W limits -> 5; screenshots of both messages.

feature: The base is held at the limit for every TX through the transverter (apps, WSPR, TUNE, TCI audio, Winlink, CW, voice messages, SWR scan); a band key or QSY during TX: the limit reaches the base first
how_to_confirm: Transverter 1 limit 0.3 W, dial 144.174 (IF 28.174), PWR 1 W: FT8 CQ and a TCI tone: 't' frames <= 0.3 W; the other radio on 28.174 decodes the CQ / sees the IF carrier.

feature: The radio's own tuner does not tune on a limited transverter band ('No tuner: 0.5 W transverter'); TUNE for an external tuner tunes at the lower of TUNE power and the limit
how_to_confirm: Dial 144.300, limit 0.5 W: ATU long press ('key ATU 1', hold 1.5 s, 'key ATU 0') -> screenshot 'No tuner: 0.5 W transverter', no 't' frames; 'tune 1 <id>' -> 't' <= 0.5 W and the other radio sees the carrier near the 28.300 IF.

feature: WSPR's beacon goes out at the transverter limit when its own Power is higher, still reporting its own Power
how_to_confirm: WSPR opened at the radio (never remotely) on a limited transverter band, Power 1 W, limit 0.2 W, TX next: 't' frames <= 0.2 W during the beacon; the other radio (WSPR opened by the owner) decodes 30 dBm.

feature: SWR Scan (APP 1:6): Run sweeps a carrier (AM X6100, FM X6200) around the TX frequency (split's other VFO) and draws SWR; Stop or closing restores VFO and mode; carrier 1 W (X6200 also when PWR is lower, X6100 less), held at 1 W while PWR changes
how_to_confirm: Owner opens SWR Scan (never opened remotely: it transmits) on 28.400 into the chain: 't' frames ~1 W (X6200 also with 'set pwr 1'; 'set pwr 50' mid-scan keeps 1 W); the other radio's spectrum shows the carrier stepping; after Stop state freq/mode as before.

feature: X6200 Sweep: Carrier (default: plain FM carrier, waits for power, 3 readings averaged, ends first then the gaps, a thin line marks the point) or Quick (the base's AM sweep, 50 points); choice kept
how_to_confirm: Owner switches Sweep and runs both: screenshot of the plot; the X6100's spectrum shows 25 vs 50 carrier steps; the choice is still there after a GUI restart.

feature: Span 50/100/200/500/1000/1500/2000/2500 kHz and Scale Log/Linear (not while scanning); 50 readings (25 with Carrier), 100 from 1000 kHz
how_to_confirm: Owner sets each span: screenshot of the axis; the other radio's wide spectrum shows the sweep width.

feature: The sweep stays inside the band of the band list for the IARU region (Region 1 40 m 7.000-7.200), moves inside near the HF/transverter/band/TX-range edges, sweeps a narrower range whole
how_to_confirm: Owner runs 2500 kHz on 40 m: the other radio's spectrum shows no carrier outside the region's 40 m; on 30 m at most 50 kHz; screenshot of the plot's frequency labels.

feature: Run refused while transmitting or tuning ('SWR scan: not while transmitting or tuning'), out of band ('No TX on ...'), without base data; the dial moved out of band mid-scan stops it as Stop does ('Scan stopped on 26.055 MHz'); data stopping mid-scan stops it ('SWR scan: no data from the base')
how_to_confirm: Owner opens it; remote sets 27.185 and the owner presses Run: screenshot 'No TX on 27.185 MHz', no 't' frames; Run during a TCI PTT: refusal message; during an owner-started scan 'set freq 26055000': state tx 0, freq/mode back to before the scan.

feature: Radio's tuner (ATU key held / 'tuner tune'): 'Tuner did not start' if the base does not key in 3 s, 'Tuner: no match' 1 s after the base returns to RX without a match; refused without data; the tune always ends back in receive (CAT/TCI stop reporting TX); base log lines
how_to_confirm: Owner holds ATU into a load (its carrier is the base's own power, not guaranteed <= 1 W for the pads): SSH grep /mnt/base_i2c.log 'ATU: Tuner:'; state tx returns 0 and a following 'tune 1 <id>' works.

feature: Browser Panel TUNE / remote 'tune 1 HOLD' lease: a steady carrier at the TUNE power on the TX frequency; 'tune 0' stops; no renewal for 3 s stops it; LOCK does not refuse it
how_to_confirm: TUNE power 0.5 W; 'tune 1 <id>' renewed each second: state tune 1, tune_s counts, 't' frames ~0.5 W, the other radio's spectrum shows the carrier; stop renewing -> 'err tune stopped: no renewal from the page', tune 0 within ~3 s; 'tune 0' stops at once; with 'set lock 1' it still tunes.

feature: 'TUNE ext. tuner on/off' on a front key's long press or a hand-mic F key (Settings > Keys); works with an app open; the same key again stops it ('TUNE stopped')
how_to_confirm: Assign it to a front key's long press (Settings > Keys), long-press via remote ('key F1 1', 1.5 s, 'key F1 0'): state tune 1 and the carrier on the other radio; again -> tune 0.

feature: Ext tune button in the apps (FT8/FT4/FT2 p5, JS8 p7, WSPR p2, SSTV p3, PSK/Olivia p6, JTTY p5) shows the TUNE power, Stop while tuning; the tone lands at the app's TX offset (FT8 14.074 + 1500 -> 14.075500), SSTV at 1900 Hz, below the dial in LSB (SSTV 7.171 LSB -> 7.169100)
how_to_confirm: 'ft8 open', 'ft8 txfreq 1500', press Ext tune (page 5 via F-keys) or 'tune 1 <id>': the other radio's spectrum peak at 14.0755 MHz, state app stays FT8; same in PSK (121) at its cursor; SSTV (112) on 7.171 LSB: peak at 7.1691 MHz.

feature: Outside the apps the carrier goes out on the TX frequency (dial, split's other VFO, TX shift) in any mode, sent as USB-D, mode back after
how_to_confirm: Split A = 28.400 CW, B = 28.450: 'tune 1 <id>' -> the other radio's peak near 28.450 not 28.400; after 'tune 0' state mode CW, split 1.

feature: TUNE power (Settings > TX Cal > EXTERNAL TUNER, 0.1 W to the top, 1.0 W default) whatever PWR is, PWR raised during the tune ignored, not held to the apps' 7 W cap
how_to_confirm: TUNE power 0.5 W, 'set pwr 80': 'tune 1 <id>' -> 't' ~0.5 W; 'set pwr 100' during the tune -> still ~0.5 W; 'set pwr 1' -> tune still ~0.5 W.

feature: TUNE time limit (Settings > TX Cal > EXTERNAL TUNER, 5-30 s, 15 default): 'TUNE over: 15 s limit'; TX panel/strip shows 'TUNE', power, SWR and '4 / 15 s' even with the TX popup off
how_to_confirm: Limit 5 s; 'tune 1 <id>' renewed: state tune_s counts to 5 and tune goes 0; screenshot 'TUNE over: 5 s limit' and the '3 / 5 s' panel.

feature: TUNE stops at once on a frequency/band/TX-shift change ('TUNE stopped: tuned away'), mode change ('mode changed'), VFO or split change ('VFO changed')
how_to_confirm: During a tune: 'set freq 28401000' -> state tune 0; again with 'set mode', 'set vfo', 'set split'; screenshot each message.

feature: Above 1 W TUNE switches the radio's ATU off first ('TUNE 5.0 W, 15 s, ATU off') and it stays off; the ATU key during such a tune stops it ('TUNE stopped: ATU on'); at <= 1 W the ATU is left alone
how_to_confirm: Needs a TUNE power over the chain's 1 W: owner with a dummy load: state atu 1 -> 0 at the start and stays 0; 'set atu 1' mid-tune -> tune 0. The <= 1 W half (state atu unchanged at 1.0 W) can run on the cable.

feature: After TUNE the frequency, mode, VFOs, split, PWR, the app and its TX offset and the band memories are as before; only the ATU-off (above 1 W) is written; the apps' TX level untouched
how_to_confirm: Snapshot state (freq, mode, split, pwr, txf) and ft8 txf; 3 s tune; after 'tune 0' all equal; GUI log has no 'tx_player: level' line from it.
