feature: During TUNE the SWR protection stands aside only for readings up to twice the TUNE power + 0.2 W and until the time limit + 1 s; everything else keeps it; the X6100's base cuts power from SWR ~2.5
how_to_confirm: Needs a mismatched load: owner tunes into an unmatched antenna/load: 't' SWR high while TUNE continues; a PTT into the same load stops with 'TX stopped: SWR ...'.

feature: TUNE refused where TX is refused: 'No tune on 27.185 MHz' + 'Out of band'/'Receive only there'; without base data 'No tune: no data from the base'; the Panel gives the same reason
how_to_confirm: 'set freq 27185000', 'tune 1 <id>' -> 'err tune: no TX on 27.185 MHz: outside the amateur bands ...'; state tune 0; screenshot.

feature: 'No tune: on the air' while PTT, an app slot, TCI, Winlink, the ATU or the SWR scan transmit; 'No tune: Winlink in session'; an app slot due during a tune is not sent
how_to_confirm: TCI trx at 0.5 W, then 'tune 1 <id>' -> 'err tune: on the air'; FT8 with CQ armed, tune just before the slot: ft8 sending stays false and the other radio decodes nothing that slot.

feature: From the Panel TUNE is refused for a browser that only watches, a session without TX and control held elsewhere
how_to_confirm: Unpaired WebSocket 'tune 1 1' -> 'err view only: pair this browser to operate'; a session without TX -> 'err this session may not transmit'; control held by TCI -> 'err controlled by ...'.

feature: The apps' audio level sets itself: settles with ALC ~1 and power at the setting, nothing in the first second, up slowly while ALC < 1, down when ALC > 3 or power well over; silence ignored; kept for the next TX (not from WSPR); a log line per change and one at start
how_to_confirm: FT8 CQs at 0.5 W over 4 slots on the X6100: 't' power ~0.5 W, ALC ~1; SSH grep the GUI log for 'tx_player: level ... windows decided' lines and the start line (base version, Line-in, Line-out, level kept).

feature: X6200: ALC ignored, the level rises until power reaches the setting and stays; waits while the power comes up; steps that bring no power go back; never clipped; every X6200 once restarted from the default 0 dB
how_to_confirm: X6200 FT8 CQs at 0.5 W for 6 slots: 't' power converges to 0.5 W; GUI log levels do not creep up between TXs and stay far under clipping.

feature: A TX reading 0 W from first second to end says 'TX 0 W: level -38 dB, Line-in 10' and logs level/Line-in/ALC/power; the X6200's level goes back to default; Line-in 0 is a known cause
how_to_confirm: 'set linein 0', 'set pwr 5', one FT8 CQ: 't' 0.0 W; screenshot of the message; GUI log line; restore linein.

feature: Apps transmit in LSB-D/USB-D (compressor out of the way) and return to LSB/USB; SSTV LSB below 10 MHz/USB above, WeFax USB, RTTY LSB or USB
how_to_confirm: SSTV CALL CQ on 7.171 LSB at 0.5 W: rigctl 'm' during TX -> PKTLSB, after -> LSB; 't' power near 0.5 W (not a fraction as in #224).

feature: With AF volume 0 or the speaker muted (mute action, BT headphones Mute speaker, a TCI client transmitting) the TX monitor does not play the digital tones
how_to_confirm: Owner listens during an FT8 TX with 'set vol 0' / muted: silent speaker; state 'muted'/'moni' as a hint.

feature: While a digital app is open power is capped at 7 W ('Power is limited to 7W'); the setting comes back on close; TUNE in the app not held to it
how_to_confirm: 'set pwr 80', 'open 101': state pwr 70, screenshot of the message; 'close': pwr 80.

feature: The apps' Power button steps 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 5, 7 W (WSPR's is its own)
how_to_confirm: FT8 open, press Power (page 2) via the F-keys repeatedly: state pwr 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 30, 50, 70.

feature: Digital apps reopen on their last frequency and mode
how_to_confirm: 'open 101', 'key BAND_UP' (next FT8 dial), 'close', 'open 101': state freq/mode as left.

feature: In CW/CW-R the ALC bar of the TX panel and S-meter box is grey; readings ~5 on a load are normal
how_to_confirm: TCI 'cw_macros:0,TEST;' at 0.5 W: screenshot of the grey ALC bar; 't' frames carry the ALC reading.

feature: Voice messages (MSG > Voice Rec, Field Ops Rec CQ) record only from the hand mic; without it 'No audio: recording uses the hand mic' after 3 s; the recording keeps 250-3000 Hz
how_to_confirm: Owner records with the hand mic: a new /mnt/msg/<name>.mp3 (SSH) whose spectrum has nothing under 250 Hz or over 3 kHz; with the mic unplugged, screenshot of the message.

feature: A voice message plays on the air (MSG > Voice), on the TX frequency in split/shift, refused out of band and without base data
how_to_confirm: Copy a test MP3 to /mnt/msg over SSH, play it from MSG > Voice at 0.5 W on 28.400 USB: 't' frames, the other radio's TCI RX audio carries it; on 27.185 refused (screenshot).

feature: X6200 reads its own PA bias from the base calibration block at each start and sends it (3360/3820 fallback when out of range or unreadable); Settings > Info > FIRMWARE > PA bias
how_to_confirm: After a GUI restart SSH grep /mnt/base_i2c.log 'PA bias': 'this radio's own' or 'own or an older version' with drive 3024-3696 / final 3438-4095; screenshot of Settings > Info.

feature: X6200 sets base register 32 = 0x0a at each start, as Xiegu's firmware
how_to_confirm: After a GUI restart SSH grep the GUI log (app_logs) for 'base: register 32 = 0x0a, as Xiegu's firmware'.

feature: APP 1 > Modes menu: RTTY, PSK31, PSK63, FT8, FT4, FT2, WSPR, Olivia, JTTY, JS8, SSTV, WeFax, NavTex, RADE; MFK chooses, press opens, last used marked; Modes again closes
how_to_confirm: 'open 114': state win names the Modes menu, screenshot lists the items; 'knob mfk 1' + 'key MFK 1/0' opens one (state app); 'open 114' twice closes it.

feature: The squelch opens while a decoder app is open ('Squelch 4 opened for WeFax'); yours comes back on close unless changed; kept through a restart with the app open
how_to_confirm: 'set sql 4', 'wefax open': state sql 0 + screenshot message; 'wefax close': sql 4; with WeFax open restart the GUI over SSH: back with sql 0, close -> 4.

feature: APP > Modes > FT8/FT4/FT2 tunes that mode's frequency; the band keys step through the others
how_to_confirm: 'ft8 open': state app FT8, freq 14.074000 USB-D (or the nearest band's); 'key BAND_UP 1/0' -> the next FT8 dial.

feature: Mode (page 1) cycles FT8 > FT4 > FT2; a Mode change ends a CQ
how_to_confirm: 'ft8 mode' three times: ft8 state proto FT8 -> FT4 -> FT2 -> FT8, state freq 14.080 (FT4), 14.084 (FT2).

feature: Show: CQ (CQs and messages to you) or All (all traffic)
how_to_confirm: While the other radio works a third call (TCI-sent FT8 audio or a QSO to another call), screenshot the list under Show: CQ and Show: All; the non-CQ rows appear only in All.

feature: TX CQ calls CQ; a band key, Freq or Mode turns it off ('CQ off: press TX CQ to call on this frequency'); a reply, yours or Auto's, takes its place
how_to_confirm: radios-ft8: A 'ft8 cq' at 0.5 W, B's ft8r rows 'CQ Q1TST EN80'; A 'key BAND_UP' -> ft8 state cq false and screenshot of the message.

feature: TX Call allows or stops transmitting; stopping cuts a transmission in progress
how_to_confirm: During A's CQ slot 'ft8 stop': state tx 0 within a second, ft8 sending false; B decodes nothing that slot.

feature: FT8/FT4 TX starts 0.5 s into its slot; a late start (<= 1.5 s FT8, 1.0 s FT4) leaves out the past part; more than a fifth late -> 'TX not sent: too late into the slot', sent next slot with its retry unused
how_to_confirm: B's ft8r DT for A's CQ ~0.0-0.3 s; 'ft8 cq' at 1.0 s into a slot: still decoded that slot; at 3 s: screenshot of the message and B decodes it one slot later.

feature: Your grid in a CQ, answer or Hound call is the QTH's 4-character square in capitals; a 2-character QTH sends none
how_to_confirm: A's QTH en80kc: B's ft8r 'CQ Q1TST EN80'; with QTH 'EN': 'CQ Q1TST'.

feature: Hold Freq: your TX offset does not move to the station you answer
how_to_confirm: B 'ft8 hold' (ft8 state hold true), 'ft8 txfreq 2000', 'ft8 reply <id>' on A's CQ at 1500: B's txf stays 2000 and A's ft8r shows B's reply near 2000 Hz; without Hold B's txf -> 1500.

feature: Auto: the next QSO message goes by itself, callers are answered also while calling CQ, never a CQ of its own; after RR73/73 the next caller at once; a station that missed RR73 gets it again
how_to_confirm: radios-ft8 with both 'ft8 auto': the QSO completes with no further command, ft8 state logged on both, one record each in /mnt/ft_log.adi; A does not CQ again by itself afterwards.

feature: With Auto, when several stations call in the same slot a POTA activator is answered first
how_to_confirm: Needs two or more callers in one slot, one of them spotted on POTA: owner with off-air stations (one cable partner can't make two callers).

feature: Auto disabled: nothing moves on by itself; each next message needs a press on the station's row; the queued message repeats up to its Retries
how_to_confirm: B auto off replies to A's CQ: A's ft8r shows B's same message every B slot until 'ft8 reply <id>' on A's answer row moves B to the report.

feature: Retries (page 4) 3/4/5/6/8/10/12/15, 6 by default: an unanswered message goes out that many times before the QSO is dropped
how_to_confirm: A sends one CQ then 'ft8 stop'; B replies with Retries 6: A's ft8r counts six B replies, then B's ft8 state qso empties.

feature: Time Sync (page 3): pressed at a slot start the clock moves to the nearest slot start (15/7.5/3.75 s) and into the clock chip; a clock NTP or GPS keeps is left alone ('Clock in sync', 'The GPS keeps the clock')
how_to_confirm: With NTP synced press Time Sync (F-keys): screenshot 'Clock in sync', SSH date still matches the test computer. With ntpd stopped and 'date -s' 3 s off over SSH, press at a slot start: offset < 0.5 s; restart ntpd.

feature: The processor clock and the clock chip are kept together; the chip's drift rate is learnt from network time after a power-off (/mnt/rtc-drift.json) and taken out at every start; read and written on the second boundary
how_to_confirm: SSH 'x6100-rtc status' and cat /mnt/rtc-drift.json: a learnt rate; 'hwclock -r' vs 'date' within ~0.1 s.

feature: Auto Sync (page 5, off by default): FT8/FT4 clock moved by the median DT of >= 5 agreeing stations in >= 3 slots within 4 min (>= 0.2 s, mid-slot, into the chip); 'too far' message beyond ~2 s; NTP/GPS clock left alone; a log line a minute
how_to_confirm: Needs five or more stations off the air (the cable partner is one vote): owner with an antenna. On the bench only: switch it on, screenshot, and with NTP the GUI log line 'ft8: Auto Time Sync' says the clock is kept by NTP.

feature: CQ Modifier (page 3): e.g. CQ POTA, CQ DX
how_to_confirm: A sets POTA, 'ft8 cq': B's ft8r 'CQ POTA Q1TST EN80'.

feature: List rows show slot time, message, country and flag (cty.dat), distance (sender's grid + your QTH) and SNR; Settings > Display > INTERFACE > FT8/FT4 info: km, mi, Country, Country + km (default), Country + mi; 'Saved QSO' and the Panel list use the same unit
how_to_confirm: B decodes A's CQ: ft8r carries the SNR; screenshot of the right column for each setting.

feature: Row colours: CQ green, worked on another band/mode dark green, worked here darker and struck through, to you red, your TX blue
how_to_confirm: After one logged QSO on 20 m: screenshot of B's list with A's next CQ struck through; on 15 m dark green; A's calls to B red.

feature: POTA tag after the message for a station spotted on POTA now (cluster's pota.app spots) and any CQ POTA
how_to_confirm: A 'CQ POTA': screenshot of B's row with the POTA tag.

feature: Reply: MFK press or touch on a row answers that station, moves your TX offset there (unless Hold Freq), turns TX Call on; a press while transmitting stops TX; a row without a call -> 'No call to answer in that message'
how_to_confirm: B 'ft8 reply <id>' (id from ft8r) on A's CQ: ft8 state qso Q1TST, txf = A's offset, A's ft8r shows 'Q1TST Q2TST EN80'; reply on a free-text row -> screenshot of the message, no TX.

feature: 'For you' strip: up to 3 stations calling you pinned under the list, 2 min after their last message, gone after your RR73/73, cleared on band/mode change; MFK enters it; For you (page 4) turns it off
how_to_confirm: A calls B with B not answering: screenshot of B's strip with A's row; 'ft8 mode' clears it; For you off -> no strip, the row only in the list in red.

feature: A QSO is logged once both reports are known (R+report, RR73, RRR or 73), once only: 'Saved QSO de ...', /mnt/ft_log.adi and the day's log (ADIF, time to the second, band '20m', frequency to the Hz); into an activation's log while Field Ops runs one
how_to_confirm: After radios-ft8, SSH tail /mnt/ft_log.adi on both: one record each with CALL, TIME_ON hhmmss, BAND 20m, FREQ to 6 decimals; ft8 state logged; web Logs page lists it; a repeated RR73 adds nothing.

feature: Moving on (another reply, TX CQ, Hound toggle, retries out) keeps a QSO whose report went out aside for 4 slots (up to 4): its late RR73/RRR/73 or R+report still logs it; with nothing in progress a late R+report resumes it and Auto sends RR73; band/Freq/Mode drops them; Hound answers none
how_to_confirm: A answers B's CQ; after B sends the report, B 'ft8 cq'; A's R-report then logs the QSO in B's ft_log.adi and B's Auto RR73 shows in A's ft8r.

feature: Force QSO save (page 2) logs the QSO in progress once both reports are known; the sequence goes on
how_to_confirm: Mid-QSO after both reports press the button (F-keys page 2): ft_log.adi has the record before the RR73; no second record when the RR73 comes.

feature: Calls WSJT-X's chkcall calls nonstandard (Q-prefixed test calls, 3X, 3DA0) go as nonstandard and WSJT-X decodes them (ft8lib patch 0002)
how_to_confirm: A (Q1TST) 'ft8 cq': B's ft8r shows it; record B's TCI RX audio for the slot and decode with WSJT-X's jt9: the message decodes there too.

feature: Compound or long own callsign (up to 11 chars): 'Callsign is long, QTH will be omitted'; CQ 'CQ PA/X' without QTH or modifier ('Next TX: ...'); hashes in reports; a call that does not fit -> 'No CQ: callsign ... does not fit FT8'; calls shown <...> are red, not answered or logged until heard in full
how_to_confirm: Set A's callsign 'Q1TST/6Y': 'ft8 cq' -> B's ft8r 'CQ Q1TST/6Y'; a full QSO with Auto logs on both; a 12-character call -> screenshot 'No CQ: ...', ft8 cq false.

feature: Log Map (page 3): logged stations on a world map centred on you with great-circle paths; ESC or Log Map closes
how_to_confirm: Press Log Map (F-keys): screenshot; press again: closed.

feature: Live Map (page 3): stations decoded with a grid in the last 15 min, coloured by distance, last minute bigger/ringed; band change empties; a snapshot
how_to_confirm: After B decodes A's CQ, B's Live Map: screenshot with A's call (green, centre square); 'key BAND_UP' then reopen: empty.

feature: PSK Reporter (Settings > Cluster > PSK REPORTER > Report decodes, on by default): FT8/FT4/FT2/JS8/JTTY decodes, and PSK/Olivia/Contestia 'DE <call>', sent by UDP to report.pskreporter.info:4739 about every 5 min, each call once per band per 5 min, 4-char locator, 'GoldCorpHF v0.x.y'; own TX never; no network drops quietly
how_to_confirm: After B decodes A over the cable, SSH 'tcpdump -n udp port 4739' on B sees a packet within ~5.5 min; pskreporter.info lists the spot for B's call; switched off: no packet.
'ft8 mode' to FT2: state freq 14.084; 'key BAND_UP' -> 18.108, etc.

feature: FT2: 3.75 s slots, TX only in the first 0.8 s of its slot, 'RX' line every 4th slot, QSOs logged ADIF MFSK / FT2
how_to_confirm: Both in FT2 with Auto: A CQ, B decodes (ft8r) and completes; ft_log.adi MODE MFSK SUBMODE FT2.

feature: FT4 (7.5 s slots) send, decode and log
how_to_confirm: Both in FT4 with Auto: A CQ, B answers, QSO logged; ft_log.adi MODE MFSK SUBMODE FT4.

feature: The main knob moves your TX audio offset; turned fast (4+ clicks in 30 ms) 5 or 10 Hz a click
how_to_confirm: 'knob main 1' -> ft8 state txf +1; 'knob main 10' in one burst -> +50 to +100.

feature: WSJT-X UDP while the app is open: heartbeat, status, decodes, logged QSOs, to /mnt/ft8_udp.conf (enabled, host, port 2237, id; default gateway + multicast)
how_to_confirm: Set host= the test computer in /mnt/ft8_udp.conf over SSH, 'ft8 open': a UDP listener on 2237 gets Heartbeat (type 0) and Status (type 1) with the dial; Decode (type 2) once the other radio sends over the cable.

feature: QSOs logged anywhere else (QSO log, Field Ops, phone/browser Log tab, CW line, JS8) go out as 'QSO Logged' and 'Logged ADIF', also with the FT8 app closed; enabled=0 turns it all off
how_to_confirm: With FT8 closed, remote 'log Q9TST|599|599|TEST': the listener gets types 5 and 12 for Q9TST; with enabled=0 nothing.

feature: Freq (page 4): the mode's preset list per band; hold for a typed dial in kHz or MHz (1800-54000 kHz) -> USB-D, rows 'RX FT8 Custom 14.091', the button shows it, kept; empty entry/band key/Mode back to presets; the remote's 'base' reports it
how_to_confirm: Pick a preset (F-keys + MFK): state freq; type 14091 on the on-screen keys via MFK: state freq 14.091000 USB-D, ft8 state base 14091000; 'key BAND_UP' -> preset.

feature: Hound (FT8 only, page 4): calls the Fox in the second period with offset 1000-3000 Hz, stops after 2 min; answers its report with R-xx (Fox offset then +300 Hz), stops after 11 periods; the Fox's RR73 logs and stops; TX CQ/Hold do nothing; off at each open; compound calls only as a hash
how_to_confirm: A plays the Fox: CQ Q1FOX, then a ft8code-made multi-stream message sent as TCI TX audio at 0.5 W; B Hound On replies: A's ft8r shows B's 'Q1FOX Q2TST EN80' at :15/:45 with offset >= 1000; after the Fox RR73 B's ft_log.adi has the QSO and TX stops.

feature: Multi-stream (Fox) messages decode in any FT8 session; the Fox's call shows <...> until its CQ is heard
how_to_confirm: A sends a ft8code multi-stream message as TCI TX audio at 0.5 W: B's ft8r rows show both parts.

feature: APP > Modes > JS8 tunes the nearest JS8 frequency (band keys step the list); RX filter 200-3000 Hz, NR/NB/notch off, 7 W cap, all back on leaving
how_to_confirm: 'open 111': state freq 14.078 USB-D, flo 200, fhi 3000, nr 0, nb 0; 'key BAND_UP' -> next JS8 dial; 'close': previous values.

feature: JS8 will not send without a callsign
how_to_confirm: Clear the callsign (Settings > General > STATION), press CQ: screenshot of the refusal, state tx 0; restore the callsign.

feature: AUTO, HB and HB ACK are off every time the app opens; nothing sends by itself
how_to_confirm: Turn AUTO on, close, reopen: screenshot page 4 AUTO off; state tx 0 over 2 min.

feature: CQ (hold: auto CQ)
how_to_confirm: A CQ (page 1 F-key) at 0.5 W: screenshot of B's list with A's CQ in green (or record B's TCI audio and decode with a JS8 decoder); hold CQ -> repeats.

feature: Heartbeat button; HB (periodic heartbeats) and HB ACK (answer heartbeats) on page 4
how_to_confirm: A Heartbeat: B's list shows A's @HB with EN80; B with AUTO + HB ACK answers (state tx 1 once on B, A's list shows the ack).

feature: One-press directed messages (SNR?, GRID?, INFO?, STATUS?, HEARING?, AGN?, RR, 73) via Query > and HW CPY?; AUTO answers queries as desktop JS8Call
how_to_confirm: A selects B's row (MFK) and sends SNR?; B with AUTO on answers: A's list shows B's reply in red (screenshot); B's state tx toggles.

feature: Reply and Send... message box; closes unsent with Send.../Reply again, ESC or the on-screen close key; with a keyboard Enter sends (#280)
how_to_confirm: A Send..., type 'Q2TST HELLO' on the on-screen keys via MFK, OK: B's list shows it in red; Send... twice: box closes, no TX.

feature: Show: No HB / Directed / All, Show Stations / Messages, Clear
how_to_confirm: After A's heartbeats and directed messages: screenshot of B's list under each choice; Clear empties it.

feature: Inbox for MSG messages (store-and-forward like JS8Call)
how_to_confirm: A sends 'Q2TST MSG TEST': B's Inbox (page 3) lists it (screenshot).

feature: Relays and store-and-forward through another station (not yet proven on the air)
how_to_confirm: Needs a third JS8 station: owner with an off-air station.

feature: Settings... (page 4): INFO, STATUS, Relay, Groups
how_to_confirm: Edit INFO on the on-screen keys, restart the GUI: screenshot shows it kept; an INFO? from the other radio returns it (cable).

feature: APRS > through JS8 gateways: grid/GPS position beacons (with a message), POTA/SOTA spots, SMS, email, Winlink
how_to_confirm: Needs an on-air JS8 APRS gateway: owner with an antenna; over the cable only the outgoing frame: B decodes A's '@APRSIS GRID ...'.

feature: Log QSO (page 5) and the log popup at 73/SK save to js8call_log.adi (desktop JS8Call ADIF), with Activ.: Off/POTA/SOTA fields and the Log prompt switch
how_to_confirm: After a directed exchange ending in 73: popup on A (screenshot), OK -> SSH tail /mnt/js8call_log.adi with CALL Q2TST, MODE MFSK SUBMODE JS8; with Activ. POTA a MY_POTA_REF field.

feature: Alerts >: beeps for messages, CQs and new stations; purple alert words
how_to_confirm: Alert word 'TESTWORD' on B, A sends it: B's row purple (screenshot); the beep needs the owner's ear.

feature: Speed (Normal/Fast/Turbo/Slow); Decode: All speeds (all four at once) / My speed
how_to_confirm: A at Turbo, B at Normal with All speeds: B's list shows A's message; with My speed it does not.

feature: Freq (page 6): JS8 list / GhostNet list / typed kHz
how_to_confirm: Choose GhostNet: state freq 7.107; type 14080: state freq 14.080.

feature: Map (page 7): JS8 log stations on the FT8 map
how_to_confirm: Screenshot of the map after a logged JS8 QSO.

feature: Main knob moves the TX offset (1 Hz slow, 5/10 Hz fast); while it turns the list fades to show the TX band, back 2.5 s after (#159); Hold: Off/On (page 3)
how_to_confirm: 'knob main 3': screenshot shows the faded list and TX band; 3 s later the list is back.

feature: ESC or the top knob stops sending; the next ESC leaves the app
how_to_confirm: During A's long message the remote 'close' (ESC): state tx 0 at once, app still open; again: state app empty.

feature: @X6100 group by default: messages to it red (also under No HB/Directed), X6100 tag in Show Stations, MSG to it in the Inbox; the radio never transmits to the group by itself; leaving via Groups lasts over restart/update
how_to_confirm: A sends '@X6100 HELLO': B's row red (screenshot), B with AUTO on stays tx 0; delete @X6100 in B's Groups, restart the GUI: 'No groups' still.

feature: Time Sync (page 3) shifts JS8's own timing from the decodes (drift on the top line); hold resets it
how_to_confirm: B's clock set 1 s off over SSH with NTP stopped, A sends: B's Time Sync -> drift ~1 s on the top line (screenshot); hold -> 0; restore NTP.

feature: 'GhostNet mode: 7.107 + its groups' tunes 7.107 (band keys 3.575/7.107/14.107) and adds @GHOSTNET, @GSTFLASH and the regional group once; a 'GhostNet groups: ...' row
how_to_confirm: Choose it from Freq (page 6): state freq 7.107000; Groups shows the three (screenshot); 'key BAND_UP' -> 14.107.

feature: With AUTO on, JS8 answers queries sent to your groups (SNR?, GRID? ...)
how_to_confirm: A sends '@GHOSTNET SNR?' on 7.107; B in GhostNet with AUTO on replies (state tx on B, A's list shows it).

feature: Reminder N min (10 default) before the chosen nets, over any screen, never during TX (comes after); the first press picks the IARU region's weekly net
how_to_confirm: Web GhostNet page: own net 12 min ahead, reminder on 10 min: at T-10 a screenshot shows the reminder in the message box.

feature: Popup list of the next 7 days' net windows (UTC, local time in brackets when the zone isn't UTC); a press chooses a net (green, *); VARA/ALE/voice windows not listed
how_to_confirm: Open the popup: screenshot; press a row: /mnt/ghostnet.conf over SSH shows it chosen.

feature: 'RTTY 7.077 MHz, 45.45 baud' closes JS8 and opens RTTY on 7.077 USB, 45.45 Bd, shift 170, reverse off for this time only; RTTY's own rate/shift/reverse and the previous frequency come back on close
how_to_confirm: Press it: state freq 7.077000 USB; screenshot of RTTY's rate/shift; close: RTTY params back (e.g. 50/450), state freq as before.

feature: @GSTFLASH: a message to it (or containing it) shows red in the message box for 20 s ('EMERGENCY @GSTFLASH: ...'), three beeps with Alerts > Beep, row marked; nothing run or answered
how_to_confirm: A sends '@GSTFLASH TEST': screenshot of B's red message; B stays tx 0.

feature: Regional group @GN + country code + department (web GhostNet page), a typed group before the generated one; without either only @GHOSTNET and @GSTFLASH
how_to_confirm: Set department 01 on the web page: Groups shows @GN<country>01 (screenshot / ghostnet.conf); a typed @GNTEST1 wins.

feature: Own net (web page): name, weekday and time in the radio's zone, length, frequency, mode; listed in the popup and reminded
how_to_confirm: Set it on the web page: the popup list and the page's list show it (screenshot, HTTP).

feature: Web Operating > GhostNet: nets with UTC and local time, reminder, own net, groups, translation switches, messages (@GSTFLASH red card), stations heard; a saved change reaches the radio within seconds also with JS8 open
how_to_confirm: HTTP GET the page; POST a reminder change: the radio's popup shows it within seconds (screenshot); /mnt/ghostnet.conf updated.

feature: /mnt/ghostnet_log.txt keeps messages to GhostNet's groups or on its frequencies and those you sent, rotated at 256 KB; no heartbeats or SNR reports
how_to_confirm: A sends '@GHOSTNET TEST' on 7.107: SSH tail on B shows it; the web page's Messages lists it.

feature: /mnt/ghostnet_nets.txt is read instead of the built-in schedule (GhostNet 1.5)
how_to_confirm: Copy a modified schedule over SSH: the popup and web page list the changed net.

feature: Translate (page 7) via MyMemory into the GUI's language (from English or Spanish): a 'NL: ...' line under the message; callsigns/locators/groups masked; 300 texts cached; quota and 'No answer from MyMemory' messages
how_to_confirm: GUI language Dutch, translate A's English message (cable): screenshot shows 'NL: ...'; with the network down: 'No answer from MyMemory'.

feature: Translate arriving messages (GhostNet popup, off by default): each English/Spanish message translated the same way
how_to_confirm: Switch on, A sends English text: B shows the translation line (screenshot).

feature: Mine into English first (off by default): the first OK puts your text into English in JS8's letters, the second OK sends; callsigns/groups at the front kept; 'English already'
how_to_confirm: GUI in Spanish, type Spanish text, OK: screenshot shows English text; OK again: B decodes the English text.

feature: APP > Modes > WSPR tunes the nearest WSPR dial (USB-D, WSJT-X's list), band keys step; always opens with TX % 0 (also after a power-off)
how_to_confirm: Owner opens WSPR (never remotely): state freq 14.095600 USB-D, screenshot TX % 0, state tx 0 for 4 min.

feature: Every RX cycle decoded at 1:54: table with UTC, band, SNR, DT, audio Hz, drift, call, grid, dBm, km; band of the cycle heard
how_to_confirm: Owner opens WSPR on B; A sends a WSPR signal (wsprcode audio over TCI at 0.2 W, or A's own beacon): B's table shows Q1TST EN80 23 (screenshot).

feature: TX % (0/10/20/33/50, random cycles) and TX next (one beacon next cycle, again cancels; TX % 0 cancels a chosen one); without callsign or locator it says which and stays off; compound calls can't be sent
how_to_confirm: Owner presses TX next at 0.2 W into the chain: 't' frames at the next even minute for ~110 s; the other radio's spectrum shows a narrow signal near 1500 Hz.

feature: Stop TX (the TX next button while a beacon is on) takes it off at once, TX % 0, TX next off; closing WSPR (ESC) also stops and sets TX % 0
how_to_confirm: During an owner-started beacon the remote 'close': state tx 0 at once; reopened: TX % 0.

feature: WSPR's own Power (page 2): 0.1/0.2/0.5/1/2/5 W, 0.2 W default; the radio's PWR is not changed (beacon at WSPR's power, back after)
how_to_confirm: Owner sets 0.5 W with 'set pwr 30': 't' ~0.5 W during the beacon, state pwr 30 before and after.

feature: Main knob moves the TX audio offset (1410-1590 Hz)
how_to_confirm: WSPR opened by the owner: 'knob main 50' then screenshot shows the offset clamped at 1590.

feature: Each cycle's spots uploaded to WSPRnet (plain HTTP over WiFi) with that cycle's dial; status line counts sent and failed
how_to_confirm: WSPR opened at the radio (never remotely) with a decodable signal: SSH tcpdump to wsprnet.org port 80 after the cycle; status line count +1 (screenshot); the spot on wsprnet.org.

feature: Band hopping (page 2 F5 / page 3 F4): WSJT-X's coordinated schedule by minute (:00 160m ... :18 10m), Off slots shared in turn (6 m takes Off slots), changes only between cycles, header 'Hop' / 'Hop, RX only'
how_to_confirm: Owner turns Hop on with bands RX: the remote watches state freq follow the minute table at each even minute.

feature: Page 3 band table: F2 Band, F3 Use Off/RX/RX+TX, F4 Hop, F5 Go to; columns frequency, use, slots, ATU match Stored/None
how_to_confirm: Owner opens page 3: screenshot; F5 Go to -> state freq to that band's WSPR dial.

feature: Web Digital modes page sets Hop and each band's use; bands without a WSPR frequency skipped; 60 m with two uses the one nearest WSJT-X's
how_to_confirm: HTTP: set Hop on and 40m RX+TX on the Digital modes page, read the page back.

feature: With the ATU on, an RX+TX band transmits on its hop only when an ATU match is stored for its WSPR frequency ('40m: no ATU match stored, RX only')
how_to_confirm: Owner: ATU on, 40m RX+TX without a stored match, Hop on: at its slot the message shows and state tx stays 0.

feature: NavTex app: Freq. list (NAVTEX 518/490, NAVTEX HF 4209.5, HF MSI), header state, MFK scrolls the text, Mode: NAVTEX / DSC with the DSC Freq. list (2187.5 ... 16804.5 kHz); the VFO is given back on leaving
how_to_confirm: 'open 110': state app NavTex, freq 518000; Freq. 490: freq 490000; Mode DSC, Freq. 2187.5: freq 2187500; 'close': the previous freq.

feature: NAVTEX (SITOR-B) text decoding
how_to_confirm: NAVTEX frequencies aren't amateur (no cable TX) and there is no antenna: owner with an MF/HF antenna; screenshot of decoded text.

feature: DSC receive: one row per call (time, category, MMSI + country, nature/called MMSI, proposed mode/frequency), distress in red with position, '?' failed check; Save (page 2) to the Files page
how_to_confirm: Off the air only (not amateur frequencies): owner with an antenna; Save then the web Files page lists the file.

feature: WeFax Freq.: DWD, Northwood, Athens and NOAA stations, then your channels named WEFAX* (rest of the name shown, app listens 1.5 kHz above the channel's dial), no duplicates
how_to_confirm: Web Memories page: add 'WEFAX TEST' at 14.0985; 'wefax open': screenshot of Freq. with TEST; choosing it: state freq 14.098500 USB.

feature: Opens in RX Auto (waits for the start tone) or Cont; the fax is saved at the stop tone (/mnt/wefax PNG) and the screen clears
how_to_confirm: A sends a WeFax test audio (start tone, phasing, 120 LPM IOC 576, stop tone) as TCI TX audio at 0.5 W on 14.100 USB; B on a WEFAX channel 1.5 kHz below: after the stop tone a new PNG in /mnt/wefax (SSH ls) and in the web gallery; 'wefax cont' draws without a start tone.

feature: View (page 2): Big (default), Full (the whole fax), Small (the old low panel with the main waterfall)
how_to_confirm: Press View (F-keys): screenshot of each.

feature: The fax on screen and in the Fax Browser is drawn inverted in the theme's colours; PNGs and the web gallery stay black on white
how_to_confirm: After a received fax: screenshot (dark paper) vs the PNG from /mnt/wefax (white paper).

feature: Align, Tilt (page 2), Fix Align, Fix Tilt, Done (page 3)
how_to_confirm: A sends a fax at a slightly wrong line rate (skewed); B: Fix Tilt via F-keys, screenshots before/after; the saved PNG straight.

feature: Save (page 2) and Clear (page 1); remote 'wefax save|clear'
how_to_confirm: Mid-fax 'wefax save': a new PNG in /mnt/wefax; 'wefax clear': screenshot blank.

feature: Fax Browser (page 3) shows the saved faxes
how_to_confirm: With PNGs in /mnt/wefax (copied over SSH): open the browser, screenshot.

feature: Power (page 4) button in WeFax
how_to_confirm: Press Power (F-keys page 4): state pwr steps as the apps' Power button.

feature: The VOL knob works as on the main screen in WeFax: turning changes the control it is on, a press switches the control (#226)
how_to_confirm: 'wefax open', 'knob vol 2': state vol +2; 'key VOL 1/0', 'knob vol 1': another state value (sql/rfg) changes.

feature: SSTV calling frequencies: LSB on 80/40 m (3.735, 3.845, 7.165, 7.171), USB above (14.230 ... 50.510); picture left, decoder state right, progress bar
how_to_confirm: 'open 112': state freq 14.230000 USB; Freq. 7.171: LSB.

feature: Start Auto RX: VIS-triggered decoding (1KO125 beta8, tolerant VIS), pictures saved in /mnt/sstv
how_to_confirm: A CALL CQ in Martin M1 at 0.5 W on 14.230; B in Auto RX: a new /mnt/sstv/sstv-*.png (SSH ls), screenshot.

feature: Start Manual RX with the chosen RX Mode
how_to_confirm: B Manual RX in Robot 36 started just before A's Robot 36 TX: a picture saved.

feature: Auto RX Restart (page 2): a new VIS during a picture starts a new one
how_to_confirm: A halts mid-picture and sends a new CQ: B starts the second picture (two files or the progress restart in screenshots).

feature: Denoise (3:3, on by default): saves the raw picture and a cleaned _dn.png, screen shows the clean one; off saves only the original
how_to_confirm: After a received picture: SSH ls shows sstv-*.png and sstv-*_dn.png; Denoise off: only one file.

feature: RX Pics Browser and Delete picture (page 2); the web Gallery lists both files, _dn first, and deletes either
how_to_confirm: With pictures present: screenshot of the browser; Delete one -> SSH ls; HTTP Gallery list.

feature: TX menu CALL CQ: a picture with CQ CQ SSTV and your callsign
how_to_confirm: A TX > CALL CQ at 0.5 W on 14.230: state tx 1 for the picture; B saves a picture showing the callsign (PNG viewed).

feature: REPLY TO / REPLAY TO the target callsign (Replay adds a miniature of the last received picture); SET TARGET CALLSIGN
how_to_confirm: A sets target Q2TST after receiving B's CQ, REPLAY TO: B's saved picture has the reply text and a miniature.

feature: TX IMAGE ONLY (no text) and REPEAT LAST TX
how_to_confirm: B receives A's image-only picture, then the repeat: two matching PNGs.

feature: REPLY MODE: AS RECEIVED (default: the mode of the last whole picture received since opening) or TX MODE; saved across restarts
how_to_confirm: B receives A's Martin M1, replies AS RECEIVED with TX Mode Robot 36: A's decoder state shows Martin M1.

feature: TX Mode (Martin/Scottie/Robot), saved for the next TX over a restart; a received picture no longer changes it (#229, #230)
how_to_confirm: A TX Mode Scottie S1, restart the GUI over SSH, CALL CQ: B's decoder state shows Scottie S1.

feature: Cancel TX goes back; Halt TX stops on the air
how_to_confirm: Halt mid-picture: state tx 0 at once; B's picture partial.

feature: While a picture goes out the knob, band/mode keys and A/B leave frequency, band and mode; Freq. off from TX setup to the end
how_to_confirm: During A's TX 'knob main 10', 'key BAND_UP': state freq unchanged, B's picture continues.

feature: TX pictures in /mnt/sstv/tx_pics, text templates in /mnt/sstv/tx_text (defaults copied at first start); uploads from the web Gallery; received in /mnt/sstv
how_to_confirm: SSH ls the folders; HTTP upload a JPEG to the Gallery: it appears in tx_pics and in the TX picture chooser (screenshot).

feature: RADE opens only with Bluetooth headphones (Mute speaker) or a TCI client connected, else says what to connect; 'Speech to' shows where it goes
how_to_confirm: No TCI client: 'open 128' -> state app stays empty, screenshot of the message; with a TCI client connected: state app RADE, 'Speech to' TCI (screenshot).

feature: Freq.: FreeDV activity frequencies set dial and sideband (LSB below 10 MHz, USB from 10 MHz)
how_to_confirm: Choose 14.236: state freq 14.236000 USB; a 40 m one: LSB.

feature: RADE V1 receive: Sync, SNR, offset, level, lost counters, decode/synth ms; speech to the TCI clients (silence between overs); 'last over' callsign in FreeDV's and this app's form
how_to_confirm: A sends a rade_c-encoded test over with an EOO callsign as TCI TX audio at 0.5 W on 14.236 USB; B's RADE: screenshot SYNC/SNR and 'last over Q1TST'; B's TCI RX audio is speech, not hiss.

feature: Rec from the hand mic (up to 60 s) encoded as you speak, receiver off meanwhile, 'encoding' then 'over ready'; dropped if the radio keys; built-in mic not usable
how_to_confirm: Owner records with the hand mic: screenshot 'over ready N s'.

feature: Send keys at RADE's own Power (radio PWR and the apps' level untouched); the End-of-Over carries your callsign; Send again, Discard, Stop; refused without callsign, during another TX, or where no TX
how_to_confirm: After the owner's Rec: Power 0.5 W (the 2 W default is over the chain's 1 W), Send: 't' ~0.5 W, B's RADE shows SYNC and 'last over Q1TST'; state pwr unchanged.

feature: RADE Power (page 2): 0.5, 1, 2 (default) or 3 W
how_to_confirm: Press Power repeatedly: screenshot of the steps; kept after reopening.

feature: FreeDV Reporter (page 2, off by default) publishes callsign, locator, frequency, TX state and heard callsigns to qso.freedv.org over TLS while the window is open; hold for a status message (freedv_reporter.txt); QSY requests shown only; retries 5 s to 2 min; works offline as off
how_to_confirm: Publishes the station on a public site (owner's say first): Reporter on: qso.freedv.org lists the call and frequency within seconds of tuning; closing the window removes it; SSH cat /mnt/freedv_reporter.txt after a hold-edit.

feature: APP > Modes > PSK31/PSK63 to the nearest standard dial (USB-D), BAND keys step, nothing sent on opening, frequency/mode back on close
how_to_confirm: 'open 121': state freq 14.070000 USB-D; state tx 0 for 30 s; 'close' restores.

feature: APP > Modes > Olivia to its dial (14.071, 3.5815 ...); Contestia from the Mode button
how_to_confirm: 'open 122': state freq 14.071000 USB-D.

feature: Mode PSK31 (31.25 Bd) / PSK63 (62.5 Bd); received text in the panel, sent text in the TX colour
how_to_confirm: A sends a macro in PSK31 at 0.5 W, B's cursor on A's audio: B's /mnt/digi_text/<date>.txt RX line with the text; the same in PSK63.

feature: Olivia 8/250 (default), 16/500, 32/1000 send and decode (prints once locked, ~8 s at 8/250)
how_to_confirm: A sends 'CQ CQ DE Q1TST' in each: B's digi_text has an OLIVIA-8/250 (etc.) RX line with the text.

feature: Contestia (CT) 4/250, 8/250, 4/500, 8/500, 16/500, 8/1000, 16/1000, 32/1000: capitals only, unknown characters as '?'
how_to_confirm: A sends 'cq de q1tst' plus an accented letter in Contestia 8/250: B's digi_text 'CONTESTIA-8/250 RX ... CQ DE Q1TST ?'.

feature: The coloured band is where the decoder listens: main knob 5 Hz (PSK) / 10 Hz (Olivia), PSK snaps onto the signal when the knob stops; MFK 1 Hz / 5 Hz
how_to_confirm: B's cursor 40 Hz off A's PSK signal, 'knob main 1': the status button's audio frequency snaps to A's (screenshot) and text decodes.

feature: Status button: audio frequency and lock quality; press resyncs, hold clears the text
how_to_confirm: During A's PSK: screenshot of Q; hold -> the panel cleared.

feature: PSK squelch (page 2, SQL): text only while the quality is at the threshold (68 default) and 1.5 s after; MFK sets it (0 off), hold toggles; /mnt/psk.conf
how_to_confirm: PSK open on a quiet input for 2 min: no RX lines in /mnt/digi_text/<date>.txt; SQL 0: noise lines appear; SSH cat /mnt/psk.conf.

feature: Dial (page 2): the MFK moves the VFO in 1 kHz steps up to 50 kHz either side; hold goes back to the standard frequency
how_to_confirm: Press Dial, 'knob mfk 3': state freq +3 kHz; hold Dial: back to 14.070.

feature: DX call taken from 'DE <call>' in the received text or typed (hold clears); RST snt (page 2)
how_to_confirm: A sends 'CQ DE Q1TST': screenshot of B's DX call button 'Q1TST'.

feature: Free Text and macros (pages 3-5: press sends, hold edits, empty deletes) with <MYCALL> <CALL> <RST> <RSTR> <QTH>; TX through the FT8 path (7 W cap, ALC, SWR protection, TX strip)
how_to_confirm: A presses a macro '<CALL> DE <MYCALL> <RST> <QTH>': B's digi_text shows it expanded with A's call and EN80KC.

feature: Stop TX: a short carrier tail (PSK) or after the current block (Olivia, Contestia)
how_to_confirm: Mid-macro Stop TX: state tx 0 within ~1 s in PSK, within a block in Olivia.

feature: Text (page 6 F5; JTTY page 6): the MFK scrolls back up to 200 lines ('Text 12 back'), new text does not move the view, hold back to the newest, knob back to tuning after 8 s
how_to_confirm: After several received lines: Text, 'knob mfk -3': screenshot 'Text 3 back'; hold: newest.

feature: Macros in /mnt/psk_macros.txt and /mnt/olivia_macros.txt, editable on the web Macros page
how_to_confirm: HTTP edit a macro on the Macros page: SSH cat shows it; the app's button label (screenshot).

feature: Log QSO (page 6 F4): DX call and both reports into the day's log in the app's mode (PSK/PSK31|PSK63, OLIVIA, CONTESTI), on to Wavelog and WSJT-X UDP, into an activation's log; 'Nothing to log'; RST rcvd (page 6 F3) press steps, hold 599; the same call within 10 min only on a hold; the Panel's Log tab logs in the app's mode
how_to_confirm: Type DX call Q9TST then Log QSO: the day's ADIF (web Logs page) has MODE PSK SUBMODE PSK31; a second press within 10 min adds nothing, a hold adds; remote 'log Q8TST|599|599|' while PSK is open logs mode PSK.

feature: APP > Modes > JTTY to the band's JTTY dial (14.090 USB-D)
how_to_confirm: 'open 123': state freq 14.090000 USB-D.

feature: F1-F8 macros (pages 2-3: press sends, hold edits name and text) with %M, %H, %E (599 + serial), WSJT-X contest keys by default, /mnt/jtty_macros.txt and the web Macros page; received lines start with SNR in dB (audio freq when outside the RX window)
how_to_confirm: A presses F1 (CQ) at 0.5 W: B's panel line '-xx dB CQ Q1TST EN80' (screenshot) and a JTTY RX line with dB in /mnt/digi_text.

feature: With a keyboard CapsLock+1 to CapsLock+8 send the macros
how_to_confirm: Bluetooth keyboard paired: CapsLock+1 -> state tx 1 and the other radio decodes (cable).

feature: Page 5: RST snt, RST rcvd, Log QSO into the day's log as JTTY (ADIF MFSK/JTTY); the Panel's Log tab logs JTTY while open
how_to_confirm: Type the DX call, Log QSO: the day's ADIF has MODE MFSK SUBMODE JTTY; remote 'log' while JTTY is open logs JTTY.

feature: Built-in PSK/Olivia/JTTY dial lists follow the band plan region (40 m PSK 7.040 R1, 7.070 R2/US, 7.035 R3; Olivia R2 variants on 160/40 m)
how_to_confirm: Settings > General > STATION > Band plan Region 1, PSK on 40 m: state freq 7.040; Region 2: 7.070; Olivia R2 on 40 m: 7.0385.

feature: Own frequencies (web Frequencies > Digital modes, Type PSK/Olivia/JTTY) replace the band's built-in one, several listed, new bands added, label shown, always USB-D, read at each band key/opening; the card shows the list; kept in params.db
how_to_confirm: HTTP add PSK 14.072 'TEST': PSK on 20 m -> state freq 14.072; delete it -> 14.070.

feature: The web Logs page lists the text-log days: read, download, delete

feature: RTTY TX (ITA2 AFSK with the app's rate, shift, centre, reverse) is in the TX player but no screen starts it yet

how_to_confirm: Only the upload: HTTP upload to the Gallery's WeFax TX folder, SSH ls /mnt/wefax/tx_pics; the TX itself has no control.

feature: KEY 1:2 Speed, Volume (sidetone 0-32 X6100, 0-63 X6200), Train, Tone; KEY 2:2 Mode (Manual/Auto-L/Auto-R), Iambic, QSK time, Ratio
how_to_confirm: TCI 'cw_keyer_speed:25;' then the TCI broadcast and screenshot of KEY 1:2 show 25; state kt = Tone; step Volume to its top (screenshot 32 / 63).

feature: Iambic B by default (A up to v0.3.9); an unchanged A becomes B after the update
how_to_confirm: Screenshot of KEY 2:2 / params over SSH on a radio with default settings: B.

feature: KEY Train: key, paddle, messages and the CW Trainer sound only the sidetone, TX power held at 0 W in CW/CW-R (also the split TX VFO) in every key mode; ON AIR at 0.0 W; 'KEY Train: sidetone only, 0 W'; TUNE keeps its own power; out of CW not held

feature: Outside the bands Train with the key, paddle or messages is refused as any CW; only the CW Trainer keeps sounding
how_to_confirm: Train on, 27.185 CW, TCI cw_macros: screenshot 'No TX on 27.185 MHz', own 'cw' text empty.

feature: CW decoder (CW 2:2 Decoder on/off; coherent tracker, 10-50 WPM): text and WPM in the see-through panel over the waterfall
how_to_confirm: A sends 'CQ CQ DE Q1TST K' via TCI cw_macros at 20 WPM, 0.5 W on 14.050; B in CW with the decoder on: the remote 'cw' text matches, WPM ~20 (screenshot); decoder off: no 'cw' text.

feature: Dec SNR (CW 2:2, 5-30 dB, default 8): how far over the noise floor a mark must be
how_to_confirm: A at 0.1 W with B's attenuator on: Dec SNR 5 copies, 30 misses ('cw' text).

feature: No characters from noise, clicks or steady carriers (birdies); a key-down over 8 dots is ignored
how_to_confirm: B decoder on while A sends a TUNE carrier at 0.5 W for 15 s on B's tone: no 'cw' text; idle for 5 min: none.

feature: Decodes A-Z, figures, punctuation, prosigns and Å Ä Ö Ü É Ñ CH (#265); the CW Keyboard and TCI key them
how_to_confirm: A TCI cw_macros 'ÅÄÖÜÉÑ CH': B's 'cw' text has them, not <?>.

feature: Your own keying is decoded (the base's sidetone in the audio; raised on the X6200); the first key-down after 2 s sets the decoder to KEY Speed
how_to_confirm: KEY Train on (no RF), Speed 25, TCI 'cw_macros:0,VVV TEST;': the same radio's 'cw' text reads 'VVV TEST' from the first word.

feature: ZAP (CW 1:2) tunes to the station the decoder follows, to 10 Hz, in CW and CW-R (#115)
how_to_confirm: B 200 Hz off A's CW on 14.050, press ZAP (F-key): state freq within 10 Hz of A's dial; again in CW-R.

feature: CW peak and CW peak Q (CW 1:2): the base's peaking filter at the key tone on the X6100 (what you hear and the decoder), the decoder's input only on the X6200
how_to_confirm: X6100: A's CW 300 Hz off the key tone; record the X6100's TCI RX audio with CW peak off/on: the off-tone level drops with it on.

feature: Log QSO (CW 1:2) logs the call the decoder confirmed (quick QSO log)
how_to_confirm: B decodes 'DE Q1TST Q1TST' from A, press Log QSO: the day's log has Q1TST mode CW (web Logs page).

feature: Tuner (CW 2:2): a row of bars, centre at the key tone, one bar per 10 Hz, green/yellow/red, lit on the station's side (reverse in CW-R), solid and fading; placed under the band plan/top of spectrum, VISION and Amber Trey variants
how_to_confirm: B 30 Hz off A's CW: screenshot shows the lit bar three to the station's side; CW-R the other side.

feature: In CW/CW-R a station on the dial sounds at the key tone and is drawn on the VFO line in the waterfall, spectrum and Panel on both radios (#115)
how_to_confirm: A on 14.050 sends; B on 14.050 CW: B's spectrum frame peak at the centre bin; B's TCI RX audio tone = state kt.

feature: While you send in CW/CW-R your carrier is drawn on the VFO line (#191)
how_to_confirm: A sends CW at 0.5 W: A's own spectrum frames during TX peak at the centre bin.

feature: X6100 IF shift (MFK 2:4, base 1.1.9+): the received picture is centred at the shifted tuning, on the dial while transmitting; the noise stripe moves the other way
how_to_confirm: Screenshot only: IF shift +1000 on the MFK 2:4 page, the faint noise stripe 1 kHz lower in the waterfall.
suite_has: control if-shift (set ifs, read back, the X6200 refuses); paths if-shift (ifshift.py: a 0.1 W tone from the X6200, its pitch kept, the Panel placing it, the base retuned)

feature: Parse (CW 2:2, on by default): run-together words split on CW words and callsigns, confirmed calls in the accent colour, abbreviations dim, RST in the heading colour; Off gives raw text
how_to_confirm: A sends 'CQCQDEQ1TSTK' with tight spacing (TCI, no spaces): B's 'cw' text / screenshot 'CQ CQ DE Q1TST K'; Parse off: run together.

feature: USB/Bluetooth keyboard keys CW from the main screen in CW/CW-R inside a CW segment with no app open: a line over the waterfall, Backspace, Esc clears and stops, Enter sends, queue; out of CW mode/segment cleared
how_to_confirm: Rii X1 paired: type 'TEST' Enter in CW on 14.050 (0.5 W): the other radio's 'cw' text TEST (cable); on 14.200 nothing sent.

feature: While the line is open the MFK turns the key speed (yellow MFK tag), back to its control when it closes
how_to_confirm: Line open, 'knob mfk 2': TCI cw_keyer_speed +2; screenshot of the tag.

feature: CapsLock+1..5 key MSG > CW messages 1-5; CapsLock+L logs the typed line; CapsLock+F opens the frequency box; a window drops the queue
how_to_confirm: CapsLock+1: state tx and the other radio decodes message 1; type 'Q9TST 599 599' CapsLock+L: the day's log record.

feature: In CW [ and ] are the paddle's dit and dah (any USB keyboard too); out of CW they are the volume keys
how_to_confirm: Train on, '[' held: own 'cw' text 'EEEE'; out of CW '[' changes state vol.

feature: APP > CW Keyboard, or a long press (Settings > Keys > PAGE KEYS, LONG PRESS: APP CW Keyboard)
how_to_confirm: 'open 117': state win CW Keyboard; screenshot.

feature: Keys only in CW/CW-R (NOT CW, 'Set CW mode to transmit'), no CW segment needed; 'No TX on ...' / 'No TX: no data from the base' where it may not transmit
how_to_confirm: 'open 117' in USB: screenshot NOT CW; in CW on 27.185: screenshot 'No TX on 27.185 MHz'; state tx 0.

feature: Without a keyboard an MFK press or Send with an empty line opens the on-screen keyboard; MFK picks keys, OK keys the line, the keyboard key closes without sending
how_to_confirm: 'key MFK 1/0' opens it, 'knob mfk N' + MFK presses type 'E', OK at 0.5 W: state tx 1, the other radio's 'cw' text 'E'.

feature: Turning the MFK or the arrows sets 5-60 WPM, the same as KEY > Speed, shown in the head
how_to_confirm: 'knob mfk 3': screenshot head +3; TCI cw_keyer_speed the same.

feature: Send, Stop, Clear (log and line), Close; log rows dim/bright/queued with READY / ON AIR / NOT CW (no colour codes, #269)
how_to_confirm: Type a long line, Send, then Stop: state tx 0 at once; Clear empties the log (screenshot without colour codes).

feature: The next pages key the MSG > CW messages (up to eight, four a page) as typed lines
how_to_confirm: Press the page's message 1 key: the other radio's 'cw' text = message 1 with {CALL} filled.

feature: Live (last page, off by default): each letter keyed as typed (space = word gap, 'Live: keyed as typed'), on the on-screen keyboard too (64 letters); Backspace removes only unkeyed letters; the same setting drives the main-screen line
how_to_confirm: Live on, on-screen 'E' then 'T' via MFK: the other radio's 'cw' text 'ET' with no OK.

feature: With a keyboard: type the line under the log, Enter keys it, queue; Backspace corrects; Esc stops what is on air and queued, with nothing to stop closes the app
how_to_confirm: BT keyboard: type, Enter: tx 1; Esc mid-send: tx 0; Esc again: state win no longer CW Keyboard.

feature: N6ARA TinyMIDI (Keyboard Mode, BLE) pairs as a keyboard: dit '[' and dah ']' key the radio in CW (volume keys out of CW), following Speed, Iambic, ratio, key mode and Train; a touch stops a CW message or line
how_to_confirm: Owner pairs and touches the paddle with Train on: own 'cw' text; a touch during a CW message: state tx 0.

feature: Keyboard-type USB paddle (e.g. Vail adapter): Left Ctrl dit, Right Ctrl dah, [ ] always; its press stops a CW message on the air
how_to_confirm: Owner plugs the adapter and keys with Train on: own 'cw' text; SET > KEYS > PADDLE shows it (screenshot).

feature: Mouse-type USB paddle: left button dit, right dah; an ordinary mouse is not taken
how_to_confirm: Owner plugs one and keys with Train on: own 'cw' text; a plain mouse does nothing.

feature: USB MIDI paddle (experimental): notes 1 dit, 2 dah; one MIDI device, the first plugged
how_to_confirm: Owner plugs a MIDI paddle: own 'cw' text with Train on.

feature: USB serial paddle (CH340, FTDI, CP210x, PL2303, CDC ACM): CTS dit, DSR dah; Serial port off by default; first ttyUSB/ttyACM, never the radio's own ports or the X6200's WR12
how_to_confirm: Owner plugs one, Serial port on: own 'cw' text with Train on; default off checked in SET > KEYS > PADDLE (screenshot).

feature: USB paddles follow KEY mode, Iambic A/B (squeeze release), speed and ratio; a contact pressed during an element and held after the other is let go is a press of its own (K stays K)
how_to_confirm: Owner squeezes in A and B with Train on: own 'cw' text.

feature: SET > KEYS > PADDLE: connected kinds, Learn dit and dah (10 s each, saved per kind), Swap dit and dah for all USB paddles
how_to_confirm: Owner runs Learn with a paddle: screenshot of the saved inputs; Swap reverses own 'cw' text E/T.

feature: SmartCW recognised by itself: USB network (SmartCW 192.168.7.1, radio .16-.23), never the default route or DNS, not on the ETHERNET card; its serial port never a paddle; 'SmartCW (MIDI)' under Connected
how_to_confirm: Owner plugs SmartCW: SSH 'ip addr' 192.168.7.x, 'ip route' default still WiFi; screenshot of Settings > Keys > PADDLE.

feature: SmartCW's own page through the radio on port 8073 (Operating > SmartCW while plugged), the whole page working, plain http
how_to_confirm: Owner plugs SmartCW: HTTP GET http://<radio>:8073/ returns SmartCW's page; the configurator menu shows Operating > SmartCW.

feature: SmartCW page guard and messages: sending/settings/restart/upload only from a page opened by the radio's own names, never through Tailscale Funnel; 'SmartCW is not plugged in', 'SmartCW did not answer', 'Not one of the radio's names'
how_to_confirm: Without SmartCW: HTTP GET :8073/ -> 'SmartCW is not plugged in'; a POST with Origin http://example.invalid -> refused ('Not one of the radio's names').

feature: SmartCW MIDI: keyed mode (note 65 keyer, 64 straight key) keys as SmartCW times it (its text, memories, beacon go out; radio KEY mode/swap don't apply); paddles mode (67/68) uses the radio's keyer; 66 PTT nothing; CW/CW-R only; let go on mode change/SWR/unplug; one keyer at a time; nothing from its practice mode
how_to_confirm: Owner plugs SmartCW in keyed mode and sends from its page at 0.5 W: the other radio's 'cw' text matches; in USB nothing keys.

feature: MSG > CW: TX sends the message; New, Edit (page 1), Delete (page 2); 1-64 characters
how_to_confirm: Open MSG > CW ('key MSG'), TX message 1 at 0.5 W: the other radio's 'cw' text matches.

feature: Web configurator CW messages page (Operating): add, edit, delete; the radio shows them next time MSG > CW opens
how_to_confirm: HTTP add 'TEST {CALL}'; open MSG > CW: screenshot lists it.

feature: While a message or beacon is sent the break-in delay is raised (one word space + 150 ms, at most 1 s) so TX stays keyed through gaps; back after (not in QRSS3)
how_to_confirm: During a multi-word message the remote's 'tx' events: one tx 1 for the whole message; afterwards a single TCI letter unkeys after the normal QSK time.

feature: {CALL} is your callsign, {HIS} the last call the decoder confirmed (the one Log QSO offers); the side panel shows the send time with {CALL} filled
how_to_confirm: B decodes 'CQ DE Q1TST Q1TST' from A; B sends '{HIS} UR 599': A's 'cw' text 'Q1TST UR 599'.

feature: Beacon (page 2): Off or 10/30/60/120 s pause; TX repeats after every pause until stopped, receives (and decodes) in the pauses, at PWR; only while MSG > CW is open
how_to_confirm: Beacon 10 s, TX at 0.5 W: the other radio's 'cw' text repeats every send + 10 s; state tx periods spaced.

feature: A beacon is not started where the radio may not transmit or without base data; one moved there stops at its next element
how_to_confirm: 27.185 CW, Beacon 10 s, TX: screenshot 'No TX on 27.185 MHz', state tx 0.

feature: Stopped by TX (Stop), the front PTT key, ESC, closing MSG > CW (Close, another menu key, an app), and any transmission in a pause or before its start (mic PTT, CAT, TCI, Panel)
how_to_confirm: In a pause rigctl 'T 1' then 'T 0': no further sends (other radio's 'cw' text stops); repeat with 'key PTT 1 <id>' and 'close'.

feature: Start (Now or a time, 5-minute steps) and Until (Stopped, 1-99 sends, or a time) on page 3 in the screen clock's zone: 'From 20:00 UTC, 10 sends', 'AT 20:00' countdown, a start gone by is tomorrow's, clock jumps handled, 'Beacon over: 10 sends' / 'Beacon over: 21:00', an end before the start is the next day's; with Beacon off TX sends once
how_to_confirm: Until 2 sends, pause 10 s: exactly two decodes on the other radio and screenshot 'Beacon over: 2 sends'; Start at the next 5-minute mark: screenshot 'AT hh:mm' and the first send at that minute.

feature: After a restart Beacon and QRSS3 are off; pause, Start, Until and the QRSS3 frequencies kept
how_to_confirm: Beacon 30 s, Start time, Until 5, QRSS3 on; restart the GUI over SSH; MSG > CW: screenshot Beacon Off, QRSS3 off, the rest kept.

feature: QRSS3 (page 2): TX and Beacon send at 3 s dots, 9 s dashes (3/9/21 s gaps) on 30 m or 80 m, moving to the band's QRSS frequency (10.140050 / 3.569900); receives in every gap; at PWR
how_to_confirm: 30 m CW, QRSS3 on, message 'E', 0.5 W: state freq 10.140050; 'tx' events ~3 s; the other radio's spectrum shows the carrier at 10.140050 for those 3 s.

feature: Freq (page 3): the band's QRSS frequency, MFK or VOL in 10 Hz steps, kept per band
how_to_confirm: Press Freq, 'knob mfk 2': screenshot +20 Hz; restart the GUI: kept.

feature: QRSS3 refused (with a word) in another mode, on another band, with LOCK, in split, with a TX shift, with XIT, out of band, without base data
how_to_confirm: QRSS3 on, TX on 20 m -> screenshot refusal; again with 'set lock 1', 'set split 1', 'set xit 100', USB mode: state tx 0 each time.

feature: QRSS3 stops on TX (Stop), ESC/closing, the front PTT, the SWR protection, any transmission between elements, and a change of frequency, band, mode, VFO, split, TX shift or XIT ('QRSS3 stopped: tuned away')
how_to_confirm: During a send 'set freq 10140200': state tx 0, screenshot 'QRSS3 stopped: tuned away'; rigctl 'T 1'/'T 0' in a gap stops it too.

feature: No key-down over 10 s ('QRSS3 stopped: key held 10 s'); a crash mid-dash lets the key go before the program restarts
how_to_confirm: Key-held limit not provokable normally. Crash case: SSH 'kill -9' the GUI during a 9 s dash (the watchdog restarts it): the other radio's spectrum rise ends at once. Risky: only with the owner's word.

feature: APP 2 > CW Trainer: train mode (sidetone only, 0 W in every key mode incl. Manual); receiver turned down (base RF gain 0) with the RF gain setting kept, given back on close and after a power-off; RF gain turned while open applies
how_to_confirm: 'set rfg 80', 'open 115': the 'm' S-meter drops to the floor while state rfg stays 80; 'close': S-meter back; TCI cw_macros while open: no 't' frames.

feature: Learn (Koch): groups of the level's characters, the newest weighted for its first 20 tries, weak and little-tried more often; Stats shows the last 20 tries; answers checked by the CW decoder
how_to_confirm: 'open 115', Learn, Start: the remote 'cw' text shows the group; key it back via TCI cw_macros at KEY speed: screenshot OK; Stats screenshot. If TCI CW does not reach the trainer, owner with a paddle.

feature: An answer ends at its last character, at a word space (Learn) or after 3 s / 30 dots + 0.5 s at slow speeds (more with Ratio > 3); a character within two dots of the group's end goes with it; Start and Replay play 1 s after the press ('Listen...')
how_to_confirm: Scripted TCI answers at 10 WPM ending in 0/1/9/,/.: graded right; an answer sent 0.5 s after Start is not counted (screenshot 'Listen...').

feature: Calls: a callsign keyed, you key it back; right +1 WPM, wrong -1; 50 calls a run; spaces inside a call allowed
how_to_confirm: Calls via TCI answers: screenshot speed +1 after a right answer; an answer with a space inside ('N 2JAH') counted right.

feature: TX speed (page 2 in Calls): Follows (KEY Speed follows the calls, restored on leaving) or Fixed (KEY Speed stays; 'Key back the callsign at your 20 WPM'); kept
how_to_confirm: Fixed: TCI cw_keyer_speed unchanged across right answers; Follows: it changes with each call and is restored on leaving Calls; reopen: choice kept.

feature: Trainer activity (each group/call and answer character, Practice keying) keeps the screensaver away (#263); idle waiting lets it come
how_to_confirm: Screensaver 1 min, Calls running with TCI answers for 3 min: screenshots never show it; left waiting: it comes; an answer brings the screen back.

feature: The trainer keys 5-50 WPM and the decoder follows down to 5 WPM while it is open (10 on the band)
how_to_confirm: KEY Speed 5, Learn: the remote 'cw' text of the group is right (an M, not TT).

feature: An unreadable answer character (or a prosign such as AR) shows <?> and is never right ('<?> = not a character'); it counts one place
how_to_confirm: Answer with '<AR>' via TCI: screenshot <?> and the hint line.

feature: KEY 2:2 Mode for the trainer: Manual (straight key; an X6200 KEY-jack paddle acts as a sideswiper; USB/BT paddle dit only), Auto-L/Auto-R iambic; Iambic A/B, QSK, Ratio
how_to_confirm: Owner keys a paddle in each mode with the trainer open: own 'cw' text.

feature: The trainer keeps sounding on any frequency the radio can transmit on (0 W, its PTT does nothing); refused in receive-only ranges and outside South Korea / own-list ranges
how_to_confirm: 'open 115' at 9.500 MHz: a TCI answer is decoded (own 'cw' text), 'key PTT 1 <id>' -> no tx; X6200 at 100 MHz: screenshot 'No TX'; South Korea at 7.250: refused.

feature: Cluster client logs in by itself once WiFi and the callsign are set, reconnects with backoff, and its status line (Set your callsign / No network / Connecting... / Logged in as CALL / Cluster link off / error + retrying) is the same on the radio and the web Cluster page's Link card
how_to_confirm: GET http://<radio>/api/cluster/link: state/text reach 'Logged in as <call>' within a minute of WiFi up; open 113 and OCR the status line from a screenshot (kill -USR1, /tmp/screen.raw): same text as the API

feature: When the node refuses the call or a second login with the same call takes over, the radio waits 30 minutes ('retry in 30 min'); a -2 login on the Link card avoids it
how_to_confirm: From the test computer telnet to the same node with the radio's login: GET /api/cluster/link text says 'retry in 30 min'; then POST /api/cluster/link {enabled:true, login:'<call>-2'} and the text returns to 'Logged in as <call>-2'

feature: Link Off (Cluster page 2 or the web Link card) ends the login and keeps it off across a GUI restart
how_to_confirm: POST /api/cluster/link {enabled:false}; GET /api/cluster/link state 'off', text 'Cluster link off'; restart the GUI (announce it) and read it again: still off; the remote's 'spots' line stops refreshing. Put it back on afterwards

feature: After login the client asks for the latest 50 spots (sh/dx); spots older than 60 minutes are dropped
how_to_confirm: Remote 'panel 1': a 'spots [...]' line arrives within a minute of 'Logged in'; no entry has age a > 60 min

feature: Cluster app (CLUSTER 1:2 / 2:2): spots of the current band sorted by frequency around a VFO marker row; the list follows tuning and selects the nearest spot; spots within 3 kHz highlighted; green * under 2 minutes
how_to_confirm: open 113: state win == 'Cluster'; set freq to a spot's f from the 'spots' line; screenshot shows that row selected/highlighted next to the VFO marker

feature: MFK turn browses the list (VFO stops following); MFK press or Tune tunes the spot, mode from the comment (CW, FT8, SSB...) else from the band plan (CW, USB-D on FT8/FT4 frequencies, LSB below 10 MHz, USB above; VHF rules)
how_to_confirm: open 113; knob mfk 2; key MFK 1/0: state freq equals that spot's f and mode follows the rule (e.g. a spot on 14.074 -> USB-D / mode from comment 'FT8')

feature: 4 m, 2 m and 70 cm spots are listed (144.300 format) and tuned through a transverter covering them or, on the X6200, the WR12 (RX only); with neither the row is grey and Tune says 'No transverter: ...' and leaves the radio where it is
how_to_confirm: With a 2 m spot listed (Band / All) and no transverter: Tune leaves state freq unchanged and the message 'No transverter' (X6200 'No transverter/WR12') is on a screenshot; with the transverter shift set, state freq becomes the spot's

feature: Page 1 Band / All switches the list between the current band and all bands (always all outside the ham bands); the button shows 'Band / 20m' or 'Band / All'; saved and shared with the cluster column
how_to_confirm: open 113; press the Band/All button (its F key): params.db cluster_all_bands flips (sqlite3 /mnt/params.db); screenshot/OCR of the button label

feature: Page 1 Mode button: quick view filter All > CW > SSB > DIG
how_to_confirm: Press Mode until 'CW': the screenshot's rows are only CW spots (compare with the 'spots' line's m field)

feature: Page 2 Server: list of saved servers, MFK chooses, press uses it (saved in /mnt/cluster.conf), Server again or ESC closes
how_to_confirm: open 113, page 2, Server, knob mfk 1, key MFK: the chosen server changes in /mnt/cluster.conf and GET /api/cluster/link 'server'; restore afterwards

feature: Order: by frequency around the VFO (Freq) or newest first (Time); same as Settings > Cluster > CLUSTER VIEW 'Newest first'; shared with the column
how_to_confirm: Press Order: params.db cluster_order flips; screenshot shows the order label; with spots, Time puts the smallest age first

feature: Cluster filters (Settings > Cluster > CLUSTER FILTERS, also the web page): modes CW/SSB/DIG/AM-FM and bands 160 m-6 m plus 4 m/2 m/70 cm; one mode and one band always stay on; apply at once to the app, the column and the waterfall
how_to_confirm: POST /api/cluster/filters with only CW and 20m: cluster.conf has them; the remote 'spots' line then has only CW 20 m spots; turning off the last mode is refused

feature: Activity filter POTA, SOTA, WWBOTA, HOTA, WWFF, IOTA, WCA, TOTA, MOTA, LH, LLOTA (any mix, none = all), told from the comment's word or reference (park, summit, bunker, WWFF, castle... as Field Ops tells them; a spot of two programmes is in both)
how_to_confirm: Set activity POTA only: every 'spots' entry's k comment has POTA or a park reference; WWFF-only comments (KFF-1234) are gone

feature: A band filter saved up to v0.3.7 keeps 4 m, 2 m and 70 cm off until turned on; bands are kept in cluster.conf by number (2 for 2 m, 70 for 70 cm)
how_to_confirm: Write a v0.3.7-style band filter (no 4/2/70) into /mnt/cluster.conf over SSH (back it up); GET /api/cluster shows 4 m/2 m/70 cm off; turn 2 m on: the file gets band 2

feature: Besides the cluster the radio reads pota.app, wwbota.org, cqhota.app and llota.app activator spots once a minute into the same list (llota spot reads 'LLOTA LLPL-0123 SSB')
how_to_confirm: The remote 'spots' line holds entries whose spotter/comment come from those services (e.g. k starting 'LLOTA' or a POTA reference) within 2 minutes

feature: Web Cluster page filters add maximum age and spotters to skip (* wildcard)
how_to_confirm: POST /api/cluster/filters max age 5 min and skip '*-#': no 'spots' entry has a > 5 or a skimmer spotter

feature: Heard in (web Filters card): only spots whose spotter is in the listed countries (prefixes by cty.dat, up to 16; -2/-# ignored; unknown spotters dropped); a change refetches the latest spots; alerts still pass; POTA/WWBOTA/HOTA spots filtered alike
how_to_confirm: POST heard-in 'K': every 'spots' entry's s spotter is a US call; an alert call from elsewhere still appears with al set

feature: Alerts (web): calls or prefixes (3B8M, VP8*, */MM), optional bands/mode; matching spots magenta with ALERT, never filtered; a new one pops up on the main screen 10 s, MFK press tunes it (popup and beep options)
how_to_confirm: POST /api/cluster/alerts with a busy prefix (e.g. 'K*'): 'spots' entries for it have al true; a screenshot within 10 s shows the popup; key MFK during it: state freq becomes that spot's f

feature: Settings > Display > MAIN SCREEN Cluster spots: short cyan line and callsign at each spot frequency at the top of the waterfall, two staggered rows; alerts pink
how_to_confirm: Set cluster_spots_wf on (web Display page, On the waterfall card); screenshot of the main screen shows callsigns over the waterfall at the 'spots' frequencies

feature: Cluster column: box at the right of the waterfall with kHz, call, mode, age around the VFO row, coloured by age; title 'Cluster 40m - Freq'; in Time order newest on top; while shown the MFK gains Cluster order and Cluster bands items
how_to_confirm: Set cluster_column on; screenshot shows the box and title; knob mfk to the Cluster order item and turn: params.db cluster_order changes

feature: Spot snap hold (0-5) and speed (1-5): turning the main knob slowly stops the VFO on a spot it passes for N more detents (only with cluster spots on the waterfall)
how_to_confirm: Set spot_snap_hold 3; tune with 'knob main 1' one detent at a time across a spot's f: state freq stays on the spot for 3 more detents; with cluster_spots_wf off it does not

feature: With no server= lines in /mnt/cluster.conf the app lists fifteen public clusters, default DXFUN dxfun.com:8000
how_to_confirm: GET /api/cluster lists the servers; on a conf with no server= lines (backed up and restored) the list is the fifteen, DXFUN selected

feature: Web Operating > Cluster: add/remove servers, use one, filters, alerts, Link card (login, on/off, the radio's status line); writes /mnt/cluster.conf shared with the radio
how_to_confirm: GET /cluster 200; POST /api/cluster/servers adds a test server, DELETE /api/cluster/servers/<i> removes it; /mnt/cluster.conf follows; a radio-side filter change shows in GET /api/cluster

feature: Field Ops full-screen interface (APP page 2 or a long-press action); GEN or Radio goes back; main knob still tunes, MFK chooses
how_to_confirm: open 118: state win == 'Field Ops'; knob main 1 changes state freq; key GEN 1/0: win == ''

feature: Home row of fifteen tiles (LOG, NOTA, SOTA, POTA, WWBOTA, HOTA, WWFF, TOTA, WCA, MOTA, LH, Tiles, LLOTA, XOTA, Bands), scrolling with the MFK (5.5 visible with VISION), Bands one step left of LOG; tiles tinted gold under Sentry (green under Codec)
how_to_confirm: open 118; screenshot, knob mfk 1 x14, screenshot: the row scrolled; knob mfk -1 from LOG lands on Bands; compare screenshots of both radios

feature: Reference, running activation, its log and the screen are kept in /mnt/field; coming back or a restart mid-activation finds it as it was
how_to_confirm: Start an XOTA/SOTA activation (no auto spot), restart the GUI: open 118 shows the activation screen again (screenshot); /mnt/field holds the state

feature: Start here (home) opens Field Ops at power on
how_to_confirm: Turn it on; params.db field_boot = 1; restart the GUI: state win == 'Field Ops' right after start; turn it off again

feature: Before the activation: the reference (name, altitude/points, locator, coordinates, position source) and the nearest references with distance; nearest taken, MFK + press chooses another, Ref... (page 2) types one
how_to_confirm: Precondition: reference lists on /mnt/field. 'pos LAT LON 10' near a known summit; open SOTA tile; screenshot/OCR shows that summit first with its distance; knob mfk 1 + key MFK selects the second

feature: Position from the radio's GPS, else the phone's (Browser panel GPS, <10 min old and better than 1 km, header 'PHONE'), else the QTH locator; header dot green (real) or yellow (locator); '(old)' after 150 s (phone) / 60 s (GPS)
how_to_confirm: Remote 'pos 39.99 -83.11 20': header shows PHONE and a green dot (screenshot); after 150 s without a new pos it says (old); 'pos ... 5000' (coarser than 1 km) falls back to the locator with a yellow dot

feature: Update list (page 2, or the web Field Ops page) downloads all ten reference lists with progress ('Updating POTA (1/10): x / y MB'), resumes up to 5 tries, ends 'Lists: N POTA, ...', keeps a failed list ('Not updated, kept as it was'), times out after 45 minutes
how_to_confirm: POST /api/field/update; poll GET /api/field until it reports the 'Lists: ...' summary; the list files under /mnt/field get new mtimes

feature: Start begins the activation and its ADIF log /mnt/field/logs/<date>-<time>_<ref>.adi (Start in POTA/WWBOTA/HOTA/WWFF also spots: test with SOTA/TOTA/XOTA)
how_to_confirm: Choose an XOTA or SOTA reference, press Start: screenshot shows the activation screen (band, freq, mode, S-meter, CQ text, QSO count, elapsed, last call); after a Log QSO the .adi exists over SSH

feature: The activation screen counts what a valid activation needs: QSOs/4 SOTA, /10 POTA, /25 WWBOTA (/10 S5,Z3), CALLS/5 HOTA, /44 WWFF, /13 TOTA, /50 WCA, CALLS/4 MOTA and LH, /1 Tiles and XOTA, /10 LLOTA
how_to_confirm: Start an activation per programme (non-spotting ones first), log two test QSOs: OCR of the counter reads '2 / N' with the programme's N

feature: Map on the reference screen from /mnt/field/tiles/<z>/<x>/<y>.jpg (zoom 13/15/17, credit.txt shown): crosshair on the chosen reference, nearby references by kind (bunker square, XOTA kinds by name prefix), activated ones grey and ticked, own position dot and phone accuracy ring
how_to_confirm: scp a small test tile set and credit.txt to /mnt/field/tiles; 'pos' near a reference; screenshot shows the map, crosshair, credit; remove the tiles after

feature: Map auto zoom (reference and you both fit), edge arrow and distance when you are far, 'distance heading' line, 'You are there: Start to activate it' within 50 m, 'No map here...' outside the tiles; page 3 View (map+list, map+info, map only), Zoom -/+ (auto again after 10 s)
how_to_confirm: With test tiles: 'pos' 20 m from the reference -> status line 'You are there'; 'pos' 3 km away -> '3.0 km  NE ..' line; press View three times and Zoom +: screenshots differ as described; 10 s later zoom returns

feature: CQ sends 'CQ CQ SOTA DE <call> <call> K' in CW (POTA in a park); CQ again while on air stops it
how_to_confirm: Radios on the pads, pwr 1, 20 m CW. On radio A in a SOTA activation press CQ: remote 't' lines while on air; radio B on the same frequency with its CW decoder shows 'CQ CQ SOTA DE <call>' (screenshot OCR); press CQ again mid-send: tx drops to 0

feature: Rec CQ (page 2): record the voice CQ from the hand mic, 60 s max, Stop rec; kept as 'CQ SOTA' / 'CQ POTA' in /mnt/msg (MSG > Voice lists it)
how_to_confirm: Owner speaks into the hand mic; then over SSH /mnt/msg has the 'CQ SOTA' file and MSG > Voice lists it (screenshot)

feature: CQ in SSB plays the recorded voice CQ on the air
how_to_confirm: With a CQ SOTA file in /mnt/msg, SSB on 20 m at 1 W: press CQ on radio A: state tx 1 and 't' lines; radio B on the frequency shows S-meter 'm' rising during the over

feature: Log QSO: 'CALL' or 'CALL rst_sent rst_rcvd' (sent first; default 599 CW / 59 otherwise); each QSO written at once to the activation .adi with MY_SOTA_REF or MY_SIG POTA/MY_POTA_REF (other programmes' MY_SIG)
how_to_confirm: In an activation type 'F4ABC 59 57' with the on-screen keyboard (MFK) or the remote 'log' if it reaches Field Ops: the .adi over SSH has CALL F4ABC, RST_SENT 59, RST_RCVD 57 and the MY_ fields

feature: If a QSO can't be written the radio says 'QSO not saved: ' and why (read-only microSD, full, write error, could not be written); the same for the day's log outside Field Ops
how_to_confirm: Over SSH bind-mount a read-only tmpfs over /mnt/field/logs, log a QSO: message 'QSO not saved: the microSD has an error and is read-only...' (screenshot OCR); unmount after

feature: The mode logged is the radio's (CW, SSB, AM, FM), FT8/FT4 on their frequencies even in USB; USB-D/LSB-D elsewhere logs no mode, says so, shows DATA; the mode is set later on the web Logs page and only then goes to Wavelog
how_to_confirm: Log on 14.074 USB: .adi MODE FT8; log on 14.080 USB-D: no MODE and the message; PUT /api/logs/<name>/<n> with mode PSK31: the record gets it

feature: Spot: POTA self-spot on pota.app with the radio's frequency and mode; first press shows what will be posted and the button reads 'Spot?', a second press within 4 s posts (also a DX cluster spot 'POTA IT-0123 SSB')
how_to_confirm: First press only (a public post otherwise): button reads 'Spot?' and the preview text (screenshot), wait 5 s: it reverts and nothing is posted. A real post only with the owner's yes

feature: Re-spot (on by default): in POTA the radio spots at Start and after a QSY (1 kHz+ or mode change) once it has transmitted and stayed a minute; at most one in 5 minutes; to pota.app only; End posts a QRT spot when the activation was spotted
how_to_confirm: Public posts: owner's yes first. params.db field_respot toggles from the home screen; with it on, a POTA activation's QSY after a TX shows the spot message (screenshot) and pota.app's spot list has the new frequency

feature: End (page 2), pressed twice, ends the activation
how_to_confirm: In an XOTA/SOTA activation press End twice: screenshot back to the reference screen; the log file stays in /mnt/field/logs

feature: Bands tile: per band cluster spots (30 min), RBN skimmer spots (15 min), skimmers that heard you (10 min, best SNR), activity bar HIGH/GOOD/FAIR/POOR, best band marked; RBN connected while open (WiFi + callsign)
how_to_confirm: Open the Bands tile, wait 60 s: screenshot/OCR shows non-zero spot counts on busy bands and a marked best band; ss/netstat on the radio shows a connection to the RBN telnet while open and none after closing

feature: Test beacon: first press takes the radio to the chosen band's CW frequency (or stays on the current band) and shows 'Press again to send' with seconds left (and the TX frequency in split); second press within 10 s sends 'TEST DE <call> x3' in CW, then the radio goes back to where it was
how_to_confirm: Pads, pwr 1, radio in CW. Choose 20 m row, press Test beacon: state freq moves to 20 m's CW frequency, tx 0; press again: tx 1, 't' lines; radio B on that frequency decodes 'TEST DE <call>'; after the send state freq returns to the start

feature: Without a second press within 10 s, or after tuning / a band key / another mode, nothing is sent and the radio stays where it is now; Use band meanwhile sends nothing; choosing another band and pressing listens there instead
how_to_confirm: Press Test beacon once, wait 11 s: state tx never 1, message says nothing was sent (screenshot); repeat and 'knob main 1' within the 10 s: same

feature: Test beacon pressed during the send stops it and goes back; tuning, a band key, another mode or Use band during the send stops it too and the radio stays as set
how_to_confirm: Pads, 1 W: second press, then a third press 1 s later: tx drops to 0 at once and state freq returns

feature: Test beacon refuses with a reason: not in CW/CW-R, frequency/band/mode locked for another band, split or TX shift off the band, no TX there, no data from the base, already transmitting, MSG > CW sending or a beacon on
how_to_confirm: Keep the radios on the pads in case it keys. set lock 1 (or split 1 with B off band), press Test beacon for another band: message names the reason (screenshot), state tx stays 0 and freq unchanged
