feature: Use band (or a press) tunes a typical activation frequency of the band for the band plan region: CW frequency in CW/CW-R (mode kept), else the phone frequency in its sideband (LSB below 10 MHz, USB above and on 60 m)
how_to_confirm: In the Bands tile choose 40 m in SSB, Use band: state freq is 40 m's phone frequency, mode LSB; in CW: the CW frequency, mode stays CW

feature: LOG tile: '<program> LOGBOOK <ref>' with a red TEST; lists the activation's QSOs (N, TIME, CALL, BAND, MODE, RST S/R); buttons Log QSO, Upload QRZ, QRZ: <call>, Back
how_to_confirm: After logging test QSOs open the LOG tile: screenshot/OCR lists them matching the .adi

feature: QRZ: <call> shows the QRZ profile the upload goes to and cycles through up to three (web Field Ops page sets them and the active one); 'Only one QRZ profile', 'No QRZ profile: add it on the web page, Field Ops'
how_to_confirm: With no profile: press QRZ: message 'No QRZ profile...' (screenshot); POST /api/field/qrz with two test profiles: GET /api/field lists them Set; the key cycles 'QRZ profile: <call>'

feature: Upload QRZ (experimental) sends the whole activation log to QRZ.com: 'QRZ: 5 sent, 2 already there', refused ones named; 'No log to upload', 'QRZ: HTTP <code>'; needs a paid QRZ Logbook API key
how_to_confirm: Needs the owner's QRZ Logbook key and consent to write to the real logbook: press Upload QRZ, OCR the 'QRZ: N sent' message; without a log: 'No log to upload'

feature: Spot also posts on the DX cluster ('POTA IT-0123 SSB', 'SOTA I/LO-123 CW', 'TOTA OKR-0150 SSB', 'WCA DL-01156 CW', 'MOTA X42018 SSB', 'LH ARLHS BEL 002 SSB', 'TILES JO20ab SSB', 'LLOTA LLPL-0001 SSB'); Start does it in POTA, WWBOTA, HOTA, WWFF; QSY spots don't
how_to_confirm: Public post: owner's yes first. After Spot, the radio's own 'spots' line (or a cluster telnet from the test computer) shows the spot with that comment

feature: WWBOTA and HOTA tiles work like POTA: lists from wwbota.org / cqhota.app, MY_SIG WWBOTA/HOTA + MY_SIG_INFO; WWBOTA spots to wwbota.org (no account), HOTA to cqhota.app with the key on the web page, else DX cluster only with a message
how_to_confirm: Activate a bunker reference without pressing Spot: the .adi has MY_SIG WWBOTA and MY_SIG_INFO; the HOTA 'no key' message is shown on a Spot press only (a public post) - screenshot

feature: WWFF tile (AREA heading, DLFF-0123 refs): MY_SIG WWFF, park-to-park SIG WWFF/SIG_INFO; spots to the WWFF Spotline with the key from the web page, else DX cluster only
how_to_confirm: Activate a WWFF reference (no Spot), log 'ON4ABC 59 59 ONFF-0001': .adi has MY_SIG WWFF and SIG WWFF / SIG_INFO ONFF-0001

feature: TOTA, WCA and MOTA tiles (TOWER, CASTLE, MILL): Ref... takes any castle by number (DL-1156 -> DL-01156; unknown 'taken as it is'); MY_SIG TOTA/WCA/MOTA; T2T/C2C/M2M via SIG/SIG_INFO; no automatic spots
how_to_confirm: Ref... 'DL-1156' in WCA: screenshot shows DL-01156; log a QSO with another castle: .adi SIG WCA, log shows C2C; a number not in the list says 'not in the castle list, taken as it is'

feature: LH tile (ARLHS numbers, LIGHT heading): Ref... takes 'BEL 002', 'BEL-002', 'BEL002', 'bel 2', 'ARLHS BEL 002'; MY_SIG ARLHS; L2L with SIG ARLHS
how_to_confirm: Ref... 'bel 2': reference BEL 002 chosen (screenshot); log 'ON4ABC 59 59 LH BEL 007': .adi SIG ARLHS, SIG_INFO BEL 007

feature: Tiles tile: no list; the reference is the 6-character locator square you are in (GPS or 6-char QTH locator), the eight around it with edge distance; follows you until chosen/started; 4-char locator -> Ref...; MY_GRIDSQUARE + MY_SIG TILES; T3 tile-to-tile
how_to_confirm: 'pos' inside EN80kc: screenshot shows 'EN80kc here' and eight neighbours; send a pos in the next square: the reference follows; log with a tile after the call: .adi GRIDSQUARE + SIG TILES

feature: LLOTA tile (LAKE heading, LLPL-0001 refs): MY_SIG LLOTA, LL2LL with SIG LLOTA; nothing spotted by itself
how_to_confirm: Activate an LLOTA reference, log a QSO with another lake: .adi MY_SIG LLOTA / SIG LLOTA; no spot message after Start

feature: XOTA tile: own list /mnt/field/xota.tsv (X, ref, name, lat, lon; read at next nearest lookup); without it 'XOTA is your own list: copy your xota.tsv to /mnt/field'; refs shown without 'XOTA-'; MY_SIG XOTA, X2X; Spot posts nothing ('XOTA is a list of your own: no spot')
how_to_confirm: Without the file: screenshot shows the copy message; scp a one-line xota.tsv near the 'pos': the place is listed; Spot: message 'no spot'; Start + log: .adi MY_SIG_INFO XOTA-...

feature: NOTA tile: the nearest places of every list at once with their programme; a press opens the row in its programme, Start activates it there; Spot posts nothing ('NOTA: press the row to open it in its programme first'); without a position Start says 'NOTA: no reference near yet'
how_to_confirm: 'pos' then open NOTA: rows 'POTA ...', 'SOTA ...'; key MFK on a row: the screen becomes that programme's (screenshot); Spot shows the NOTA message

feature: Web Operating > Field Ops: QRZ Logbook profiles (three calls + keys, the active one), HOTA key, WWFF key (Set / Not set only), update the reference lists, download and delete activation logs
how_to_confirm: GET /field 200; POST /api/field/hota with a test key: GET /api/field says Set and never echoes it; GET /field/logs/<name> returns the .adi (200, ADIF text); restore the keys afterwards

feature: Bands app (APP page 3 or a long-press action) in the look of the other apps; ESC closes
how_to_confirm: open 119: state win == 'Bands'; close: win == ''

feature: Each band: activity bar and word, cluster/RBN counts, who heard you (best SNR); the best band framed; MFK moves the filled row
how_to_confirm: open 119, wait 60 s: screenshot/OCR shows counts; knob mfk 1 moves the filled row

feature: MFK press or Use band tunes a typical frequency of the chosen band (CW in CW/CW-R, which stays; else phone in the band's sideband) for the region
how_to_confirm: knob mfk to 40 m, key MFK: state freq is 40 m's phone frequency in LSB (or the CW one in CW)

feature: Test beacon, two presses as in Field Ops; ESC while it sends lets it finish and come back; ESC while waiting keeps the 10 s then sends nothing and the radio stays
how_to_confirm: Pads, 1 W, CW: first press moves state freq, second sends (tx 1, radio B decodes 'TEST DE'); separately: first press then close: no tx within 11 s

feature: Propagation (APP 4:6 or long-press): ESC closes and the radio returns to the frequency and mode it had; the bands listened to keep their own frequency/mode
how_to_confirm: Note state freq/mode; open 126, switch to Beacons (state freq goes to a beacon frequency in CW); close: state freq/mode back as before

feature: Conditions view: N0NBH/hamqsl.com solar data fetched on opening and hourly while open (Refresh if the last is 5+ minutes old), kept in /mnt/conditions.txt
how_to_confirm: open 126: /mnt/conditions.txt mtime is fresh (or unchanged if < 1 h); press Refresh after 5 min: mtime updates

feature: Conditions shows SFI, sunspots, A/K (K in words), X-ray, noise, 6m Es, the band-group forecast by day/night with the current column marked, a 'what to try now' line, its age in the header (works offline from the kept file), and the map with QTH centred, night shading, grey line and subsolar point
how_to_confirm: With /mnt/conditions.txt present: screenshot/OCR shows the SFI and K from the file and the header age; compare both radios' screenshots

feature: Beacons view follows the NCDXF/IARU schedule by the clock: Sweep (default) a whole round per band in turn on 14.100/18.110/21.150/24.930/28.200 MHz CW; Band (stay; Band button steps); Follow (with the beacon chosen by MFK); nothing retunes while transmitting; header 'clock?' without NTP/GPS
how_to_confirm: open 126, Beacons: state mode CW and freq one of the five; with Sweep, freq changes band every 3 minutes; press Band: freq stays; Follow + knob mfk: freq hops with the chosen beacon's slot

feature: Beacon scoring from the S-meter in each 10 s slot: table cells filled green/amber/accent (heard in 15 min), dark (not heard), faint (not yet); bottom line with distance and the lowest dash heard; kept between openings
how_to_confirm: Off-air beacons need an HF antenna (owner). Over the pads: radio B keys a 1 W CW carrier on 14.100 during a known beacon's slot while A is on Band 20 m: that beacon's 20 m cell fills (screenshot)

feature: Birdie Cal Start steps the receiver across every active TX band (and a transverter's), keeps narrow carriers that stay put, writes /mnt/birdies.txt (max 2048, 'List full at 2048' message); Stop ends early keeping what was found
how_to_confirm: No antenna on the radio: open 125, Start: state freq steps across bands; at the end (or Stop) /mnt/birdies.txt has one frequency per line, <= 2048 lines; compare the two radios' lists

feature: Clear forgets the birdies
how_to_confirm: Press Clear: /mnt/birdies.txt is empty

feature: Birdies setting (Settings > Display > MAIN SCREEN, the app's Marks button, web Display page): Marks draws a red tick at each birdie at the top of the waterfall
how_to_confirm: Set birdie_marks to Marks (POST /api/display); screenshot shows ticks at the birdies.txt frequencies within the span

feature: Marks + notch also puts the DNF notch on a birdie inside the passband in USB/LSB/digital modes and removes it when tuned away; a user notch is left alone
how_to_confirm: Set Marks + notch, tune so a listed birdie is 1 kHz into the USB passband: params.db dnf on and dnf_center at it (or the notch on a screenshot); tune away: dnf off

feature: On the Air lists what the EiBi broadcast list has on the air now across HF and MW, in frequency order, re-read each minute; the line under the list says what, hours/days, from and to
how_to_confirm: open 133: state win == 'On the Air'; screenshot/OCR shows rows sorted by kHz

feature: MFK press or F4 Tune tunes the chosen station: broadcast in AM, Morse in CW, others in USB
how_to_confirm: knob mfk 1; key MFK: state freq equals the row's kHz and mode AM for a broadcaster

feature: F1 Show: All, Broadcast, Utility, Numbers (hold: the one before), classified from the entries (-CW/-TY/-TS/-HF languages, navy/VOLMET/fax names = Utility; ENIGMA designations, Buzzer etc. = Numbers)
how_to_confirm: key F1: label changes (screenshot); with Utility only utility rows remain

feature: F2 Range: All, or Near the dial (250 kHz either side)
how_to_confirm: set freq 9600000; key F2 to Near: every row is within 9350-9850 kHz (OCR)

feature: F3 Tune as you go: tunes each station as the MFK stops on it
how_to_confirm: key F3 on; knob mfk 1: state freq changes without an MFK press

feature: F5 Save as channel: tunes it and keeps it as a named memory channel
how_to_confirm: key F5: GET /api/channels gains an entry named after the station with its frequency

feature: Time Signal tunes WWV in AM, 10 MHz first; frequency and mode come back when it closes
how_to_confirm: open 132: state freq 10000000, mode AM; close: previous freq/mode

feature: F1 steps 2.5, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 MHz (hold: the one before)
how_to_confirm: key F1: state freq 15000000; long press F1: back to 10000000

feature: F2 Set clock Auto / Off (Off only shows how far the clock is)
how_to_confirm: key F2: label toggles Auto/Off (screenshot)

feature: Decodes WWV/WWVH ticks (1000/1200 Hz), the 100 Hz time code minute by minute (date, UTC, DUT1, leap warning) and after two good minutes (three when >1 min off) sets the clock and RTC; an NTP/GPS-kept clock is left alone and the offset is shown and logged ('timesig:')
how_to_confirm: No HF antenna here (no off-air WWV) and the cable is amateur-only: owner with an antenna, or an audio replay of radio_captures/modes/wwv_10000.wav into the app if the suite has injection; then OCR the decoded time and grep the GUI log for 'timesig:'

feature: CHANNELS window (APP page 2, the long-press action APP Channels, or the hand mic's V/M): rows name + frequency + mode; unnamed shows 'CHANNEL n'
how_to_confirm: open 124: state win == 'Channels'; screenshot/OCR matches GET /api/channels

feature: MFK press tunes the channel (frequency, mode, AGC, PRE, ATT) and closes the window, LOCK on or not (LOCK stays on)
how_to_confirm: set lock 1; open 124, knob mfk 1, key MFK: state freq/mode/agc/pre/att equal the channel's, lock still 1, win == ''

feature: Not tuned while an app holds the frequency or mode: 'Channel not tuned' names which, the window stays
how_to_confirm: With an app holding the frequency (e.g. WSPR hopping), press a channel: state freq unchanged, message on a screenshot, win still 'Channels'

feature: Add stores the current VFO (freq, mode, AGC, PRE, ATT) at the end; Delete removes the one under the cursor; Edit renames ('Channel name' keyboard); Drag/Drop reorders with the MFK
how_to_confirm: Press Add: GET /api/channels gains the VFO's entry last; Drag, knob mfk -1, Drop: order changes in GET; Delete: entry gone; restore the list after

feature: Hand mic V/M opens the window (not over WeFax, NavTex, SSTV, JS8, PSK, Olivia, JTTY); UP/DOWN tune the channel after/before the last one tuned and show its name, not while an app holds the frequency (LOCK lets them through)
how_to_confirm: The H-22's keys are not on the remote (on the X6100 try 'key VM': win == 'Channels'); owner presses UP: state freq becomes the next channel's

feature: Up to 100 channels, shared with the web Memories page: a page change shows on the radio within seconds unless the window is open; a change in the window writes its list over the file
how_to_confirm: POST /api/channels a test channel: within 5 s open 124 lists it; adding past 100 is refused (API error)

feature: Memories page: Save/Delete/Up/Down name the channel as shown and change nothing if the list changed meanwhile (message, radio's list shown); changes go one at a time; entries the radio leaves out and unreadable files (1e400) are left alone; Undo of a delete restores it at its place
how_to_confirm: DELETE /api/channels/<i> after changing the list from the radio: refused with a message and the file unchanged; POST /api/channels/restore puts a deleted one back at its index

feature: Channels/MEM slots take 0.1-55 MHz and 70-500 MHz (transverter) on the X6100, 0.1-1000 MHz on the X6200
how_to_confirm: POST /api/channels at 60 MHz: refused on the X6100, accepted on the X6200; 145 MHz accepted on both

feature: A Save changes only what was changed: an unchanged name/frequency the page would not take (non-ASCII, over 31 bytes) stays as in the file, as do other keys
how_to_confirm: Write a channel with an extra key and a 40-byte name to channels.json over SSH; PUT /api/channels/<i> changing only the frequency: the name and extra key survive

feature: A channel named WEFAX... also shows in the WeFax app's Freq. list (dial 1.5 kHz below the station)
how_to_confirm: POST /api/channels 'WEFAX TEST' at 7793.5 kHz; open WeFax, Freq. list: it is listed (screenshot)

feature: Scanner (APP 4:6 or long-press), receive only; ESC closes and the radio returns to its frequency and mode; bands it visited keep their own memory
how_to_confirm: Note state freq/mode; open 127, Start, wait; close: state freq/mode as before; win == ''

feature: Source: Channels (their modes), Airband 118-137 MHz AM 25 kHz (X6200), HF Air (the HF Air Band app's area, USB), CB (the CB app's plan and mode), Segment (the band plan segment the dial is in: 3 kHz SSB, 500 Hz CW, 5 kHz AM)
how_to_confirm: Per source, Start and sample state freq/mode every 300 ms: values step through the expected list (Airband 118.000, 118.025 ... AM, X6200 only)

feature: Start / Pause / Resume (from the channel the dial is on, else the top); Skip on to the next from a stop or pause; main knob pauses where tuned; while paused the MFK steps by hand
how_to_confirm: Start; Pause: state freq stops changing; Skip: it moves one entry; knob main 1: paused there; knob mfk 1 steps one entry

feature: Lock out leaves the current frequency out until the list changes; Clear forgets learnt levels, lockouts and the heard list
how_to_confirm: Pause on entry N, Lock out, Resume: state freq never equals N's again; Clear: it comes back

feature: Speed Fast/Normal/Slow: 120/250/500 ms per frequency (Fast 150-200 ms in practice)
how_to_confirm: With Speed set, time between state freq changes over 20 steps averages ~150-200 / 250 / 500 ms

feature: Stop at Auto (10 dB over each frequency's learnt quiet level), S3, S5, S7, S9; Hang 2/5/10 s of quiet before going on; the S-meter bar shows the stop mark; the right side lists stops (time, freq, name, level, duration)
how_to_confirm: Pads: radio B keys 1 W on one Channels/Segment entry in a ham band; A stops there (state freq constant, 'm' up), resumes Hang seconds after B unkeys; the heard list shows the entry (screenshot)

feature: Keying (PTT, TCI, a remote session) holds the scan on the frequency as busy; hang counts from the end of the over; nothing retunes while transmitting
how_to_confirm: Pads, 1 W: while scanning, key PTT 1 for 3 s on radio A: state freq frozen during tx, scan goes on Hang seconds after key PTT 0

feature: HF Air Band (APP 5:6 or long-press): ESC closes, the radio stays where it is
how_to_confirm: open 204: win == 'HF Air Band'; tune a row, close: state freq stays

feature: Area cycles Europe/Africa/Middle East, Americas, Asia and Pacific, Worldwide LDOC, All areas; kept; default by the IARU region
how_to_confirm: Press Area: params.db aero_area increments; headings change (screenshot)

feature: Headings (VOLMET first) with a row per frequency and the EiBi station on the air there now; the row the radio is on is marked
how_to_confirm: Screenshot/OCR: VOLMET heading first, Shannon VOLMET on 5505 in Europe

feature: MFK press, Tune or a tap tunes the frequency in USB through the radio's own tuning; not while transmitting
how_to_confirm: knob mfk 1, key MFK: state freq is the row's kHz, mode USB

feature: Save channel names it after the station or the row ('NAT 8891'); Scan opens the Scanner on this list (Source HF Air)
how_to_confirm: Save channel: GET /api/channels has 'Shannon VOLMET' or 'NAT 8891'; Scan: win == 'Scanner'

feature: PTT on these non-amateur frequencies is refused ('No TX on 8.891 MHz', 'Out of band: Settings > TX Cal') unless TX outside ham bands is on
how_to_confirm: Check params.db tx_outside_bands = 0 first (never key otherwise); key PTT 1 for 1 s: state tx stays 0, message on a screenshot

feature: CB app (APP 5:6 or long-press): channels of a plan with frequency, mode and purpose; ESC closes, the radio stays
how_to_confirm: open 205: win == 'CB'

feature: Plan cycles Europe (CEPT), Germany 80, UK 27/81, USA (FCC), Australia, Poland, Band A/B/D/E; kept; default from the station country else the IARU region; channel 23 between 22 and 24 in frequency
how_to_confirm: Press Plan: params.db cb_plan changes; tune channel 1: 26.965 MHz (Europe), 27.60125 (UK), 26.960 (Poland)

feature: Mode steps through the plan's modes (its own first); single-mode channels (Germany 41-80 FM, Australia 11 AM / 16 LSB) are tuned in that mode ('CB 50: FM only')
how_to_confirm: Press Mode: params.db cb_mode changes; tune Germany channel 50: state mode FM whatever Mode says, message shown

feature: MFK press or a tap tunes the channel in its mode through the radio's own tuning; not while transmitting
how_to_confirm: Europe channel 19: state freq 27185000 and the plan mode

feature: Knob: Channels (default) steps the main knob channel to channel in plan numbering, shows the channel big, sets its mode; Free tunes as always; off the plan or with LOCK it behaves as always
how_to_confirm: On channel 22, knob main 1: state freq = channel 23's (27.255), then 24's; set cb_knob Free: knob main 1 moves by the step

feature: Save channel stores 'CB 19' in Channels; Scan opens the Scanner on the plan (Source CB)
how_to_confirm: Save: GET /api/channels has 'CB 19'; Scan: win == 'Scanner'

feature: PTT on CB is refused ('No TX on 27.185 MHz') unless TX outside ham bands is on; power is not set by the app
how_to_confirm: Check tx_outside_bands = 0 first; key PTT 1: state tx stays 0, message on a screenshot

feature: Flights (APP 5:6 or long-press): nothing received or retuned by the radio; ESC closes
how_to_confirm: Note state freq; open 203: win == 'Flights', freq unchanged; close

feature: Plot (north up, you in the middle, range rings, dots with track strokes, named when 15 or fewer, ground grey, emergency red) and list (nearest first: flight/registration/hex, type, altitude m, speed km/h, distance/bearing); MFK chooses one, two detail lines
how_to_confirm: open 203 and wait 5 s: /tmp/x6100-flights.json has aircraft; screenshot/OCR rows match its nearest entries; knob mfk 1 changes the detail lines

feature: Range 25/50/100 (default)/200/400 km, kept until switched off
how_to_confirm: Press Range: the ring labels change (screenshot)

feature: Update (or MFK press) asks now; otherwise on opening then every 20 s (60 s from adsb.lol), only while open and lit, never in the background; app and web page share an answer for 10 s
how_to_confirm: Watch /tmp/x6100-flights.json mtime: refreshed ~20 s apart while open, unchanged after close; Update refreshes it at once

feature: Plot centred on GPS, else the phone's position (Panel GPS, no coarser than 1 km, < 10 min), else the QTH locator; header says which; with none it asks for a locator and fetches nothing
how_to_confirm: Remote 'pos 39.99 -83.11 20' then open 203: header reads Phone (screenshot); without pos: Locator EN80kc

feature: Data from airplanes.live, adsb.lol as fallback; bottom line names the source and fetch time; sends only the position rounded to 0.1 deg, the range and 'OpenX6X00/<version>', never the callsign
how_to_confirm: OCR the bottom line for the source; tcpdump on the radio (if present) or the cached request shows lat/lon with one decimal and no callsign

feature: Web Operating > Flights: plot and list in the browser, Range and a Centre locator box; asks only while the page is in view
how_to_confirm: GET /flights 200; GET /api/flights returns JSON aircraft; with a Centre locator /tmp/x6100-flights-web.json is written

feature: Internet radio (APP 4:6, Web radio tile, long-press) opens on favourites, else the country's stations, else the countries; lists ordered by popularity (100 max), * marks favourites
how_to_confirm: open 201: win == 'Internet radio'; screenshot shows the favourites from /mnt/iradio/favorites.tsv

feature: Play / Stop (MFK press or tap): plays on the speaker at VOL (or Bluetooth headphones standing in), header Connecting/Playing/Stopped/Error, station, format, bitrate, now-playing title; stops on window close, Stop or another app
how_to_confirm: Play an MP3 favourite: pidof mpg123 (or ffmpeg) on the radio, header 'Playing' (OCR); key GEN: the player process is gone

feature: Favourite toggles the selected station in/out of /mnt/iradio/favorites.tsv
how_to_confirm: In the country list press Favourite: the station's line appears in favorites.tsv; press again: removed

feature: List cycles Favourites, country, world's most listened, last search; Country chooses from the directory's countries (kept in /mnt/iradio/country); Search by name or genre tag, or a stream URL that goes straight to the favourites
how_to_confirm: Press Country, choose one: /mnt/iradio/country holds it; Search 'jazz' lists stations (screenshot); search 'http://...' adds it to favorites.tsv

feature: MP3 everywhere (mpg123); AAC, Ogg, Opus, FLAC and HLS with the image's ffmpeg, else MP3-only lists and 'not playable' favourites; playlists (.pls/.m3u/.asx/.xspf) play their first stream; a dropped station retried 3 times
how_to_confirm: Play an AAC station on both radios: ffmpeg runs and the header says Playing; GET /api/iradio reports whether the image plays more than MP3

feature: Error says why a station did not play ('not a stream: a web page', 'the station answered HTTP 404')
how_to_confirm: POST /api/iradio a favourite pointing at a web page; play it: header Error with 'not a stream: a web page' (OCR)

feature: Playback stops as soon as the radio transmits, whatever keys it; nothing in it keys the radio
how_to_confirm: Pads, 1 W: play a station, key PTT 1: the player process ends and the header says Stopped; key PTT 0: it does not resume by itself

feature: While a station plays the speaker plays it in place of the receiver; the receiver comes back at Stop
how_to_confirm: By ear at the radio (or record the speaker): station audio, then receiver noise after Stop

feature: A Zello message or an SVXConnect over (with the Simplex repeater session on) drops the station out and it comes back after, on speaker and headphones
how_to_confirm: With a station playing and a Zello channel connected, a message arrives (from the owner's phone or the other radio's RF>Zello): screenshot shows the talker and the station paused, then resumed

feature: A list is fetched when shown and kept an hour (countries a day); the stream only while playing; nothing while closed; says 'OpenX6X00/<version>', counts a click, picks a random directory server
how_to_confirm: With the window closed, no connections to radio-browser.info (ss on the radio) for 5 minutes; reopening the same list within an hour makes no new request

feature: Web Operating > Internet radio: favourites add (name + stream address), edit, move up, delete; says whether this image plays more than MP3; writes /mnt/iradio/favorites.tsv
how_to_confirm: GET /iradio 200; POST /api/iradio a test station, PUT rename, POST /api/iradio/<id>/up, DELETE: favorites.tsv follows each step

feature: Web Operating > Zello: user name, password, developer key Issuer and Private Key (shown only Set/Not set, user name as two characters), channels one a line (20 max), Clear account; kept in /mnt/zello for root, never logged, not in Backup or on the Files page
how_to_confirm: The owner enters the real account once. Then GET /zello 200; GET /api/zello shows Set/Not set and never the password or key; ls -l /mnt/zello root-only; the Files page lists no zello secrets

feature: Test (web): logs on with the saved account on the first channel and off again ('Logged on: Test channel, 3 online')
how_to_confirm: Precondition: account saved by the owner. POST /api/zello/test returns 'Logged on: <channel>, N online'

feature: Zello app: MFK + press (or Connect) joins a channel; top line Connecting / channel + online count / not online / 'lost: again in 4 s'; press again or Disconnect leaves; Reload channels after a web change
how_to_confirm: open 202: win == 'Zello'; knob mfk to a channel, key MFK: OCR the top line for the channel and 'online'; Disconnect: top line changes; /mnt/app_logs/zello.txt logs the connection

feature: Channel messages play on the speaker at VOL (or Bluetooth headphones), the talker named; between messages the receiver
how_to_confirm: Connected; a message on the channel (owner's phone or the other radio's RF>Zello): OCR the talker line; zello.txt logs the message

feature: Talk: hold the radio's PTT key (or Talk) and speak into the hand mic without its PTT; built-in mic unusable; 'No audio: talking on Zello uses the hand mic' after 3 s with none; 2 minutes max
how_to_confirm: Owner talks with the hand mic; the message reaches the channel (phone app); without a hand mic the 3 s message appears (screenshot)

feature: While the app is open the PTT key talks on Zello and never keys the radio; it keys the radio again once the app closes; a PTT held when the app opened stays the radio's
how_to_confirm: Pads in case it keys. Open 202 and key PTT 1 (if the remote's PTT is the radio's PTT key): state tx stays 0; close the app, key PTT 1 briefly: tx 1 at 1 W

feature: Talk via (page 2): Hand mic or Bluetooth (a headset mic); 'No BT mic' while none (radio keeps headsets on A2DP, so normally none)
how_to_confirm: Toggle Talk via: params.db zello_talk_bt flips; Talk then reads 'No BT mic' (screenshot)

feature: While the radio transmits for anything else (hand mic PTT, CAT, TCI, browser PTT, an app, the tuner) channel audio pauses and a message being sent ends; back 0.5 s after RX
how_to_confirm: Connected, pads, 1 W: key the radio via TCI during an incoming message: zello.txt shows the message cut/paused; screenshot after unkey shows it playing again

feature: Connected only while the app is open on a channel or the Simplex repeater is on; ESC leaves; nothing at power on; reconnects at once then 1,2,4..30 s; a refused account is said once and not retried; report in /mnt/app_logs/zello.txt (no secrets)
how_to_confirm: Connect then ESC: ss shows the Zello connection closed; zello.txt has the connect/close lines and no password/key/token (grep)

feature: Zello>RF (page 2): channel messages transmitted on the frequency in the radio's mode (LSB/USB/AM/FM, never CW/data) at the voice-message level, unkey at the end; replaces the speaker; needs SQL > 0, the callsign while CW ID is on; power at most 7 W and the band's limit
how_to_confirm: Pads, pwr 1, 20 m USB, SQL set: radio A Zello>RF on and connected; a channel message arrives: A's state tx 1 with 't' W <= 1; radio B on 20 m sees its S-meter rise for the message length

feature: RF>Zello (page 2): what the receiver hears while the squelch is open goes to the channel, ending 1.5 s after it closes
how_to_confirm: Pads: radio A RF>Zello on, connected; radio B keys 1 W on A's frequency for 5 s: A's top line / zello.txt shows a message sent to the channel of ~6.5 s

feature: Both directions need the squelch: they can't be turned on with SQL 0 and pause with '(no SQL)' on the main screen if SQL goes to 0
how_to_confirm: set sql 0; press Zello>RF: params.db zello_to_rf stays 0; with it on, set sql 0: main screen shows '(no SQL)' (screenshot)

feature: CW ID (800 Hz, 20 WPM; end of the first transmission then each 5-120 min, default 60, or Off; owed ID sent when Zello>RF is turned off); TX limit 30-300 s (120); Pause 1-30 s (3) between transmissions
how_to_confirm: Settings readable in params.db (zello_id, zello_id_min, zello_limit, zello_pause). Pads: after the first relayed message radio B's CW decoder reads A's callsign; with TX limit 30 a long message unkeys at 30 s (tx 0)

feature: The link keys only inside the amateur bands or an enabled transverter range, whatever TX outside ham bands says: 'Link: amateur bands only', button 'No ham band', main screen 'Z>RF(no ham band)'; tuned out mid-message it unkeys
how_to_confirm: Tune 27.185 MHz with Zello>RF on: button reads 'No ham band', main screen tag 'Z>RF(no ham band)' (screenshot), state tx never 1

feature: RF>Zello outside the bands: off by default ('Link: amateur bands only, nothing to Zello', 'RF>Z(no ham band)'); with TX outside ham bands on it goes with a licence warning ('Outside bands'); split: Zello>RF judges the TX frequency, RF>Zello the RX one
how_to_confirm: Tune a broadcast frequency with RF>Zello on: button 'No ham band' and the message (screenshot); nothing reaches the channel (zello.txt)

feature: Never over anyone: no key while the squelch is open, the radio transmits for anything else, you talk on Zello, or 0.5 s after; the radio's PTT (or any PTT through the radio) unkeys the link at once; no loop back to Zello
how_to_confirm: Pads: while A relays a message (tx 1), key PTT on A via TCI or the remote: the relay unkeys (link tag no longer [TX]); while B keys into A (squelch open) a channel message is held until it closes

feature: Main screen 'ZELLO LINK' tag with Z>RF/RF>Z, '...' when off the channel, red [TX]/[ID], [RX>Z], 'Z>RF(off)'; app top line SIMPLEX REPEATER; closing the app keeps the link ('Zello link stays on'), Disconnect stops it, off after a restart; switches kept
how_to_confirm: Connect with a direction on, ESC: screenshot shows 'ZELLO LINK' and the message; ss shows the connection kept; restart the GUI: no connection, params.db zello_to_rf still set

feature: One link at a time: while SVXConnect's Simplex repeater is on, Zello's switches say so and stay off, and the other way round
how_to_confirm: Turn SVX>RF on (params.db svx_to_rf 1), open Zello, press Zello>RF: it stays off with the message (screenshot); reverse the test

feature: Web Operating > SVXConnect: callsign, e-mail, reflector host[:port 5300], Switchable and Monitored talkgroups with + priorities (32 max), Start on, Locked, Linger (30), Idle (0), TX time-out (30-600, 120), Roger beep, Location; Save writes /mnt/svxconnect/svxconnect.conf whole
how_to_confirm: GET /svxconnect 200; POST /api/svxconnect with test values, cat /mnt/svxconnect/svxconnect.conf over SSH, restore the original after; a TX time-out of 20 is refused

feature: Certificate: Request makes a key and sends a CSR to the reflector, 'Waiting for the sysop to sign the request' polled every 30 s; Stop / new Request continue it; signed shows validity and renewal; with one, Request checks it with the reflector; Remove certificate
how_to_confirm: Needs a reflector sysop to sign: POST /api/svxconnect/enroll; GET /api/svxconnect shows the waiting state; /mnt/app_logs/svxconnect-enroll.txt written

feature: Key, request and certificate in /mnt/svxconnect/pki, never shown or logged, not in Backup or the Files page; settings in the Backup's apps' lists
how_to_confirm: GET /api/svxconnect contains no PEM; GET /files/svxconnect/pki/... refused; backup download contains svxconnect.conf but no pki

feature: Connect (page 1) logs in with the saved settings; top line Connecting / reflector, selected talkgroup (locked), node count / why not ('certificate missing, expired, not yet valid'); reconnects by itself
how_to_confirm: Precondition: a signed certificate. open 206: win == 'SVXConnect'; Connect: OCR the top line; without a certificate the line says it is missing (this part needs none)

feature: Talkgroup table (> selected, + priority, 'listen' monitored-only, talker and time); MFK + press selects a switchable one; Lock keeps it; Recent lists the last overs (call, TG, ago, length)
how_to_confirm: Connected: knob mfk to a switchable TG, key MFK: '>' moves (screenshot); Lock: top line says locked

feature: The selected talkgroup's overs play on the speaker at VOL; the talker named; between overs the receiver; an over wins over the Internet radio
how_to_confirm: Connected to a busy TG: the talker line and Recent fill in (OCR); /mnt/app_logs/svxconnect.txt logs the overs

feature: Talk: hold the radio's PTT key (or Talk) and speak into the hand mic; to the selected TG; 'not sent: X is talking on TG 8'; ends at the TX time-out; 'No audio: talking on SVXConnect uses the hand mic'
how_to_confirm: Owner talks; the over shows in Recent on the other radio connected to the same TG

feature: Talk via, the PTT key held by the app, the pause while the radio transmits and the connection rules are as in Zello
how_to_confirm: Pads: with 206 open, key PTT 1 (radio's PTT key): state tx stays 0; params.db svx_talk_bt toggles with Talk via

feature: /mnt/app_logs/svxconnect.txt and svxconnect-enroll.txt for problem reports, never the key
how_to_confirm: After a Connect attempt both files exist; grep for 'PRIVATE KEY' finds nothing

feature: SVX>RF and RF>SVX (page 2): the selected talkgroup's overs transmitted on the frequency, the receiver (squelch open) sent to the talkgroup; RF>SVX needs a selected TG and is refused while someone talks on it
how_to_confirm: Pads, 1 W, SQL set: radio B keys 5 s into A with RF>SVX on: A's Recent/top line shows its own over to the TG; an incoming over with SVX>RF on keys A (tx 1, 't' <= 1 W) and B's S-meter rises

feature: CW ID, TX limit and Pause as Zello's, same defaults (svx_id, svx_id_min, svx_limit, svx_pause)
how_to_confirm: Settings in params.db; pads: B's CW decoder reads A's callsign after the first relayed over

feature: Amateur bands only ('Link: amateur bands only', 'No ham band'); RF>SVX outside the bands only with TX outside ham bands on and the warning 'RF>SVX: outside the amateur bands, check your licence', else 'nothing to SVX'
how_to_confirm: Tune 27.185 MHz with SVX>RF on: button 'No ham band' (screenshot), tx never 1

feature: A talker on a higher-priority talkgroup pulls the selection over and its overs go on the air too; Lock for a link relaying one TG
how_to_confirm: Monitored TG with +++ gets a talker: '>' moves to it (screenshot); with Lock on it stays

feature: Main screen 'SVX LINK' with S>RF/RF>S, red [TX]/[ID], [RX>S]; closing the app keeps the link ('SVXConnect link stays on'); Disconnect stops; nothing at power on
how_to_confirm: Connect with a direction on, ESC: tag on the main screen (screenshot), svxconnect process still running (pidof svxconnect); after a GUI restart it is not

feature: Weather (APP 6:6, tile before Settings, long-press): nothing received, retuned or keyed; ESC closes
how_to_confirm: Note state freq; open 200: win == 'Weather', freq unchanged; close

feature: Now: temperature, sky, feels-like, low/high, sunrise/sunset, wind/gusts, humidity, pressure, rain chance and amount, clouds, dew point, visibility, UV, the place's highest warning on its colour or none; place's own time with zone abbreviation; metric units
how_to_confirm: open 200: /tmp/x6100-meteo.json written; OCR the temperature and compare with the JSON; times carry a zone abbreviation

feature: 5 days: each day's high/low, sky, rain chance and amount, strongest wind and gusts, UV 3+
how_to_confirm: Press 5 days: five rows (OCR) matching the JSON's daily values

feature: Warnings: each warning in force (level, what, from/to, issued, areas, the service's text and instructions), the place's own first (*here*), then nearby; MFK scrolls; in Now and 5 days the MFK goes to the next view
how_to_confirm: Press Warnings: screenshot shows the list or 'none in force'; knob mfk 1 scrolls; in Now, knob mfk 1 switches view

feature: Update (or MFK press) asks now; on opening and every 15 min while open and lit, not in the background (unless Notices on); the app and web page share an answer for 2 min
how_to_confirm: Press Update: /tmp/x6100-meteo.json mtime updates; after close no update for 20 min (Notices off)

feature: Where: GPS, else the phone's position (Panel GPS, <= 1 km, < 10 min), else the QTH locator centre, else the station country's capital; header GPS / Phone / Locator X / Country Y; with none it says what to set
how_to_confirm: Remote 'pos 39.99 -83.11 20', open 200: header 'Phone' (screenshot); without pos: 'Locator EN80kc'

feature: Sends the position rounded to 0.1 deg, the screen language and 'OpenX6X00/<version>', never the callsign; the place name from Nominatim only on open or Update (1/s, cached in /mnt/meteo/places.json, last 100); /mnt/meteo/nominatim.url sets another server or 'off' (locator shown)
how_to_confirm: After open, /mnt/meteo/places.json has the 0.1-degree square's name; with nominatim.url 'off' the header shows the locator; restore

feature: Warnings from the NWS (US), MeteoAlarm (38 countries, area-name matching: other orange/red as nearby, max 12), SMN Argentina and INMET Brazil (polygons: inside = own, 150 km = nearby); elsewhere (and when a service fails) worked out from the forecast and marked 'from the forecast'
how_to_confirm: Web Weather page Place box with locators in the US (EN80), Belgium (JO20), Argentina (FF55), Uruguay (GF15): GET /api/meteo answers name the service in the bottom line; Uruguay's warnings say 'from the forecast'

feature: Forecast-derived warnings for today/tomorrow: gusts 65/90/120 km/h, rain 50/100/150 mm, thunderstorms (hail orange), heat 36/40/44 C, cold -12/-20 C, UV 11+; each 'from the forecast'
how_to_confirm: For a place outside the services (web Place box), compare the JSON's forecast with the warnings listed: each threshold crossed gives one 'from the forecast' warning

feature: Web Operating > Weather: now, five days and warnings, a Place box by locator; every 15 minutes while in view; /tmp/x6100-meteo-web.json for a typed locator
how_to_confirm: GET /meteo 200; GET /api/meteo returns JSON for the radio's position; with a locator the answer differs and /tmp/x6100-meteo-web.json is written

feature: Notices (APP > Weather, Off by default, meteo_alerts): the app's bottom line and the web page say when on
how_to_confirm: Press Notices: params.db meteo_alerts flips; GET /api/meteo (or the page) shows notices on; turn back off

feature: With Notices on the radio checks 2 min after start then every 30 min (Open-Meteo + the service, never Nominatim; none while the app is open); a new warning for the place (service yellow+ / NWS Moderate+, forecast orange+) shows 10 s in the message box, once each (kept in /mnt/meteo/seen), only while receiving with the screen lit and the app closed
how_to_confirm: Notices on, GUI restart: an Open-Meteo request ~2 min later (ss / tcpdump); a real warning in force gives the message box (screenshot) and an entry in /mnt/meteo/seen; with Notices off no background request

feature: Settings > Bluetooth DEVICES: Scan (16 s); an MFK press on a *new* device pairs, trusts and connects it and opens the pairing window; Activity row says what or why it failed; paired devices: Connect/Disconnect, Connect at startup, Forget
how_to_confirm: Headphones in pairing mode; Scan; press: over SSH 'bluetoothctl info <MAC>' Paired yes, Connected yes; Activity row on a screenshot

feature: HEADPHONES: RX to headphones (PulseAudio loopback from alsa_input.platform-sound.stereo-fallback, mono, ~0.4-0.7 s late) and Volume (the sink's volume)
how_to_confirm: Connected headphones: 'pactl list short modules' shows the loopback to the bluez sink; change Volume: 'pactl list sinks' volume follows

feature: Mute speaker: AF volume and TX monitor 0 while headphones are connected, the previous values back on disconnect; AF volume does not change the headphone audio
how_to_confirm: Remote state vol and moni go 0 on connect and back on disconnect; spk/muted keys follow

feature: Only A2DP: PulseAudio has no headset backend (rootfs/etc/pulse/system.pa.d/btaudio.pa), which also keeps a phone/PC's A2DP stream out of the TX audio; the radio as a PC's speaker plays nowhere; no microphone (HFP/HSP) offered
how_to_confirm: Over SSH the btaudio.pa on the radio has no headset backend; 'sdptool browse local' shows no HFP/HSP audio gateway record

feature: A paired PC/phone sees the radio as an A2DP speaker; what it sends is dropped and never reaches the TX audio
how_to_confirm: Pair a PC, play audio to the radio: 'pactl list short source-outputs' has no loopback of the bluez source; a TX at 1 W on the pads carries no PC audio

feature: CW on headphones: X6100 hears its base's full-scale sidetone (late); the X6200's base puts it in at about -89 dBFS (nearly nothing, #192)
how_to_confirm: By ear with headphones while keying CW into the pads

feature: WiFi runs at 20 MHz only to leave room for Bluetooth
how_to_confirm: Over SSH 'iw dev wlan0 info' (or iw link) shows width 20 MHz

feature: Keyboards found by Scan marked *keyboard* (unnamed: 'Keyboard' + address); press the keyboard's pairing key when asked; a code to type shows on the Activity row; a keyboard with a new address is found by name
how_to_confirm: Rii X1 Plus in pairing mode (Fn+Tab): Scan lists it as keyboard; pair; 'bluetoothctl info' Paired yes; a key typed appears in a text field (screenshot)

feature: Pairings backed up to /mnt/backups/bluetooth.tgz and restored at the first start of a new image (S39btpairings); a radio with its own pairings keeps them
how_to_confirm: Over SSH: /mnt/backups/bluetooth.tgz exists and 'tar tzf' lists the adapter's paired device directories matching 'bluetoothctl devices Paired'

feature: btcat opens the real CAT UART /dev/ttyS2 and bind-mounts a pty over it; USB CAT and up to 3 Bluetooth clients share it (one request at a time, replies to the asker, transceive to all); logs /tmp/btcat.log, /tmp/btcat-setup.log
how_to_confirm: Over SSH: pidof btcat; findmnt /dev/ttyS2 shows the bind mount; Settings > Bluetooth Clients row shows 0 (not 'bridge not running') on a screenshot; the two logs exist

feature: Bluetooth adapter power switch (ADAPTER card)
how_to_confirm: Read only: 'bluetoothctl show' Powered matches the switch. Do not switch it off on the X6200 (WiFi stalls)

feature: Pairing (3 min): visible and pairable, label counts down, then off by itself; new devices marked trusted and pairings saved on /mnt; outside the window the radio is hidden and the agent refuses
how_to_confirm: Switch Pairing on: 'bluetoothctl show' Discoverable yes, Pairable yes; after 3 min both no; the label counts down (screenshot)

feature: CAT accepts paired devices only (RFCOMM security medium)
how_to_confirm: From an unpaired Linux PC 'rfcomm connect /dev/rfcomm0 <radio MAC> 1' fails; after pairing it connects

feature: A paired PC/phone gets a serial port (rfcomm channel 1, COM/SPP on Windows/Android) carrying the radio's CI-V CAT; the Clients row counts it
how_to_confirm: Paired PC: rfcomm connect, send CI-V read-frequency (FE FE <addr> E0 03 FD): the reply's frequency equals the remote state freq; Clients row shows 1

feature: Bluetooth GPS (NMEA over SPP, e.g. GLO 2): Scan, press it when *new*, press again for 'GPS for gpsd' on; tag GPS, note 'gpsd reads it'; also on the web Direction finder's GPS card
how_to_confirm: GLO 2 on: after the steps, /tmp/btgps.state 'connected'; GET /api/btgps names it; screenshot shows the GPS tag

feature: btgps-bridge gives gpsd a pseudo-terminal (/var/run/btgps.tty while connected) since the kernel makes no Bluetooth serial devices; positions at 10 Hz feed page I, the bearing log and anything reading gpsd
how_to_confirm: Over SSH: /var/run/btgps.tty is a link to a pty; 'gpspipe -w -n 20' shows TPV from it once fixed

feature: btgps-ctl reconnects: 10 s after a drop, doubling to 5 minutes (a new choice restarts at 10 s), ~5 s a try; log /tmp/btgps.log
how_to_confirm: Switch the GLO 2 off: /tmp/btgps.state 'trying', btgps.log tries at ~10, 20, 40 s ...; switch it on: connected within the current wait

feature: GPS for gpsd Off: no connection tries at all (they stalled the X6200's WiFi)
how_to_confirm: POST /api/btgps Off (or the setting): /tmp/btgps.state 'off'; /tmp/btgps.log gets no new tries for 5 minutes

feature: Web Direction finder's GPS card: Bluetooth GPS, a paired device or Off
how_to_confirm: GET /api/btgps lists paired devices and the choice; POST the current choice back: 200 and unchanged

feature: 'GoldCorpHF TCI' Bluetooth serial service on RFCOMM channel 22, class UUID 1d21eea1-57bf-4f53-9ad6-721d624f2e67 (CAT keeps channel 1); logged 'tci: service registered' in /tmp/bt_pair.log
how_to_confirm: Over SSH 'sdptool browse local' lists the UUID on channel 22; grep 'tci: service registered' /tmp/bt_pair.log

feature: The same TCI WebSocket over the RFCOMM link (same HTTP upgrade; no Origin = a TCI program); paired, encrypted devices only; GUI log 'tci: Bluetooth ... connected'
how_to_confirm: Paired PC: connect RFCOMM 22, send the upgrade request: TCI 'protocol:'/'vfo:' lines arrive; an unpaired PC is refused

feature: A Bluetooth client's first key asks on the screen 'Bluetooth AA:BB:.. (name) wants to transmit'; Always keeps the address in the TCI page's Allowed list
how_to_confirm: Pads, 1 W: the BT client sends 'trx:0,true;': screenshot shows the question, state tx stays 0 until answered

feature: TCI off (Settings > General > TCI SERVER or web System > TCI) closes and refuses Bluetooth TCI too; Listen only applies to it
how_to_confirm: POST /api/tci disabled: the BT client's link closes and a reconnect fails; enable again

feature: A Bluetooth client's TX ends at once when the link/WebSocket closes, after 0.5 s without its TX audio when keyed with audio, after 5 s of silence otherwise (pings every 2 s), and after 3 minutes for every client
how_to_confirm: Pads, 1 W: BT client keys then drops the RFCOMM link: state tx 0 within 1 s; keys and stops answering pings: tx 0 within ~5 s

feature: Up to 4 TCI clients in all, network and Bluetooth together
how_to_confirm: Open five WebSockets to port 50001: four get the TCI init lines, the fifth is refused/closed

feature: Settings > Display > INTERFACE > Theme (and the web Display page's Theme card) applies the new theme at once (from the web card the screen restarts with it)
how_to_confirm: POST /api/display theme Classic: params.db theme changes and a screenshot differs from the previous; restore

feature: Sentry is the default on both radios: amber on black over every app and menu, spectrum and waterfall in its gradient (a card that chose another keeps it)
how_to_confirm: params.db theme on a default card is Sentry; screenshot pixels dominantly amber on black; same on both radios

feature: Every built-in theme (Sentry, RF.Guru, Classic with Arial, Outdoor, Outdoor-Negative, VISION, Black Metal, Total Black, 1bit, Amber Trey) renders alike on both radios
how_to_confirm: For each theme set it on both radios, screenshot the main screen and an app (e.g. open 119): the two radios' pictures match except for radio-specific values

feature: VISION: big type, S-meter on its own row always as bars; Field Ops shows five and a half tiles
how_to_confirm: Set VISION: screenshot shows the S-meter row; open 118: 5.5 tiles visible

feature: Black Metal / Total Black (2E0JFS): two state rows on top, S/SWR/ALC scales by a big frequency with small 10 Hz digits, other VFO and A/B badge, span edges, buttons in capitals ('VOLUME 30'); Total Black on pure black with a thin line on the buttons
how_to_confirm: Set each: OCR the bottom buttons in capitals; screenshot shows the state rows

feature: 1bit: black on white like a monochrome LCD, pixel font, inverted boxes, segment S-meter, bar spectrum, dotted waterfall
how_to_confirm: Set 1bit: every screenshot pixel is black or white
