feature: Modem Mercury (experimental, 1.9.21): with Winlink on, Pat and ARDOP stop, x6x00-mercury and Pat start; Modem row 'Mercury on the radio's audio'; ports 8300/8301/8100 on 127.0.0.1; settings /run/winlink/mercury.ini
how_to_confirm: POST Modem Mercury: pidof x6x00-mercury, no ardopcf; 'ss -ltn' shows 127.0.0.1:8300/8301/8100 only; GET /api/winlink Modem row; switch back to ARDOP

feature: Mercury's load: ~39 % of the X6100 listening (18 % with ARDOP); the Modem row turns red 'Ready, but it fell behind the receiver lately' and Pat's log says so when a decoder drops audio
how_to_confirm: With Mercury listening 10 minutes: top shows its CPU; GET /api/winlink Modem row not red; compare the X6200 (not measured yet)

feature: Mercury calls by VARA HF transport (station to station; it does not answer); bandwidth 500/2300/2750 with the RX filter covering 450-2550 / 1200-1800 Hz; a key stopped after 40 s; no CW ID
how_to_confirm: Pads, 1 W: A with Mercury connects vara to B's call on 20 m: A keys (tx 1), B's mercury.log shows the frames received; a key never lasts over 40 s

feature: Last connection explains 'Pat called through ARDOP, but the radio runs Mercury/XARA', 'Mercury/XARA was not ready', a bandwidth the modem does not have
how_to_confirm: With Mercury chosen, Pat connect ardop: no TX and GET /api/winlink last connection gives the mismatch message

feature: Modem XARA (experimental, 0.1.3, VARA HF compatible): needs a valid callsign (1-7 letters/digits, SSID -1..-19, not N0CALL) or Status says so and it doesn't start; commands 127.0.0.1:8300, data 8301; /run/winlink/xara.conf
how_to_confirm: POST Modem XARA with callsign N0CALL: status names the problem, no xara process; with the real call: xara runs, ss shows 127.0.0.1:8300/8301; switch back

feature: VARA HF licence box off: VARA's free speed levels; ticked (owner's statement): full speed; the Modem row says which
how_to_confirm: Toggle the box: GET /api/winlink Modem row 'VARA's free speed levels' / 'full speed (VARA HF licence ticked)'; restore off

feature: XARA calls (never answers; listening off); bandwidth 500/2300/2750 with filter 1240-1760 / 350-2650 / 120-2880 Hz; keys stopped after 30 s; CW ID with any callsign (~28 WPM) at session end, after an unanswered or cancelled call (a cancelled call ends at once)
how_to_confirm: Pads, 1 W: A calls B over VARA HF and cancels: A keys a few seconds more; B's CW decoder reads A's call; B's xara.log shows the call; B never keys

feature: The first channel list holds NAVTEX MF and HF, SHANNON VOLMET, the DWD RTTY stations and the DWD and GYA WeFax stations
how_to_confirm: GET /api/channels on a card whose list was never edited contains those names (else note it was edited)

feature: The speaker is quiet while the scan looks, so there is no burst of noise at every step
how_to_confirm: By ear at the radio during a scan (the remote state's spk/muted keys may show it; check whether they change)

feature: In AM the receiver filter must pass 100 Hz for the time code; it does on an X6200 by default
how_to_confirm: open 132 on the X6200: remote state flo <= 100 in AM

feature: With nothing connected ARDOP answers a DISC frame only when it ends our own last session within a minute; a DISC from anyone else no longer keys the radio
how_to_confirm: Pads: radio B's ardopcf sends a DISC (its host port over SSH) on A's frequency while A is idle: A's state tx stays 0

feature: The Panel page at http://<radio>/panel (Remote > Panel), and /panel#ft8|#cw|#log|#keys|#screen opening on that tab
how_to_confirm: HTTP GET http://<radio>/panel -> 200 with the panel HTML; in a headless browser /panel#log shows the Log tab active

feature: 'panel 1' subscribes to the radio's state as JSON on every change (freq, mode, flo, fhi, switches, levels, lock, ulock, kt, cwrise, rxo, app, win, pg ...)
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: 'panel 1' -> a 'state {...}' line parsing as JSON with every documented key; 'set vol N' -> a new state line with vol N; 'panel 0' stops the state lines

feature: Spectrum as binary frames to a panel client: 16-byte header {u16 0xFFFF, u16 bins, u32 centre Hz, u32 width Hz, u32 sequence} then one int8 dB per bin, about 15 a second
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 after 'panel 1': binary frames whose first u16 is 0xFFFF, length 16+bins, centre = state freq (or near), sequence increasing, ~15/s over 5 s; after 'set freq F' the centre follows

feature: Frequency set from the panel ('set freq HZ', the keypad in kHz, tap/drag on the panorama)
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 (operate, control): 'set freq 14074000' -> state freq 14074000; 'set freq 1' -> 'err freq: not a frequency this radio tunes' followed by the unchanged state

feature: BAND up/down from the panel ('set band +1|-1') following the band list
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: note 'bands [...]'; 'set band +1' -> state freq inside the next band of the list; 'set band -1' returns

feature: MODE from the panel ('set mode 0-7'; 8 SAM and 9 WFM on the X6200), refused for a mode the radio does not have
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: 'set mode 2' -> state mode 2; on the X6100 'set mode 8' -> 'err mode: not on this radio' + state; on the X6200 'set mode 9' -> state mode 9

feature: STEP and ZOOM (1-8) from the panel; the knob buttons tune by the step
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: 'set step N' -> state step N; 'set zoom 4' -> state zoom 4 and spectrum frame width shrinks accordingly; 'knob main 1' moves freq by one step

feature: VFO A/B toggle from the panel ('set vfo')
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: 'set vfo 1' (toggle) -> state vfo flips 0<->1; again -> back

feature: LOCK shows and sets the radio's frequency lock; a freq set under LOCK is refused
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: 'set lock 1' -> state lock 1 ulock 1; 'set freq F' -> 'err freq: locked (LOCK, or an app holds the frequency)' + state unchanged; 'set lock 0' -> lock 0

feature: While a digital app holds the frequency the state's lock is 1 with ulock 0, the freq is refused, and the user's LOCK stays as set
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: 'ft8 open' -> state app 'FT8', lock 1, ulock 0; 'set freq F' -> err freq: locked ...; 'set lock 0' leaves lock 1 (app hold stays); 'ft8 close' -> lock 0

feature: PRE, ATT, NB, NR, AGC (0-3) and ATU on/off from the panel
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: 'set pre 1', 'set att 1', 'set nb 1', 'set nr 1', 'set agc 2', 'set atu 0' -> each read back in state; restore after

feature: VOL (0-55 X6100, 0-100 X6200), SQL and RF GAIN (0-100) with - / + or a slider
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: after 'panel 1' read 'volmax 55|100'; 'set vol 20' -> state vol 20; 'set sql 10', 'set rfg 80' -> read back; out-of-range values clamp or are refused with err

feature: POWER in tenths of a watt: 1-100 on the X6100, 1-80 on the X6200, 1-50 there on battery; pwrmax announced
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: 'pwrmax 100' (X6100) / 'pwrmax 80' (X6200) after 'panel 1'; 'set pwr 5' -> state pwr 0.5; 'set pwr 200' -> state pwr at most pwrmax/10 W

feature: FILTER in SSB and DIG: both edges set by hand ('set filter LO HI'), presets 1.8-3.6 kHz
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 in USB: 'set filter 100 2900' -> state flo 100 fhi 2900; 'set filter 300 2400' -> read back

feature: FILTER in CW and CW-R: a width centred on the key tone (100 Hz to 1 kHz); one edge typed takes the other along
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 in CW: 'set filter LO HI' around kt -> state flo/fhi centred on state kt with width HI-LO, flo never below 0

feature: FILTER in AM, NFM and SAM: the high edge alone (2.5-6 kHz), the low edge always 0
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 in AM: 'set filter 0 4000' -> state flo 0 fhi 4000; 'set filter 500 4000' -> flo stays 0

feature: FILTER in WFM: high edge up to 10 kHz (presets 4-10 kHz)
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 on the X6200 in WFM (mode 9): 'set filter 0 9000' -> fhi 9000; 'set filter 0 20000' -> fhi capped at 10000

feature: No filter edge past 6 kHz (10 kHz in WFM)
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 in USB: 'set filter 100 9000' -> state fhi <= 6000 (or err + state unchanged)

feature: S-meter to panel clients ('m <dB>', ten a second)
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 after 'panel 1': count 'm <float>' lines over 5 s -> about 50, values plausible noise-floor dB

feature: Power, SWR and ALC while transmitting ('t <W> <SWR> <ALC>')
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: key the radio at <=1 W into the pad (key PTT lease or TUNE) -> 't W SWR ALC' lines with W > 0 and SWR near 1; none in RX

feature: Battery reading in the panel state
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: state 'bat' present and plausible (compare with the radio's own reading via SSH/screen)

feature: DX cluster spots as the radio filters them ('spots [...]'), newest first, tap tunes; calls on the waterfall, alerts orange
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 after 'panel 1' with the cluster connected: 'spots [...]' JSON arrives (again at most every 3 s on change); 'set freq' to a spot's frequency tunes

feature: FT8 tab Open/Close starts and ends the FT8/FT4/FT2 app on the radio
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: 'ft8 open' -> 'ft8 {"open":1,...}' and state app 'FT8'; 'ft8 close' -> ft8 open 0, app ''

feature: FT8 decodes to the page as 'ft8r {...}' (id, type, text, call, grid, audio Hz, SNR, to me, worked, distance, country); last rows kept for a later page
how_to_confirm: Radio B sends FT8 at <=1 W into the pad (tools/bench), radio A 'ft8 open': 'ft8r' rows with B's call, SNR, country; a second WS client opened afterwards receives the last rows
bench_has: bench.py radios-ft8, bench.py hackrf-ft8 (HF: outside today's HackRF rule)

feature: FT8 MODE steps FT8, FT4, FT2; TX Hz sets the audio frequency
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 with FT8 open: 'ft8 mode' -> ft8 proto changes FT8->FT4->FT2->FT8; 'ft8 txfreq 1500' -> ft8 txf 1500; 'ft8 bogus' -> 'err ft8 bogus'

feature: FT8 AUTO and HOLD switches from the browser
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 (TX session) with FT8 open, TX off: 'ft8 hold' -> ft8 hold toggles; 'ft8 auto' -> ft8 auto toggles; nothing keys (tx stays 0)

feature: A session without TX is refused the FT8 commands that send: cq, auto, reply, txcall
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 with a no-TX operate session in control: 'ft8 cq' / 'ft8 auto' / 'ft8 reply 1' / 'ft8 txcall' -> 'err this session may not transmit'; ft8 state unchanged

feature: FT8 CQ from the browser calls CQ in our slot
how_to_confirm: Radio A 'ft8 open', 'ft8 cq' at <=1 W into the pad -> ft8 cq 1, sending 1 in our slot, tx 1; radio B's 'ft8r' shows A's CQ

feature: Tap a CQ or a call ('ft8 reply ID') answers it as a press on the radio's list
how_to_confirm: Radio B CQs, radio A gets 'ft8r' id N; A 'ft8 reply N' -> ft8 next shows B's call, A sends in the next slot, B decodes A's reply

feature: TX (the app's TX Call) armed or off from the browser ('ft8 txcall')
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 FT8 open: 'ft8 txcall' -> ft8 tx 1 (armed); a queued message then goes in the next slot (tx 1); again -> tx 0

feature: STOP drops the transmission under way and the queued message, CQ off, TX off; AUTO stays
how_to_confirm: During an A CQ over the pad: 'ft8 stop' -> ft8 cq 0, tx 0, sending 0 and state tx 0 within a slot; auto unchanged

feature: CW tab: the radio's CW decoder text as 'cw "..."' (LOG takes the last call to the Log tab)
how_to_confirm: Radio B sends CW text at <=1 W into the pad (TCI cw_macros), radio A in CW with the decoder on: 'cw "..."' lines on A's WS contain B's text

feature: Log tab: a QSO by hand ('log CALL|RSTS|RSTR|NAME') goes to the day's ADIF log on the radio's frequency
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 (operate): 'log T3ST|59|57|Bench' -> 'logged ok'; over SSH the day's ADIF has CALL T3ST on the state frequency; view-only -> 'err view only...'; remove the test QSO after

feature: The logged QSO's mode: the open digital app's (PSK31 ... WSPR), else the radio's; CW in CW/CW-R even with RTTY/SSTV open; in USB-D/LSB-D with no app away from FT8/FT4 it is logged without a mode
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: log in CW -> ADIF MODE CW; open PSK31 then log -> MODE PSK31 (or PSK/SUBMODE); USB-D on 14.100 MHz no app -> record without MODE and the radio's message says so; clean up after

feature: 'logq ID CALL|...' with a client-chosen number: answered 'logged ID ok|no' to the sending session; the same ID+QSO written once; another QSO under that ID 'logged ID conflict'
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: 'logq 123456789 T3ST|59|59|x' -> 'logged 123456789 ok'; resend identical -> same answer, ADIF has one record; 'logq 123456789 T4ST|59|59|x' -> 'logged 123456789 conflict', not written

feature: 'logq? ID CALL|...' asks again: ok, no, pending, conflict or unknown (never seen, restarted, or past the last 64)
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: after a logq, 'logq? ID same' -> ok; 'logq? 999 x' -> unknown; after a GUI restart the first ID -> unknown; 65 logq then the first -> unknown

feature: After 'size' the radio lists its keys ('keys GEN APP ...'): the X6200 has no PRE, V/M, AGC or LOCK key
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 connect -> 'hello', 'size 800 480', 'keys ...': X6100 contains PRE VM AGC LOCK, X6200 does not; after 'panel 1' -> 'modes 8' (X6100) / 'modes 10' (X6200), 'volmax 55|100', 'pwrmax 100|80'

feature: Sound: the RX audio in the browser over the TCI server
how_to_confirm: TCI 50001 as the page does: 'audio_start:0;' -> binary RX audio frames arrive continuously (headless browser: Sound plays without error)

feature: Mic: the browser's microphone goes out while PTT is held, over TCI with the paired key; PTT without Mic keys the radio's own microphone
how_to_confirm: Headless browser with a fake mic (tone file) on radio A's Panel, Mic on, PTT held at <=1 W into the pad -> A tx 1 and radio B hears the tone (TCI audio/S-meter on B); Mic off -> A keys its own mic

feature: GPS: the phone's position to the radio ('pos LAT LON [ACC]'), operate, no control needed; kept ten minutes
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 (operate): 'pos 51.5 -0.12 15' -> no err, Field Ops/grid on the radio shows IO91 (screenshot or GUI log); 'pos 95 0' -> 'err pos LAT LON [ACC]'; view-only -> err view only

feature: 'clk? MS' answered 'clk MS OURS' (the radio's time in ms)
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: 'clk? 1763800000000' -> 'clk 1763800000000 <ours>' with ours within a second of the test PC's UTC

feature: 'clk MS RTT' leaves the clock alone when NTP keeps it (clk ntp D), a GPS fix in 10 s (clk gps D), within 0.3 s (clk ok D) or round trip > 1 s (clk slow D); bad input 'err clk MS RTT'
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 (operate) on WiFi with NTP: 'clk <now> 50' -> 'clk ntp D'; 'clk <now> 1500' -> 'clk slow D'; 'clk 5 5' -> 'err clk MS RTT'

feature: The radio sets its clock (and RTC) from the phone's when more than 0.3 s off and nothing else keeps it; says 'Clock set from the phone: +12.3 s'
how_to_confirm: Over SSH stop ntpd and let the kernel mark the clock unsynced; WS 'clk <now+5000> 40' -> 'clk set ~5000', 'date' moved, message on screen; restore ntpd after

feature: Page-side options: colours (Blue/Fire/Ice/Grey), Light theme, App mode, Fullscreen, portrait/landscape layout, kept per browser
how_to_confirm: Headless browser on /panel: toggle Light/App, reload -> choice kept (localStorage); resize portrait/landscape -> layout changes

feature: Panel keyboard: arrows tune (Shift ten steps), [ ] volume, Space is PTT, never in a field or on a Tab-reached button
how_to_confirm: Headless browser paired, in control: press ArrowRight -> state freq + step; ']' -> vol +1; Space with focus in the Log field types a space and sends no 'key PTT'

feature: The page shows the radio's state, never what it hopes: a refused set is answered 'err ...' then the whole state; an unanswered change reverts in 2 s
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 under LOCK: 'set freq F' -> an 'err freq: locked ...' line followed by a full 'state {...}' line; 'set bogus 1' -> 'err unknown setting bogus' + state

feature: A browser that only watches does not change the radio: set, key, knob refused with the reason
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 without auth: 'set vol 5' -> 'err view only: pair this browser to operate' and state unchanged; 'key F1 1' and 'knob main 1' -> same err

feature: Band list and band plan to panel clients ('bands', 'plan'), sent again when either changes
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 'panel 1' -> 'bands [...]' and 'plan [...]' JSON; change a band on the web Bands page -> a new 'bands' line arrives

feature: State 'kt' (key tone) and 'cwrise' (1 where CW's tone rises with the dial: CW-R, and the X6200's CW)
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: X6100 in CW -> cwrise 0, in CW-R -> 1; X6200 in CW -> cwrise 1; kt equals the CW pitch setting

feature: 'wefax open|close|auto|cont|save|clear' works the WeFax app; state app 'WeFax'
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 (operate, control): 'wefax open' -> state app 'WeFax'; 'wefax auto' / 'wefax cont' accepted; 'wefax foo' -> 'err wefax foo'; 'wefax close' -> app ''

feature: 'apps' answered 'apps [[ACTION,"Name"],...]': the apps this radio has
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: 'apps' -> JSON list; X6200's includes its own apps, both include FT8

feature: 'open ACTION' opens an app; state 'win' names the open window
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 (operate, control): 'open <Cluster action>' -> state win 'Cluster'; screenshot shows it; 'close' -> win ''

feature: 'open sentry L' opens the Sentry on page A-G, H (AIRSPACE) or I (direction finder); state 'pg'
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: 'open sentry B' -> state win 'Sentry', pg 'B'; 'open sentry H' -> AIRSPACE; 'close' -> pg ''

feature: 'open' never starts the SWR scan, WSPR or the first-start guide ('err open ACTION')
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: 'open <ACTION_APP_SWRSCAN>' and 'open <ACTION_APP_WSPR>' -> 'err open N'; state tx stays 0; 'open 99999' -> err open

feature: Greeting 'hello <version> <boot>': a changed boot number tells the client the radio restarted
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 connect -> 'hello v0.3.12.x NNN'; restart the GUI over SSH (never stop it), reconnect -> boot differs; version equals Settings > Info

feature: 'tx 0|1' goes to every client when the radio keys or unkeys
how_to_confirm: Two WS clients; key radio A at <=1 W into the pad (PTT lease) -> both get 'tx 1', then 'tx 0' on release

feature: State 'rxo' is 1 while the radio holds itself receive only (Sentry, or a no-TX session in control)
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: no-TX session 'control take' -> state rxo 1, screen says '0 W: receive only'; 'control release' -> rxo 0; 'open sentry A' -> rxo 1

feature: 'key PTT 1 N' keys the radio's own mic as a lease renewed every second; three seconds without it the radio unkeys ('ptt released: no renewal from the page')
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 TX session at <=1 W into the pad: 'key PTT 1 7' each second -> tx 1; stop renewing -> 'tx 0' within ~3 s and an err/ptt released message

feature: Three minutes on the air at most whatever happens
how_to_confirm: Hold the PTT lease at 0.1 W into the pad for >180 s -> tx 0 at 180 s with the reason

feature: 'key PTT 0' lets go; a hold let go stays over: late renewals of that number are ignored, only a new number keys
how_to_confirm: Key with 'key PTT 1 7', 'key PTT 0' -> tx 0; send 'key PTT 1 7' again -> stays tx 0; 'key PTT 1 8' -> tx 1 (pad, <=1 W)

feature: A session without TX is refused PTT and TUNE
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 no-TX session in control: 'key PTT 1 5' -> 'err this session may not transmit'; 'tune 1 5' -> same; tx stays 0

feature: A press where the radio may not transmit (outside the amateur bands, receive only) is refused with the reason
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 TX session: 'set freq 27185000', 'key PTT 1 9' -> 'err ptt: no TX on 27.185 MHz: outside the amateur bands (Settings > TX Cal)'; tx stays 0

feature: A PTT press without a press number (page older than the radio) is refused: reload the page
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 TX session: 'key PTT 1' (no N) -> 'err this session may not transmit from a page older than the radio: reload the page'

feature: PTT refused while the base sends no data ('no data from the base')
how_to_confirm: Needs the base's data to stop (cannot be forced remotely): 'key PTT 1 N' -> 'err ptt: no data from the base'

feature: PTT button states: PTT (hold) with TX audio source, Keying..., ON AIR with seconds, Unkeying..., TX ended, TX (not this browser), No TX + reason for 5 s
how_to_confirm: Headless browser on radio A's Panel: hold PTT at <=1 W into the pad -> 'Keying...' then 'ON AIR' within 1.5 s; key from another client -> 'TX (not this browser)'; refused press -> 'No TX' + reason

feature: With Mic on but no microphone granted, a PTT press is refused 'No TX' and the radio's microphone is never used instead
how_to_confirm: Headless browser with mic permission denied, Mic on, PTT pressed -> no 'key PTT' and no trx sent; WS state tx stays 0

feature: While a no-TX session has control the whole radio is receive only: base at 0 W; PTT, CW key, apps, MSG and ATU tuning refused whichever key asked
how_to_confirm: No-TX session 'control take' -> rxo 1; from it 'key ATU 1' held 2 s, 'key MSG 1' -> state tx stays 0 (refusal; run at 0.1 W, pad advised); release control -> rxo 0

feature: TUNE for an external tuner: 'tune 1 N' renewed each second while state tune 1 (tune_s the limit); 'tune 0' stops; stops 3 s after the last renewal
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 TX session at <=1 W into the pad: 'tune 1 3' -> state tune 1, tune_s > 0, tx 1, 't' meters; stop renewing -> 'err tune stopped: no renewal from the page' ~3 s; 'tune 0' stops at once

feature: TUNE refused like PTT: view-only, no-TX session, control elsewhere, a frequency the radio does not tune ('err tune: ...')
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: view-only 'tune 1 1' -> err view only; no-TX 'tune 1 1' -> 'err this session may not transmit'; on 27.185 MHz -> 'err tune: ...'; 'tune 1' without N -> 'err tune 1 HOLD: reload the page'

feature: A tune started at the radio or by another page shows and is stopped by 'tune 0' with operate and control
how_to_confirm: Client 1 'tune 1 4' (pad, <=1 W); client 2 takes control, 'tune 0' -> state tune 0, tx 0

feature: The remote's 'close' closes the app open, the RTTY panel too (the one app with no window of its own)
how_to_confirm: 'open' the RTTY app (its action from 'apps'): the state's app 'RTTY'; 'close': app '' within 2 s.

feature: The remote's state says G's own channel (wch Hz, wchm mode; 0 and -1 for none); 'set wch HZ MODE' sets that memory only, the dial not tuned; a frequency the radio does not tune refused
how_to_confirm: read wch/wchm; 'set wch 27065000 6': the state's wch 27065000, freq unchanged; 'set wch 5': 'err wch: not a frequency this radio tunes'; put back as found.

feature: The remote's state says TUNE's own power (tpwr, tenths of a watt); 'set tpwr N' sets it as Settings > TX Cal > EXTERNAL TUNER does (0.1 W up to the radio's top, clamped), saved
how_to_confirm: read tpwr; 'set tpwr 1': the state's tpwr 1; 'set tpwr 0': tpwr 1 (clamped to 0.1 W); put back as found (the settings row too).

feature: Settings > General > BROWSER REMOTE turns the server (both pages) on and off, port in /mnt/remote.conf, shows who is watching
how_to_confirm: HTTP GET /api/remote -> {enabled, port}; POST /api/remote {enabled:false} -> WS 50002 refuses connections; POST {enabled:true} -> connects again (restore at once)

feature: The bar shows Link, Spectrum/Picture, Sound, Mic green/amber/red/grey, then Access and Control; stale state greyed with its age
how_to_confirm: Headless browser on /panel: indicators green; block the WS port (drop packets) -> amber then red, controls grey, 'What is shown is from N s ago'

feature: The page reconnects after 1, 2, 4, 8, up to 15 s, with Try now, and says why (remote off, update, unreachable); 'The radio restarted' on a new boot number
how_to_confirm: Headless browser: POST /api/remote enabled:false -> page says the browser remote is off with a button; re-enable -> reconnects; restart the GUI -> 'The radio restarted'

feature: Nothing crosses a gap: keys held when the link goes are released by the radio, a transmission from the browser ends, nothing is replayed
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 in control: 'key MFK 1' then close the socket without a release -> no long-press action (screenshot) and the key is up; a reconnect sends nothing by itself

feature: A stalled link counts as back only when the radio answers a ping sent after the silence ('ping N' -> 'pong N')
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: 'ping 42' -> 'pong 42' in order after all earlier messages; 'ping' -> 'pong'

feature: On a stalled link the page ends the transmission, lets held keys go, sends nothing until a ping is answered
how_to_confirm: Headless browser holding PTT at <=1 W into the pad; stall the link (drop packets) -> page shows 'TX ended', radio unkeys by the lease (tx 0 within 3 s)

feature: Log fields, the chosen tab and QSOs waiting for an answer are kept through a lost link and a reload; never retried when a duplicate is possible
how_to_confirm: Headless browser: type a call in Log, reload -> field kept; send a QSO with the WS blocked -> 'waiting for the connection', unblock -> it is asked about (logq?) and settled once

feature: 'pair?' puts a six-digit code on the radio's screen for two minutes
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: 'pair?' -> 'pairing code shown on the radio for 2 min'; SSH screenshot (kill -USR1 x6100_gui -> /tmp/screen.raw) shows 'Pair code: NNNNNN (2 min)'

feature: 'pair CODE NAME' answers 'paired TOKEN ROLE TX'; the token keeps the browser paired through reloads and restarts
how_to_confirm: Read the code by OCR of the SSH screenshot, 'pair NNNNNN Bench' -> 'paired <32 hex> operate 1'; new WS 'auth TOKEN' -> 'role operate 1 Bench' (owner if OCR fails)

feature: A wrong or expired code is refused; three wrong tries burn the code
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: 'pair 000000 x' -> 'err pairing refused: wrong or expired code (press Pair for a new one)'; 'pair 123' (no name) -> 'err pair CODE NAME'

feature: A new code at most every 30 s; after each burned code the wait doubles (1, 2, 4 min ... up to an hour), 'Pairing paused' on screen
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: 'pair?' twice within 30 s -> second 'err pairing paused: a new code in N s'; after 3 wrong 'pair' -> 'pair?' -> 'err pairing paused: a new code in N min'; GUI restart clears it

feature: Settings > General > BROWSER REMOTE > Pair code shows a code at once and starts the waits over
how_to_confirm: At the radio (or remote keys into Settings): Pair code shows a fresh code; WS 'pair?' is no longer paused

feature: While the pairing code shows, the screen mirror of unpaired viewers pauses
how_to_confirm: Unpaired WS client counting JPEG frames; 'pair?' from another client -> no JPEG frames to the unpaired one for ~15 s while a paired client still gets them

feature: 'auth TOKEN' at each connection answers 'role view|operate|admin TX NAME'; an unknown token falls back to view
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: 'auth <provisioned token>' -> 'role operate 1 bench-tx' and a 'ctl ...' line; 'auth ffff...' (32 hex) -> 'err unknown session: pair this browser again' + 'role view 0 -'

feature: Up to sixteen paired browsers in /mnt/remote_sessions.conf as SHA-256 hashes of their tokens; a plain token from before is hashed at the first start
how_to_confirm: SSH: write a 32-hex token line, restart the GUI -> the file's first column becomes 64 hex, auth with the token still works

feature: remote_sessions.conf written whole beside the old one, a .bak copy kept and used when the file comes back empty or unreadable
how_to_confirm: SSH: back up, empty /mnt/remote_sessions.conf (keep .bak), restart the GUI -> 'auth TOKEN' still gives the role; restore

feature: The last-seen time goes to the card once an hour or on an address change, not at every connection
how_to_confirm: SSH: note mtime of /mnt/remote_sessions.conf, reconnect+auth several times -> mtime unchanged

feature: The first browser ever paired is the admin; every later browser is an operator
how_to_confirm: On an empty sessions file (backup first): pair twice (code by OCR) -> first 'paired T admin 1', second 'paired T operate 1'; restore the file

feature: An admin's 'sessions' lists the paired browsers as JSON (name, address, via Funnel, connected, last seen) and the TCI programs allowed Always
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 admin: 'sessions' -> 'sessions [...]' JSON; an operator 'sessions' -> 'err admin only'

feature: 'revoke N' ends a session at once, its open connections included
how_to_confirm: Admin WS + second WS authed as session N: 'revoke N' -> second socket closes ('err session revoked'), its token then gives role view; 'revoke 99' -> 'err no such session'

feature: 'unpair' forgets the caller's own session
how_to_confirm: WS authed: 'unpair' -> socket closes, the token no longer authenticates; unpaired 'unpair' -> 'err not paired'

feature: Settings > General > BROWSER REMOTE > Forget all revokes every browser (and the .bak); the next pairing is the new admin
how_to_confirm: At the radio: Forget all -> /mnt/remote_sessions.conf and .bak empty/gone over SSH; any token -> role view

feature: View only (unpaired) may watch and listen only: no log, tune, keys, knobs, PTT, FT8, control
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 unauthed: 'log X|59|59|', 'set freq F', 'key F1 1', 'knob main 1', 'ft8 open', 'control take' -> each 'err view only: pair this browser to operate'

feature: Control: one holder at a time; 'control take|release'; 'ctl none|local|tci|browser NAME MINE' to every client
how_to_confirm: Two operator WS: A 'control take' -> A 'ctl browser bench-a 1', B 'ctl browser bench-a 0'; A 'control release' -> 'ctl none 0'

feature: A key, knob or setting from a browser without control is not sent ('take control first')
how_to_confirm: A has control; B 'set vol 3' -> 'err controlled by bench-a: take control first' and state unchanged; B 'control take' -> B in control

feature: With control free the first to tune or key takes it
how_to_confirm: Control none; operator 'set vol 10' -> applied and 'ctl browser NAME 1'

feature: The radio's own keys and knobs always take control back ('At the radio')
how_to_confirm: Browser in control; turn a knob on the radio -> every client gets 'ctl local 0'

feature: The keys and knob turns a browser sends never hand control to 'At the radio', however late the GUI reads them (an FT8 app decoding): matched by the kernel's event time, not the read
how_to_confirm: Control taken; FT8 app open and decoding; 40 remote key taps and knob turns: 'ctl' stays 'browser ... 1' throughout (it said 'local' within a few taps before).
manual_ref: Control: one holder at a time

feature: 'ft8 stop' and 'js8 stop' need operate only, not control: stopping the apps' transmitting goes whoever holds control
how_to_confirm: Control released or held by another; 'ft8 stop': no 'err controlled by', the app's TX off; 'ft8 cq' still refused without control.
manual_ref: Control: one holder at a time

feature: A key held past the long press time is a long press by its events' own times (the kernel's), even when the GUI reads the press late (busy: an app decoding, on the air)
how_to_confirm: A key held 1.5 s (the remote's key 1, then 0) while the GUI is busy (an app decoding, the radio on the air) does its long action, never its tap's; the same held 0.3 s: its tap.

feature: The CW decoder searches for the tone from 150 Hz up whatever the CW filter's low edge: a filter from 0 Hz on a strong signal's loud audio no longer locks it on the keying's thumps (every element an E)
how_to_confirm: The X6200 keys 'VVV TEST DE Q1TST' at 15 WPM, 0.1 W; the X6100 in CW, filter 0-3000, RF gain 100: its decoder copies TEST DE Q1TST (it printed E E E before). Offline: tools/cw_replay's host check replays that recording (fails on the decoder before: 20 Hz lock, all E).

feature: A TCI client takes control the moment it tunes or keys; what it only asks (vfo:0,0; trx:0;) takes nothing
how_to_confirm: Browser in control; TCI 'vfo:0,0;' and 'trx:0;' -> browser keeps 'ctl browser ... 1'; TCI 'vfo:0,0,7074000;' -> browser gets 'ctl tci 0'

feature: While the radio transmits control stays where it is until the transmission ends
how_to_confirm: Radio keyed by session A (pad, <=1 W); session B 'control take' -> 'err busy: the radio is transmitting, control stays where it is'

feature: A client that keys without control gives control back when its transmission ends (browser, radio, program, or free)
how_to_confirm: Browser A in control; TCI client keys trx:0,true,tci (pad, <=1 W) -> ctl tci during the over; after trx:0,false -> 'ctl browser A 1' again

feature: A browser that loses its link loses control with it
how_to_confirm: A 'control take', close A's socket -> B gets 'ctl none 0'

feature: The Panel/Screen page gives the paired browser's key on its TCI link ('auth TOKEN'): no Ask before TX, a no-TX session refused without a question
how_to_confirm: TCI 50001: 'auth:<no-TX token>;' then 'trx:0,true,tci;' -> 'trx:0,false;', remote state ask stays 0 (no question on screen); with a TX token the start keys without a question (cable)

feature: Sessions lists the TCI programs answered Always, with Forget ('revoke tci ADDR'), which makes the radio ask again
how_to_confirm: SSH: add a line to /mnt/tci_allowed.conf (or answer Always), admin 'sessions' -> entry with "tci":1; 'revoke tci ADDR' -> gone; 'revoke tci 1.2.3.4' -> 'err no such TCI client'

feature: PTT button Hold to talk or Tap on, tap off ('tap to stop'), kept per browser; the 3 minutes and the page leaving sight still end it
how_to_confirm: Headless browser, Tap on/tap off, radio A at <=1 W into the pad: tap -> tx 1, tap -> tx 0; option kept after reload

feature: Bluetooth headset button as PTT (Play/pause, Next, Previous as tap on/off, or Speaker mic held to talk) via the page as media player
how_to_confirm: Phone with a BT headset on the Panel: button press -> 'key PTT' sent and radio tx 1 (pad); page out of sight -> PTT let go

feature: Headset mute as PTT: sound keys (~0.1 s), digital silence (< -90 dBFS) unkeys (~1.5 s); arms only after sound then silence
how_to_confirm: Headless browser with a fake mic file: tone then digital silence then tone -> radio A keys/unkeys over the pad accordingly; a never-silent mic keys nothing

feature: FT8 state carries the timeline: 'in' ms to our next slot, 'slot' length, 'rep' sends left, qso, hound, nocall, logged, logged_s; once a second while a countdown runs
how_to_confirm: Radio A 'ft8 open', 'ft8 cq' (pad, <=1 W) -> 'ft8 {...}' each second with in decreasing, slot 15000, rep counting down; after a QSO logged and logged_s set
manual_ref: ### What the FT8 app will do next

feature: TX off: the app listens, decodes and queues; nothing keys; the radio says 'TX off: receive only until TX Call, CQ or a call is pressed'
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: 'ft8 open' with tx 0, wait 2 slots -> state tx stays 0, ft8 sending 0; screenshot shows the TX off message
manual_ref: ### What the FT8 app will do next

feature: No callsign set: the app decodes but never transmits (ft8 state nocall)
how_to_confirm: With the callsign cleared (SSH params, restore after): 'ft8 open' -> ft8 nocall 1; 'ft8 cq' -> no transmission
manual_ref: ### What the FT8 app will do next

feature: Decode list newest at the bottom or 'Newest on top', kept per browser; distance in km or mi as Settings > Display > FT8/FT4 info
how_to_confirm: Headless browser with decodes from radio B over the pad: toggle the wide button -> order flips, kept after reload; distance unit matches the radio setting
manual_ref: ### What the FT8 app will do next

feature: CQ and AUTO go on calling and answering when the page closes or loses its link
how_to_confirm: A 'ft8 cq' then close the WS; radio B keeps decoding A's CQs over the pad; a new WS sees the timeline where the radio is
manual_ref: ### What the FT8 app will do next

feature: The Screen page at http://<radio>/remote (Remote > Screen)
how_to_confirm: HTTP GET http://<radio>/remote -> 200 with the remote page

feature: The radio's screen as JPEG frames, up to ten a second, an unchanged screen once a second; 'screen 0' stops them
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: binary frames starting FF D8 (JPEG), decode 800x480; ~1/s on a still screen, more while the waterfall moves (<=10/s); 'screen 0' -> no JPEG frames; SSH screenshot matches

feature: Picture: sharp (~40 kB), balanced (~33 kB), fast (half size, ~12 kB); one frame at a time after the last reached the browser
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: 'picture fast' -> JPEG 400x240 ~12 kB; 'picture sharp' -> 800x480 ~40 kB; 'picture balanced' -> 800x480 smaller

feature: The Walkie Talkie portrait screen is shown upright
how_to_confirm: WS 50002: 'open sentry G' -> JPEG frames decode as portrait (height > width) with text upright (OCR); 'close'

feature: 'banner TEXT' puts the bench suite's line across the screen (TX/RX box); 'banner' clears; it goes when that session disconnects
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 (operate): 'banner TEST 1 A->B' -> SSH/JPEG screenshot shows the line; 'banner' -> gone; set again then close the socket -> gone; view-only -> err view only

feature: Every front key from the browser, held as long as pressed (long presses work): F1-F5, GEN, KEY, DFN, APP, MSG, DFL, AM, CW, SSB, A/B, ATU, FST, BAND, POWER, PTT; X6100 also PRE, V/M, AGC, LOCK
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 in control: 'key SSB 1','key SSB 0' -> state mode changes; 'key GEN 1' held 1.5 s -> long-press action (screenshot); 'key FOO 1' -> 'err unknown key FOO'; X6200 'key PRE 1' -> err unknown key

feature: VOL, MFK and MAIN knobs from the browser ('knob main|vol|mfk N'), push via the knob keys
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 in control: 'knob main 3' -> freq + 3 steps; 'knob vol -2' -> vol -2; 'knob foo 1' -> 'err unknown knob foo'; 'key VOL 1/0' pushes

feature: Screen page keyboard: F1-F5, arrows main knob (Shift ten), [ ] volume, PageUp/PageDown MFK, Enter MFK push, Space PTT; not in dialogs or the picture list
how_to_confirm: Headless browser in control: PageUp -> 'knob mfk 1' sent; Enter with focus on a Tab-reached button presses that button, not the MFK

feature: The https page carries picture, sound and microphone through the same port: wss://<radio>/ws/remote and /ws/tci handed on by the web server
how_to_confirm: WSS to https://<radio>/ws/remote (cert not verified) -> 'hello ...'; wss://<radio>/ws/tci -> TCI greeting

feature: The screen is streamed while the radio's panel is dark (Screen off after, Screen always off); the screensaver waits while a page is open
how_to_confirm: With Screen always off set (restore after), WS 50002 still gets JPEG frames of the GUI; with a short screensaver timeout and a client connected the screensaver never starts (screenshot)

feature: Up to four viewers at a time, Panel and Screen together
how_to_confirm: Open 5 WS connections to 50002 -> four get 'hello', the 5th is closed at once (no free slot); close one -> a new one gets in

feature: Pages from other sites cannot connect (Origin checked, the radio's own names only), nor Pat's Winlink page (port 8080)
how_to_confirm: WS 50002 with 'Origin: http://evil.example' -> handshake refused; Origin http://<radio>:8080 -> refused; Origin http://<radio>/ with Host <radio> -> 101; Origin=Host=evil.example (rebinding) -> refused

feature: While a TCI client transmits the radio's speaker and TX monitor are quiet, and come back as they were
how_to_confirm: Radio A: note state spk/moni/tcim; TCI client keys trx:0,true,tci at <=1 W into the pad -> state tcim 1 (speaker muted); after unkey -> as before

feature: A frequency change from a TCI client wakes a blanked screen or ends the screensaver (not with Screen always off)
how_to_confirm: Let the screensaver start (short timeout set, restore after); TCI 'vfo:0,0,14075000;' -> SSH screenshot shows the main screen

feature: TCI greeting: protocol:ExpertSDR3,1.9; device:GoldCorpHF; receive_only, trx_count, channels_count, vfo_limits, if_limits, modulations_list (+sam,wfm on the X6200), the audio format, vfo, modulation, filter, agc, rit, drive, trx, cw speeds, then start; ready;
how_to_confirm: WS ws://<radio>:50001 -> text frames in that order ending 'start;' 'ready;'; modulations_list has sam,wfm only on the X6200; vfo matches the remote state freq

feature: TCI on by default on port 50001; on/off and port in Settings > General > TCI SERVER or the web TCI page; /mnt/tci.conf enabled, port, trust, tx_confirm
how_to_confirm: HTTP GET /api/tci -> {enabled, port, trust, tx_confirm}; POST port 1023 -> 400 'Invalid port: 1024-65535'; trust 'x' -> 400; SSH cat /mnt/tci.conf matches

feature: Clients may: Listen only: a client hears and follows the radio; its tuning and keying are answered with the state unchanged, every start refused without a question
how_to_confirm: POST /api/tci trust 'view' (restore after): TCI 'vfo:0,0,7100000;' -> 'vfo:0,0,<unchanged>;', freq unchanged; 'trx:0,true,tci;' -> 'trx:0,false;', remote state ask 0

feature: What a client only asks (vfo:0,0; trx:0; modulation; rx_filter_band; agc_mode; rit_enable; rit_offset; drive without a value) takes no control and is answered with the state
how_to_confirm: Browser in control; TCI 'vfo:0,0;' -> 'vfo:0,0,F;', 'drive;' -> 'drive:0,N;', 'modulation:0;' -> 'modulation:0,usb;' ... browser still 'ctl browser X 1'

feature: vfo: tunes the radio; refused (state answered) under LOCK, an app hold, or a frequency it does not tune
how_to_confirm: TCI 'vfo:0,0,7074000;' -> 'vfo:0,0,7074000;' and remote state freq 7074000; with LOCK on -> answered with the old frequency

feature: modulation: lsb, usb, cw, cwr, am, nfm, digl, digu (sam, wfm on the X6200)
how_to_confirm: TCI 'modulation:0,digu;' -> 'modulation:0,digu;' and remote state mode USB-D; X6200 'modulation:0,wfm;' -> wfm; X6100 'modulation:0,sam;' -> am and 'modulation:0,wfm;' -> nfm (fm/dsb aliases too)

feature: rx_filter_band: sets and reports the filter edges
how_to_confirm: TCI 'rx_filter_band:0,100,2800;' -> echo with the radio's edges; remote state flo/fhi 100/2800

feature: agc_mode: off, slow, fast, auto (med/medium taken as auto)
how_to_confirm: TCI 'agc_mode:0,fast;' -> 'agc_mode:0,fast;', remote state agc changes; 'agc_mode:0,medium;' -> auto

feature: rit_enable and rit_offset
how_to_confirm: TCI 'rit_enable:0,true;' 'rit_offset:0,500;' -> echoes; remote state rit 500; 'rit_enable:0,false;' -> rit 0

feature: drive: TX power 0-100 % (0.1 W up to 10 W, 8 W on the X6200; on battery 5 W from 50 % on the X6100, 62 % on the X6200)
how_to_confirm: TCI 'drive:0,10;' -> 'drive:0,10;' and remote state pwr 1.0 (X6100) / 0.8 (X6200); 'drive;' asks

feature: trx:0,true; keys the radio (PTT) with its own microphone; trx:0,false; unkeys
how_to_confirm: TCI client allowed (Always), radio at <=1 W into the pad: 'trx:0,true;' -> 'trx:0,true;' and remote tx 1; 'trx:0,false;' -> tx 0

feature: trx:0,true,tci; keys with the client's audio: every 21.3 ms TX_CHRONO asks for audio in the client's format; 8-48 kHz, any of four types, first channel transmitted
how_to_confirm: Radio A TCI client (tools/bench/tci_tone_tx.py) sends a 1 kHz tone at <=1 W into the pad: TX_CHRONO frames arrive ~47/s, A tx 1, radio B's S-meter/TCI audio shows the tone; unkey answered at once

feature: A TX audio frame whose size is not what its header says ends the transmission at once; WSJT-X's double-size frame is accepted
how_to_confirm: During trx:0,true,tci over the pad send one frame with a wrong length -> radio unkeys at once (tx 0); double-size frames -> keeps transmitting

feature: One transmission at a time: another operating client's key meanwhile is answered trx:0,false; and changes nothing, not even control
how_to_confirm: Client 1 keys (pad, <=1 W); client 2 'trx:0,true;' -> client 2 gets 'trx:0,false;', remote ctl unchanged, client 1 still tunes during its over

feature: A TCI audio key in CW or CW-R is refused (trx:0,false; to that client)
how_to_confirm: Remote 'set mode' CW; TCI (allowed) 'trx:0,true,tci;' -> 'trx:0,false;', remote tx stays 0

feature: A key that does not put the radio on the air within a second (a frequency it does not transmit on, no data from the base) is answered trx:0,false;
how_to_confirm: TCI 'vfo:0,0,27185000;' then 'trx:0,true;' -> 'trx:0,false;' within ~1 s, remote tx 0

feature: The keying client's unkey or leaving unkeys the radio; a key still on its way when it leaves keys nothing; a refused client unkeys nothing
how_to_confirm: Client keys (pad, <=1 W) then closes the socket -> remote tx 0 at once; with the browser PTT keyed, a refused TCI client's trx:0,false; leaves tx 1

feature: TCI refuses a browser page from any site but the radio's own and Pat's mailbox (8080); programs without Origin connect by any name
how_to_confirm: WS 50001 with Origin http://evil.example -> refused; Origin http://<radio>:8080 -> refused; no Origin, Host 1.2.3.4 -> greeting

feature: TCI over Tailscale Funnel is refused (also a hand-made funnel); only the Panel's own audio and key for a session that may transmit
how_to_confirm: Simulated: WS 50001 with header 'Tailscale-Funnel-Request: 1' -> no greeting; 'vfo:0,0,7074000;' ignored; after 'auth:<TX token>;' only audio and trx commands are taken

feature: Ask before TX: a client not allowed yet does not key; its start is answered trx:0,false; and the radio asks '<addr> (<name>) wants to transmit': Allow once, Always, No (No preselected)
how_to_confirm: TCI from the test PC (User-Agent 'BenchTCI'): 'trx:0,true;' -> 'trx:0,false;', remote state ask 1, screenshot shows '<PC addr> (BenchTCI) wants to transmit' with No selected; 'key MFK 1/0' -> No, ask 0

feature: No answer in 20 s is No, with a note on the screen; No refuses the client's starts without a question until it connects again
how_to_confirm: Trigger the question, wait 21 s -> state ask 0, note on the screen; 'trx:0,true;' again -> 'trx:0,false;' with no new question; reconnect -> asks again

feature: Allow once: the client may transmit while that connection stays open; asked again on reconnect; answered after it hung up, its next connection within a minute may transmit
how_to_confirm: Question shown, choose Allow once with 'knob mfk' + 'key MFK'; next 'trx:0,true;' keys (pad, <=1 W); reconnect -> asked again

feature: Always: kept in /mnt/tci_allowed.conf (address, name, when allowed, last seen), through restarts, up to sixteen; with sixteen kept Always is Allow once with a note
how_to_confirm: Question shown, choose Always via the remote MFK -> SSH /mnt/tci_allowed.conf has the PC's address and name; with 16 lines pre-provisioned, Always -> note 'Allow once' and no new line

feature: One question at a time: a second start of the same client opens nothing more; another client's start meanwhile is refused without a question of its own
how_to_confirm: Client 1 start -> question; client 1 again -> no second; client 2 'trx:0,true;' -> 'trx:0,false;' and the screen still shows client 1's question

feature: Settings > General > TCI SERVER Allowed list with Forget all; Panel admin Forget for one; a forgotten client is asked at its next start, also on an open connection
how_to_confirm: Allowed client connected; admin WS 'revoke tci <addr>' -> its next 'trx:0,true;' -> 'trx:0,false;' with a question (state ask 1)

feature: Ask before TX off (tx_confirm=0): every operating client keys at once; an old tci.conf without tx_confirm asks; turning it off while asking closes the question
how_to_confirm: POST /api/tci tx_confirm false (restore after): unknown client 'trx:0,true;' keys at once (pad, <=1 W); with a question open, turning it off -> state ask 0

feature: Not asked: programs on the radio itself (127.0.0.1, not a browser, not via a proxy); a client via Tailscale or the https port is known by its own address
how_to_confirm: SSH on radio A: a TCI client to 127.0.0.1:50001 keys at once without a question (pad, <=1 W); the same via wss://<radio>/ws/tci from the PC is asked about by the PC's address

feature: The TCI SERVER card shows the connected client's address, 'no client' otherwise
how_to_confirm: Navigate Settings > General with remote keys, screenshot: 'no client'; connect a TCI client -> its address shown

feature: rx_smeter and rx_channel_sensors (S-meter in dBm) after rx_sensors_enable:true;
how_to_confirm: TCI: 'rx_smeter:0,0,<dBm>;' arrives periodically to every client in RX; 'rx_sensors_enable:true;' -> 'rx_sensors_enable:true;' then 'rx_channel_sensors:0,0,-NNN.N;' lines; 'rx_sensors_enable:false;' stops those

feature: tx_sensors (mic level, forward power, SWR >= 1.0, ALC) after tx_sensors_enable:true; 0 until the radio's first reading
how_to_confirm: TCI 'tx_sensors_enable:true;' then key at <=1 W into the pad -> 'tx_sensors:0,<mic>,<pwr>,<pwr>,<swr>,<alc>;' with power > 0, SWR >= 1.0, 0 before the first reading

feature: RX audio stream: audio_start / audio_stop; each frame's header gives rate, type, length and channels
how_to_confirm: TCI 'audio_start:0;' -> 'audio_start:0;' then binary frames (TCI header, type RX audio) at the expected rate (48 kHz -> ~23 frames/s of 2048); 'audio_stop:0;' -> frames stop

feature: Audio format per client: audio_samplerate 24000|48000, sample type int16|int24|int32|float32, channels 1|2, samples 100-2048; defaults 48k float32 stereo 2048; 24k without channels -> mono 512; a value it lacks answered with the one kept
how_to_confirm: Fresh TCI: greeting shows 48000/float32/2/2048; 'audio_samplerate:24000;' alone -> frames mono 512; 'audio_stream_sample_type:int16;' -> header type int16; 'audio_samplerate:44100;' -> answered with the kept rate

feature: CW from a client: cw_macros:0,TEXT; keyed by the radio's own keyer at KEY Speed; trx as it goes; cw_macros_empty:0; at the end
how_to_confirm: Radio A in CW, allowed client 'cw_macros:0,CQ DE T3ST K;' at <=1 W into the pad -> 'trx:0,true;' ... 'trx:0,false;' 'cw_macros_empty:0;'; radio B's CW decoder ('cw "..."' on the remote) reads CQ DE T3ST K

feature: CW text in a mode other than CW/CW-R is refused trx:0,false; with 'TCI CW: set CW or CW-R mode' on the screen, nobody asked
how_to_confirm: Radio in USB; TCI 'cw_macros:0,TEST;' -> 'trx:0,false;', state ask 0, tx 0; screenshot shows 'TCI CW: set CW or CW-R mode'

feature: Ask before TX asks at the client's first CW text, which does not go out
how_to_confirm: Unknown client in CW: 'cw_macros:0,TEST;' -> 'trx:0,false;' and state ask 1; nothing keyed; answer No via remote MFK

feature: cw_macros_stop; (or trx:0,false; or leaving) stops the client's own text at once and drops what waits; not another client's or the operator's
how_to_confirm: Long text going (pad, <=1 W); 'cw_macros_stop;' -> 'trx:0,false;' then 'cw_macros_empty:0;' and tx 0 at once

feature: CW text: ^ ~ * stand for : , ;; |SK| |BT| |AR| |KN| prosigns; > < raise/lower 5 WPM for that text (5-50); unknown chars dropped; more text queued up to 1024 characters
how_to_confirm: Send 'cw_macros:0,TEST^1~2 |BT| >FAST;' then a second text while it goes, over the pad: radio B's CW decoder shows TEST:1,2 = FAST and the second text after it

feature: A client that holds PTT (trx:0,true;) cannot send a CW text; another client's text while someone is on the air is refused
how_to_confirm: Client keys trx:0,true; (pad) then 'cw_macros:0,X;' -> refused (trx:0,false; or ignored), no CW; client 2's text -> 'trx:0,false;'

feature: cw_macros_speed and cw_keyer_speed are both KEY Speed (5-50 WPM, clamped); set takes control, ask does not; every client hears both on change
how_to_confirm: Two TCI clients: client 1 'cw_macros_speed:25;' -> both get 'cw_macros_speed:25;' and 'cw_keyer_speed:25;'; 'cw_macros_speed:0,99;' -> 50; 'cw_keyer_speed;' -> current value, ctl unchanged

feature: cw_msg, cw_terminal, cw_macros_delay, cw_macros_speed_up/down and keyer are left unanswered
how_to_confirm: TCI each of those commands -> no reply within 1 s, then 'vfo:0,0;' still answered

how_to_confirm: 'apps' on both: the same [action, name] ids.

feature: Both radios' updaters are offered the same newest release (per-model bundles)
how_to_confirm: SSH x6100-update check on both: 'latest' equal, 'url' set for each model.

feature: 'wide 1' streams the base's whole 384 kHz spectrum (X6200); the X6100 answers that its base has none
how_to_confirm: 'panel 1', 'wide 1': X6200 spectrum frames with width ~384000; X6100 'err wide: this radio's base has no spectrum of its own'.

feature: 'play /tmp/bench_NAME.wav' plays a bench file on the radio's own speaker (bench_player.c; the acoustic mic test); 'play stop'; refused while transmitting
how_to_confirm: scp a WAV to /tmp/bench_t.wav, 'play /tmp/bench_t.wav': state 'plays' 1 then 0; 'play /etc/passwd' -> err; while 'tx' 1 -> err.

feature: USB transmit audio (TCI) to the other radio's USB receiver: 200-3100 Hz tones arrive at their frequency and level, both directions
how_to_confirm: tones.py TX RX at 0.1 W: each tone's offset/slope, level within 3.5 dB 300-2900 Hz, other sideband >= 40 dB down; then swap TX and RX and compare the two directions.

feature: LSB transmit to LSB receive, the same tones and passband, both directions
how_to_confirm: tones.py's LSB pass: the same measures; the listener's spectrum at each tone's RF.

feature: The transmitter's power loop on the first sound after a pause: no overshoot or dip on gcfix4/5; Xiegu's own bases (the factory X6100, the X6200) measured and said, their loops overshoot
how_to_confirm: tones.py TX RX --bursts 0.05,...,3.2: overshoot, dip and settling per pause within +-1 dB.

feature: Opposite-sideband image and carrier leak, band by band 160-6 m, both radios
how_to_confirm: image.py TX RX --bands ...: image at dial-fa within 0.1 Hz, its level in dBc and the carrier in dBc per band; compare both radios as senders.

feature: CW sent by one radio (TCI cw_macros or MSG > CW message) is decoded by the other's CW decoder, and the other way
how_to_confirm: Sender in CW at 0.1 W: TCI 'cw_macros:0,TEST Q1TST;'; listener in CW, decoder on: its 'cw "..."' text contains it; spectrum rise at the sender's carrier; swap.

feature: AM voice over: one radio armed on G sends, the other hears it, every band's G channel, both ways
how_to_confirm: bench.py radios-walkie A B --modes am: listener's spectrum within 3 kHz of the dial or S-meter up 15 dB on each over.

feature: FM voice over on G (10 m and 6 m FM calling too), both ways
how_to_confirm: bench.py radios-walkie A B --modes fm: as for AM.

feature: FT8 both ways between the radios: CQ decoded, a reply sent and decoded
how_to_confirm: bench.py radios-ft8 TX RX --rx-alike, then swapped: PASS both ways with the ft8r rows.

feature: The microphone path on the air: the built-in mic (and the hand mic) modulates an SSB/AM/FM over the other radio hears
how_to_confirm: Radios side by side: 'play /tmp/bench_voice.wav' on the listener's neighbour speaker, the sender keyed on G (AB, 'key PTT 1 HOLD' lease) at 0.1 W, mic=built-in: the listener's spectrum shows the voice's sidebands; the hand mic needs the owner (acoustic.py is referenced but not in the repo).

feature: Both receivers read the same level for the same signal through the same pads (S-meter and spectrum alike)
how_to_confirm: radios-ft8 --rx-alike / path_proof both ways: listener S-meter and spectrum rise at the tone vs the chain's expected dBm, compared between the radios.

feature: Each radio's power meter reads what was asked at 0.1-1 W on every band
how_to_confirm: set pwr 1..10, key via TCI tone: 't W SWR ALC' W within 30 % of asked; logged over-power per band (6 m: the X6100 reads ~1 W at 0.1 W).

feature: B knows GMRS's 22 channels and the repeater inputs of 15-22: a GMRS frequency set as B's channel goes with the GMRS preset (not UHF LMR's), heard in NFM, named 'GMRS 20' / 'GMRS 20 IN' on B's peaks, its title and C's log
how_to_confirm: page B, 'set bch 462675000': state bpre GMRS, bmode NFM, bname 'GMRS 20'; 467562500: 'GMRS 8'; 467675000: 'GMRS 20 IN'; A's freq/mode unchanged (orch gmrs-b)

feature: B's F1 on the GMRS preset (SCAN CFG's F1 SCANS: THE BAND) scans GMRS's 22 channels in frequency order, the step time on each, stopping on one that talks as the style says, named in C's log
how_to_confirm: page B on GMRS 15, key F1: state bscan 4, bhz steps 462.550, 462.5625 ... in order, bname each 'GMRS n'; F1 again: bscan 0 (orch gmrs-scan; a replay of noise with no SDR on HOST)

feature: G's GMRS group (channels 1-22, home 20) and GMRS RPT IN group (inputs of 15-22) with any SDR on HOST: CH-/CH+ round the group, CH LIST numbers them by channel, 4-decimal frequencies, a note each (interstitial, narrow 12.5 kHz, repeater output); 8-14 shown NFM
how_to_confirm: page G, 'set gsdr 462675000': state ghz 462675000; F4 CH LIST: 22 rows numbered 1-22; 'set gsdr 467675000': GMRS RPT IN 20 (orch gmrs-g)
manual_ref: #### G on an SDR: RTL-SDR, HackRF or bladeRF

feature: G's SDR never sends on GMRS: A/B there arms nothing and says 'NO TX: GMRS: ONLY RADIOS CERTIFIED FOR IT (47 CFR 95E)'; PTT refused with the same words whatever the SDR (HackRF, bladeRF); G's TX line 'GMRS: RX ONLY'
how_to_confirm: G on GMRS 20 through an SDR: state gno 'GMRS: ONLY RADIOS CERTIFIED FOR IT (47 CFR 95E)'; key AB: garm 0, rxo 1, tx 0 (orch gmrs-g)

feature: No TX on GMRS's channels and repeater inputs (462.5375-462.7375, 467.5375-467.7375 MHz) by any path: a transverter covering them, TX outside ham bands on, any TX ranges profile, the SDR: refused 'GMRS: certified radios only'
how_to_confirm: tools/gmrs host check (gmrs_test, gmrs_tx_x6100/x6200 on the real settings: every channel, input and edge refused as GMRS through a transverter, the switch on, each TX ranges profile), tools/ham_bands and tools/tx_ranges (GMRS's spans written out); orch gmrs-xvtr: the remote's PTT at GMRS through a transverter answered 'err ptt: no TX on GMRS: ...', nothing keyed

feature: The remote's state says B and G on the SDR (bhz, bpre, bmode, bname, bscan 0-4, ghz, garm, gno, sdr) and F's choice and GMRS panel (fsel, gmp, gmhz, gmrx); 'set gmp 1|0' (page F only) opens or closes F's GMRS panel; 'set bch HZ' (page B only) sets B's channel with the narrowest preset, 'set gsdr HZ' (page G with an SDR) G's SDR channel, 0 back on the radio
how_to_confirm: 'set bch 462675000' on page B: bhz 462675000, bpre GMRS; on page A: 'err bch: only while the Sentry shows B' (orch gmrs-b)

feature: F SYSTEM's GMRS (LISTEN): a panel of GMRS's 22 channels and the repeater inputs of 15-22 (number, 4-decimal frequency, bandwidth, what each is, WATCHED, where B or A is on it); the MFK or VFO chooses, F1 or a push tunes it on the receiver there (B's SDR, else the radio's own through the WR12 on A; none: says why), F2 scans the 22 there, F3 watches it on a spare RTL, F4 the CTCSS privacy codes 1-38 and the 104 DCS codes, F5/BACK/APP closes; its last line: no TX, certified GMRS radios only
how_to_confirm: page F, 'set gmp 1': fsel 'GMRS (LISTEN)', gmp 1, gmhz a GMRS channel, gmrx the receiver; the VFO moves gmhz a row; F4: gmhz 0, F4: back; F1: with an SDR page B on it, with none nothing tuned; F5: gmp 0 (orch gmrs-f)

feature: GMRS on the X6200's own receiver through the WR12 (or a transverter covering 462-468 MHz): A's F1 on D's GMRS band scans the 22 channels in NFM (not the band), A's targets named GMRS20 / G20 IN, G's GMRS and GMRS RPT IN groups on the radio with CH-/CH+ and CH LIST; A/B there arms nothing ('NO TX: GMRS: ONLY RADIOS CERTIFIED FOR IT (47 CFR 95E)')
how_to_confirm: with the WR12 on HOST, or a transverter taking 462.5-467.8 MHz in (orch gmrs-xvtr sets one on both radios): F's GMRS panel gmrx 2, its F1 tunes A in NFM; A's F1: the dial steps 462.550, 462.5625... in order; key AB on A and G at GMRS: rxo stays 1; G's CH + steps the GMRS group on the radio; tools/gmrs gmrs_tx_x6200: the WR12 receives every channel and input, sends none
